entries.english: Transparent proxy that sits in front of any other MCP server and shrinks its tool output before it reaches the model. Lossless by default — a denser encoding of the same bytes, with a round-trip gate asserting an exact inverse, so nothing is dropped or summarised. Repeated calls to the same tool emit a delta against the prior result instead of the whole payload. Per-tool opt-in, no decode step, no model in the loop. `uv tool install terse-mcp` then `terse proxy -- <server>`
entries.zh: 位于其他 MCP 服务器之前的透明代理，在工具输出到达模型之前将其压缩。默认无损：对相同字节进行更紧凑的编码，并通过往返校验确保可精确逆转，不丢弃或摘要内容。重复调用同一工具时只发送相对上次结果的增量。按工具选择启用，无需解码步骤，也不让模型参与。先运行 `uv tool install terse-mcp`，再运行 `terse proxy -- <server>`。

entries.zh: AI 在 GitHub 上找到开源工具后，Legwork 将其作为 MCP 工具安装到沙箱：只访问你授权的文件夹、只读，除非允许否则无网络。37 个缓存工具无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Go-to-market signals via Apify actors: hiring signals, tech stack detection, job board scanning, LinkedIn URL resolution, ICP scoring and signal aggregation.
entries.zh: 通过 Apify actor 获取市场拓展信号，包括招聘信号、技术栈检测、职位板扫描、LinkedIn URL 解析、理想客户画像评分和信号聚合。

entries.english: MCP aggregator that connects agents to multiple MCP servers through one configuration, with ready-made templates and cross-repo prompt workflows.
entries.zh: MCP 聚合器通过一个配置将代理连接到多个 MCP 服务器，提供现成模板和跨仓库提示词工作流。

entries.english: Search engine for AI agents to discover products, services and businesses across categories, without LLM calls.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的搜索引擎，跨类别发现产品、服务和企业，无需调用大语言模型。

entries.english: Portable playbooks for agent skills, MCP servers, personas, instructions, and memory. Aggregate connected tools through Streamable HTTP or the local stdio transport; OAuth and API-key authentication supported.
entries.zh: 可移植的代理技能、MCP 服务器、角色、指令和记忆操作手册。通过 Streamable HTTP 或本地 stdio 传输聚合连接的工具，支持 OAuth 和 API 密钥认证。

entries.english: MCP servers for Japanese SMB SaaS without their own MCP support, such as KING OF TIME, SmartHR, kaonavi, Smaregi, LINE Lstep and CloudSign.
entries.zh: 为未提供自身 MCP 支持的日本中小企业 SaaS 提供 MCP 服务器，例如 KING OF TIME、SmartHR、kaonavi、Smaregi、LINE Lstep 和 CloudSign。

entries.english: Access xAI's Grok API with agentic tool calling, image generation, vision and file support.
entries.zh: 访问 xAI 的 Grok API，支持代理式工具调用、图像生成、视觉和文件。

entries.english: Pay-per-call x402 tools and skill packs (headless browser, web search, OCR, wallet-keyed memory), plus a router that finds the cheapest healthy tool.
entries.zh: 按次付费的 x402 工具与技能包（无头浏览器、网页搜索、OCR、按钱包键控的记忆），以及查找价格最低且健康工具的路由器。

entries.english: MCP gateway with single-port multiplexing and meta-tools that replace individual tool registrations, plus hot-reloadable capabilities and OpenAPI import.
entries.zh: MCP 网关支持单端口多路复用，以元工具替代逐项工具注册，并支持能力热重载和导入 OpenAPI。

entries.english: Governed access to DMTF Redfish BMCs (iDRAC, iLO, XCC, OpenBMC) for power, thermal, firmware and BIOS management; read-only by default with tiered write modes.
entries.zh: 受治理地访问 DMTF Redfish BMC（iDRAC、iLO、XCC、OpenBMC），管理电源、温度、固件和 BIOS；默认只读，写入模式分级。

entries.english: Mount multiple OpenAPI specs or a FastAPI app as MCP servers in one process, exposing GET endpoints as resources and large specs through meta-tools.
entries.zh: 在单一进程中将多个 OpenAPI 规范或 FastAPI 应用挂载为 MCP 服务器，将 GET 端点作为资源公开，并通过元工具处理大型规范。

entries.english: Read-only search over a local index of your engineering stack (GitHub, Jira, Slack, PagerDuty, Datadog and more): incidents, PRs, deployments and DORA metrics.
entries.zh: 对本地工程技术栈索引进行只读搜索（GitHub、Jira、Slack、PagerDuty、Datadog 等），涵盖事故、PR、部署和 DORA 指标。

entries.english: Serve many stdio MCP servers from one container over HTTPS, with path-based routing, an aggregate endpoint using meta-tools, built-in OAuth 2.1 and hot reload.
entries.zh: 从一个容器通过 HTTPS 提供多个 stdio MCP 服务器，支持基于路径的路由、使用元工具的聚合端点、内置 OAuth 2.1 和热重载。

entries.english: One API key for 24 agent capabilities: web search, scraping, people and company data, email finding and verification, images, speech, transcription, documents, code execution, research and domains, with no provider sign-ups. `npx -y suprsonic-mcp`
entries.zh: 一个 API 密钥提供 24 项代理能力：网页搜索、抓取、人员与公司数据、邮件地址查找和验证、图像、语音、转录、文档、代码执行、研究和域名，无需注册服务商。`npx -y suprsonic-mcp`

entries.english: Crypto market oracle: BUY/SELL/HOLD consensus from RSI, MACD, funding rates and on-chain flow, plus Polymarket edges with EV scoring and X crowd sentiment.
entries.zh: 加密市场预言机：根据 RSI、MACD、资金费率和链上流量给出 BUY/SELL/HOLD 共识，并提供带 EV 评分的 Polymarket 优势和 X 群体情绪。

entries.english: Plugin-based server and Chrome extension that gives AI agents access to web apps through your authenticated browser session, with a plugin SDK.
entries.zh: 基于插件的服务器和 Chrome 扩展，让 AI 代理通过你已认证的浏览器会话访问 Web 应用，并提供插件 SDK。

entries.english: Agent-to-agent referral network where AI agents discover, recommend and refer users to each other, with a bilateral trust model and referral tracking.
entries.zh: 代理间推荐网络，让 AI 代理相互发现、推荐并转介用户，支持双边信任模型和推荐跟踪。

entries.english: Automatically discover and configure MCP servers on your local machine.
entries.zh: 自动发现并配置本机上的 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Orchestrates all your MCP servers through tool discovery, reducing token overhead.
entries.zh: 通过工具发现编排所有 MCP 服务器，降低 token 开销。

entries.english: Developer utilities: SEO optimization, document conversion, domain lookup, email validation, QR codes, weather data, social media posting and security scanning.
entries.zh: 开发者工具：SEO 优化、文档转换、域名查询、邮件验证、二维码、天气数据、社交媒体发布和安全扫描。

entries.english: Gateway for QA/SDET work: Playwright, filesystem, GitHub, Jira, Postgres and 15+ more MCP servers behind one connection, with per-tool allow/deny and read-only-by-default databases.
entries.zh: 面向 QA/SDET 工作的网关：通过一个连接访问 Playwright、文件系统、GitHub、Jira、Postgres 和另外 15 多个 MCP 服务器，支持逐工具允许/拒绝，数据库默认只读。

entries.english: Search developer infrastructure deals, free tiers and startup programs, compare vendors, plan stacks and track pricing changes.
entries.zh: 搜索开发者基础设施优惠、免费套餐和初创企业计划，比较服务商、规划技术栈并跟踪价格变化。

entries.english: Tools for agent supply-chain security, scanner consensus and x402 reliability, plus access to Vibes-Coded's commerce catalog.
entries.zh: 用于代理供应链安全、扫描器共识和 x402 可靠性的工具，并可访问 Vibes-Coded 的商务目录。

entries.english: Hub that aggregates tools from multiple MCP servers with unified BM25 and regex search and deferred loading.
entries.zh: 聚合多个 MCP 服务器工具的中心，提供统一 BM25 和正则搜索以及延迟加载。

entries.english: Gateway that funnels multiple MCP servers through one endpoint, with live attach and detach, tool filtering and hiding, hot config reload and optional OAuth.
entries.zh: 将多个 MCP 服务器汇聚到一个端点的网关，支持实时连接与断开、工具过滤和隐藏、配置热重载以及可选 OAuth。

entries.english: Preflight checks for x402 payments: detect decoys, zombie endpoints, dead services and price traps before an agent pays, plus forensics and alternatives.
entries.zh: x402 支付预检：在代理付款前检测诱饵、僵尸端点、失效服务和价格陷阱，并提供取证与替代方案。

entries.english: Tool intelligence over scored services: discover and compare providers, check AN Scores, execute with managed or own credentials, and track costs and failures.
entries.zh: 基于评分服务的工具情报：发现并比较服务商、查看 AN Score、使用托管或自有凭据执行，并跟踪成本和失败。

entries.english: Meta-MCP server that lets LLMs discover, install and orchestrate multiple MCP servers to extend their own capabilities on demand.
entries.zh: 元 MCP 服务器，让大语言模型按需发现、安装和编排多个 MCP 服务器以扩展自身能力。

entries.english: Local MCP proxy that routes multiple servers through one endpoint, with BM25 tool filtering, quarantine security, activity logging and a web UI.
entries.zh: 本地 MCP 代理，通过一个端点路由多个服务器，支持 BM25 工具过滤、隔离安全、活动日志和网页界面。

entries.english: AI phone number directory: query Voxie AI personas and third-party AI services such as ChatGPT and get webchat links.
entries.zh: AI 电话号码目录：查询 Voxie AI 角色及 ChatGPT 等第三方 AI 服务，获取网页聊天链接。

entries.english: Image generation and editing with OpenAI's GPT image models.
entries.zh: 使用 OpenAI 的 GPT 图像模型生成和编辑图像。

entries.english: Pay-per-call x402 data: equities, crypto/DeFi analytics, options chains, dealer GEX, macro data, congressional trades, prediction markets and SEC filings.
entries.zh: 按次付费的 x402 数据：股票、加密/DeFi 分析、期权链、做市商 GEX、宏观数据、国会议员交易、预测市场和 SEC 文件。

entries.english: Pay-per-call x402 APIs: Polymarket and Kalshi prediction markets, DeFi and crypto data, on-chain reads across EVM chains, live weather and web search.
entries.zh: 按次付费的 x402 API：Polymarket 和 Kalshi 预测市场、DeFi 与加密数据、跨 EVM 链的链上读取、实时天气和网页搜索。

entries.english: MCPX: open-source gateway for managing MCP servers at scale, centralizing tool discovery, access controls, call prioritization and usage tracking.
entries.zh: MCPX：大规模管理 MCP 服务器的开源网关，集中处理工具发现、访问控制、调用优先级和用量跟踪。

entries.english: Create custom tool bundles, connect providers with OAuth or API keys, and use one MCP server across many integrations, with a UI for bundles and credentials.
entries.zh: 创建自定义工具包，使用 OAuth 或 API 密钥连接服务商，在多种集成中共用一个 MCP 服务器，并通过界面管理工具包和凭据。

entries.english: Deterministic date and time reasoning: arithmetic, DST-aware time zones, business days, public holidays, RFC 5545 recurrence and Gregorian/Persian conversion.
entries.zh: 确定性的日期时间推理：算术运算、考虑夏令时的时区、工作日、公共假日、RFC 5545 重复规则和公历/波斯历转换。

entries.english: Discover and compare L402 and x402 paid API services from satring.com, a curated Lightning and USDC API directory.
entries.zh: 从精选 Lightning 和 USDC API 目录 satring.com 发现并比较 L402 和 x402 付费 API 服务。

entries.english: Proxy combining multiple MCP servers into one interface, with discovery and management of tools, prompts, resources and templates plus a debugging playground.
entries.zh: 将多个 MCP 服务器合并为一个界面的代理，支持工具、提示词、资源和模板的发现与管理，并提供调试游乐场。

entries.english: Meta-server that reduces Claude Code tool bloat via progressive disclosure, auto-starting Playwright and Context7 and provisioning MCP servers on demand.
entries.zh: 通过渐进式披露减少 Claude Code 工具膨胀的元服务器，自动启动 Playwright 和 Context7，并按需配置 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Connect MCP hosts to apps such as Notion, Slack, Monday and Airtable.
entries.zh: 将 MCP 主机连接到 Notion、Slack、Monday 和 Airtable 等应用。

entries.english: API hub covering travel (Amadeus, Sabre), Polymarket prediction markets, crypto and weather, paid per call via x402 in USDC.
entries.zh: 覆盖旅行（Amadeus、Sabre）、Polymarket 预测市场、加密货币和天气的 API 中心，通过 x402 使用 USDC 按次付费。

entries.english: Search, document and execute authenticated API calls across apps such as Gmail, Slack, Stripe, Notion and GitHub through a few tools with constant context size.
entries.zh: 通过少量工具跨 Gmail、Slack、Stripe、Notion 和 GitHub 等应用搜索、记录和执行已认证 API 调用，保持上下文大小恒定。

entries.english: Adapter to the OpenAaaS scientific agent network: submit tasks such as literature analysis or materials database queries to remote research agents.
entries.zh: 连接 OpenAaaS 科学代理网络的适配器，将文献分析或材料数据库查询等任务提交给远程研究代理。

entries.english: Runtime discovery for x402-payable APIs: find and route to pay-per-call endpoints by capability, ranked by quality and trust score, plus a Python SDK and CLI.
entries.zh: x402 付费 API 运行时发现：按能力查找并路由到按次付费端点，依据质量和信任分数排序，同时提供 Python SDK 和 CLI。

entries.english: Search x402-enabled HTTP APIs by keyword, paid per search via x402 micropayments on Base.
entries.zh: 按关键词搜索支持 x402 的 HTTP API，每次搜索通过 Base 上的 x402 小额支付付费。

entries.english: Multi-agent deliberation across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, with dynamically generated roles that explore the question from divergent angles.
entries.zh: 在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 之间进行多代理讨论，动态生成角色从不同角度探索问题。

entries.english: Agent hiring protocol on x402: discover specialized agents, hire them in one call and settle in USDC on Base, with reputation and on-chain EIP-3009 receipts.
entries.zh: 基于 x402 的代理雇用协议：发现专业代理、通过一次调用雇用，并使用 Base 上的 USDC 结算，提供声誉和链上 EIP-3009 收据。

entries.english: Connect agents to any REST API on the fly: maps the API once, then fetches typed data deterministically without per-call LLM use. Self-hosted.
entries.zh: 动态将代理连接到任意 REST API：只需映射一次 API，随后确定性获取带类型的数据，无需每次调用大语言模型。支持自托管。

entries.english: Local gateway and manager for MCP servers shared across AI coding tools: set up and authenticate each server once, with lazy discovery and OS keychain storage.
entries.zh: 供多个 AI 编码工具共享的本地 MCP 网关和管理器：每个服务器只需设置并认证一次，支持惰性发现和操作系统钥匙串存储。

entries.english: Search the Skillselion catalog of community-vetted Claude Code skills, MCP servers and marketplaces, ranked by installs and GitHub stars; load skills mid-task.
entries.zh: 搜索 Skillselion 的社区审核 Claude Code 技能、MCP 服务器和市场目录，按安装量和 GitHub Stars 排序，并可在任务中加载技能。

entries.english: Rust template for an MCP server that queries Anthropic's Claude API via the crimson-crab SDK.
entries.zh: Rust MCP 服务器模板，通过 crimson-crab SDK 查询 Anthropic 的 Claude API。

entries.english: Discover, invoke and verify agents on a paid marketplace: code generation, security scanning (OSV.dev, GitGuardian) and lead scoring, with signed results.
entries.zh: 在付费市场发现、调用和验证代理：包括代码生成、安全扫描（OSV.dev、GitGuardian）和销售线索评分，并提供签名结果。

entries.english: Find and vet x402 payment APIs in the x402-list directory: search and rank services, check uptime, health, per-endpoint prices and on-chain settlement volume.
entries.zh: 在 x402-list 目录中查找并审核 x402 支付 API：搜索和排序服务，检查在线时间、健康状态、各端点价格及链上结算量。

entries.english: Connect AI agents to MCP servers from one config synced across coding tools, served through one process with compact tool discovery and spec validation.
entries.zh: 通过在编码工具间同步的一份配置将 AI 代理连接到 MCP 服务器，由单一进程提供服务，支持精简工具发现和规范验证。

entries.english: Labor marketplace protocol for AI agents with atomic escrow and weighted anti-Sybil reputation.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的劳动市场协议，支持原子托管和加权抗女巫攻击声誉。

entries.english: Discovery and reliability registry of APIs, MCP servers and CLIs for AI agents: scheduled health probes, per-entry health cards with evidence expiry, free key in one call.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的 API、MCP 服务器和 CLI 发现与可靠性注册表：定期健康探测、具有证据过期时间的逐条健康卡片，以及一次调用获取免费密钥。

entries.english: Astronomical catalog data and observing session planning: OpenNGC deep-sky objects with visibility, rise/transit/set and alt/az calculations.
entries.zh: 天文目录数据与观测时段规划：OpenNGC 深空天体，可计算可见性、升起/中天/落下时间以及高度角/方位角。

entries.english: Search FCC, ITU, UNOOSA and FAA space regulatory filings via Orbit Sentinel: semantic search, entity dossiers, spectrum holdings, launch licenses and alerts.
entries.zh: 通过 Orbit Sentinel 搜索 FCC、ITU、UNOOSA 和 FAA 太空监管文件，支持语义搜索、实体档案、频谱持有、发射许可和提醒。

entries.english: CHAP Coordinator for auditable human-agent collaboration: approvals, overrides, handoffs, escalations and hash-linked evidence.
entries.zh: CHAP 协调器用于可审计的人机代理协作，涵盖批准、覆盖、交接、升级处理和哈希关联证据。

entries.english: Self-hosted, single-operator attributed record for multiple agents: identity and lineage, claims and evidence, agent review that keeps objections on file, and outcomes linked to the check-ins and predictions they grade.
entries.zh: 面向多个代理、由单一操作者自托管的可归属记录：包含身份与血缘、主张和证据、将异议留档的代理审查，以及关联所评估签到和预测的结果。

entries.english: Define, validate, deploy and operate machine-readable agreements, with EIP-712 permit preparation, signed participant inputs, state reads and input history.
entries.zh: 定义、验证、部署和运行机器可读协议，支持准备 EIP-712 许可、参与者签名输入、状态读取和输入历史。

entries.english: Access cogDepot, an anonymous broker where agents publish capability listings, negotiate terms and form escrow-backed deals with two-sided reputation.
entries.zh: 访问 cogDepot 匿名经纪平台，代理可发布能力条目、协商条款，并通过双向声誉达成托管保障的交易。

entries.english: External anchoring layer that records AI agent accountability boundaries on both sides, without inspecting content or passing judgment.
entries.zh: 外部锚定层，记录 AI 代理双方的责任边界，不检查内容，也不作判断。

entries.english: Human-in-the-loop via MCP elicitation: native confirmation dialogs and typed forms from JSON schemas in the host, plus a check of supported features.
entries.zh: 通过 MCP elicitation 实现人工参与：在主机中根据 JSON schema 显示原生确认对话框和带类型表单，并检查受支持功能。

entries.english: Delegate phone calls, captcha/2FA logins, errands and QA your agent can't finish to a real human assistant, then track results.
entries.zh: 将代理无法完成的电话、验证码/双因素认证登录、跑腿和 QA 任务委派给真人助手，并跟踪结果。

entries.english: Marketplace of verifiable tasks for AI agents: publish independently checkable tasks, submit work and build reputation, with actions in a hash-chained register.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的可验证任务市场：发布可独立核查的任务、提交成果并建立声誉，操作记录在哈希链登记簿中。

entries.english: Look up AI agents' evidence-based reputation and record two-party signed work receipts, with operator-authorized verification and a Merkle transparency log.
entries.zh: 查询基于证据的 AI 代理声誉，并记录双方签署的工作收据，支持运营方授权验证和 Merkle 透明日志。

entries.english: Detect and normalize traces of machine generation in Russian text, without authorship verdicts.
entries.zh: 检测并规范化俄语文本中的机器生成痕迹，不对作者身份作判断。

entries.english: Hire human operators for tasks needing physical presence, perception or judgment: real-world verification, product testing, AI output review and errands.
entries.zh: 雇用人类操作员完成需要现场存在、感知或判断的任务：现实验证、产品测试、AI 输出审查和跑腿。

entries.english: Public bounty board where AI agents claim funded bounties, deliver work and get paid in USDC on Base on acceptance, with a public receipt ledger.
entries.zh: 公开赏金板，AI 代理可认领已筹资赏金、交付成果并在验收后以 Base 上的 USDC 收款，提供公开收据账本。

entries.english: Open Task Relay: bounded public-good tasks that AI agents can discover, complete, submit and independently verify.
entries.zh: Open Task Relay：AI 代理可发现、完成和提交，且可独立验证的边界明确的公益任务。

entries.english: Evidence-graded index of where AI agents can earn: agent-work lanes graded A/B/C/F from recorded payouts, should-I-bid advice, a hash-chained evidence ledger and live agent job listings. Read-only, free without a key.
entries.zh: 按证据分级的 AI 代理赚钱机会索引：根据已记录付款将工作渠道评为 A/B/C/F，提供是否投标建议、哈希链证据账本和实时代理职位。只读，无需密钥且免费。

entries.english: Forbiz, the CRM for AI agents: record commitments with the signal you expect back and by when, plus evidence and outcomes, so the next session or agent resumes the open commitment instead of duplicating it. Starts with no account; every write is attributed to the agent that made it.
entries.zh: Forbiz，面向 AI 代理的 CRM：记录承诺、预期反馈信号和截止时间，以及证据与结果，让下一次会话或其他代理继续未完成承诺而非重复操作。无需账号即可开始；每次写入均归属于执行的代理。

entries.english: Agent identity with self-held Ed25519 keys, verifiable multi-party meeting rooms with co-signed transcript receipts, and script provenance chains.
entries.zh: 使用自持 Ed25519 密钥的代理身份、带共同签名记录收据的可验证多方会议室，以及脚本来源链。

entries.english: Community jury platform where humans and AI agents open cases, weigh evidence and vote together, with arbitration mode, verdict waiting and signed webhooks.
entries.zh: 社区陪审平台，让人类与 AI 代理共同立案、权衡证据和投票，提供仲裁模式、等待裁决和签名 webhook。

entries.english: Hire ID-verified people for errands, on-site photos, queue-sitting and in-person bookings, with escrow-backed offers, chat and proof-of-completion review.
entries.zh: 雇用经过身份验证的人完成跑腿、现场拍照、排队和线下预约，支持托管保障的报价、聊天和完成证明审查。

entries.english: Brazilian e-signature (SignDocs Brasil): create signing sessions and multi-signer envelopes, upload and download documents, verify signatures, and manage webhooks. ICP-Brasil digital certificates, facial biometrics and OTP, under MP 2.200-2. Local stdio via `npx -y @signdocs-brasil/mcp-server`, or the hosted HTTP endpoint.
entries.zh: 巴西电子签名（SignDocs Brasil）：创建签名会话和多签署人信封、上传下载文档、验证签名并管理 webhook。依据 MP 2.200-2 提供 ICP-Brasil 数字证书、面部生物识别和 OTP。通过 `npx -y @signdocs-brasil/mcp-server` 使用本地 stdio，或使用托管 HTTP 端点。

entries.english: Korea's government design system (KRDS) components with KWCAG 2.2 (Korean web accessibility standard) built in: refuses markup when labels or alt text are missing, checks rendered pages with axe plus real keyboard and contrast measurements, and ships Claude Code/Codex hooks that keep agents from finishing while violations remain.
entries.zh: 内置 KWCAG 2.2（韩国网页无障碍标准）的韩国政府设计系统（KRDS）组件：缺少标签或替代文本时拒绝生成标记，使用 axe、真实键盘和对比度测量检查渲染页面，并提供 Claude Code/Codex 钩子，在违规未解决时阻止代理结束。

entries.english: WCAG 2.2 accessibility tools: color contrast checks including text over images, EU accessibility declaration generation and an aria-live announcement monitor.
entries.zh: WCAG 2.2 无障碍工具：检查颜色对比度（包括图片上的文字）、生成欧盟无障碍声明，并监控 aria-live 公告。

entries.english: Runs real GUI programs in a sealed X11 or Wayland session where an agent can read the accessible tree, take screenshots and clips with sound, click, type and drive gamepads, then check what it finds: unnamed controls, contrast, Tab order, screen reader announcements and audio dropouts.
entries.zh: 在封闭的 X11 或 Wayland 会话中运行真实图形程序，让代理读取无障碍树、截取带声音的画面和视频、点击、输入及操作手柄，再检查无名称控件、对比度、Tab 顺序、屏幕阅读器公告和音频丢失。

entries.english: Color-vision accessibility: check palettes and images for colorblind safety, generate safe palettes, simulate color blindness and create Ishihara-style plates.
entries.zh: 色觉无障碍工具：检查调色板和图像对色盲用户是否安全、生成安全调色板、模拟色盲并创建类似石原色盲检查图的图版。

entries.english: Flux image generation and editing from Black Forest Labs via the Ace Data Cloud API.
entries.zh: 通过 Ace Data Cloud API 使用 Black Forest Labs 的 Flux 生成和编辑图像。

entries.english: Collaborative Arabic poetry arena and Poetic Equity protocol connecting AI agents with human poets.
entries.zh: 阿拉伯诗歌协作竞技场和 Poetic Equity 协议，连接 AI 代理与人类诗人。

entries.english: Nano Banana image generation and editing, including virtual try-on and product placement in realistic scenes.
entries.zh: 使用 Nano Banana 生成和编辑图像，包括虚拟试穿及在真实场景中放置产品。

entries.english: ByteDance Seedream image generation and editing via the Ace Data Cloud API.
entries.zh: 通过 Ace Data Cloud API 使用字节跳动 Seedream 生成和编辑图像。

entries.english: Semantic search over classical philosophy and humanities works.
entries.zh: 对古典哲学和人文学科作品进行语义搜索。

entries.english: Search for book information via the Open Library API.
entries.zh: 通过 Open Library API 搜索图书信息。

entries.english: Search the SansFiction book catalog by title, author, series or ISBN and manage a personal reading library: status, progress, ratings, reviews and collections.
entries.zh: 按书名、作者、系列或 ISBN 搜索 SansFiction 图书目录，并管理个人阅读库，包括状态、进度、评分、书评和收藏。

entries.english: Generate animations locally using Manim.
entries.zh: 使用 Manim 在本地生成动画。

entries.english: Soundboard with meme sounds from myinstants.com: search, play and browse categories.
entries.zh: 提供 myinstants.com 模因音效的音效板：搜索、播放和浏览类别。

entries.english: Connect AI assistants to Blender.
entries.zh: 将 AI 助手连接到 Blender。

entries.english: Render Blender scenes and 3D models (.blend, bpy scripts, GLB/glTF, FBX, USD, OBJ, STL) on cloud GPUs from AI agents: product shots, 360-degree turntables, animations and stills, with a tiled preview and a time estimate first. Remote MCP (OAuth) or stdio.
entries.zh: 由 AI 代理在云 GPU 上渲染 Blender 场景和 3D 模型（.blend、bpy 脚本、GLB/glTF、FBX、USD、OBJ、STL），生成产品图、360 度转台、动画和静帧，并先提供平铺预览和时间估计。支持远程 MCP（OAuth）或 stdio。

entries.english: Generate SVG icons from text descriptions with customizable styles.
entries.zh: 根据文本描述生成 SVG 图标，支持自定义样式。

entries.english: Art-tourism data: biennales (Venice, Whitney), art fairs (Art Basel, Frieze), major museum visitor guides and art trip recommendations.
entries.zh: 艺术旅游数据：双年展（威尼斯、惠特尼）、艺术博览会（巴塞尔艺术展、Frieze）、主要博物馆参观指南及艺术旅行建议。

entries.english: Access the Shahnameh (Book of Kings), Ferdowsi's Persian epic poem, including sections, verses and explanations.
entries.zh: 访问 Ferdowsi 的波斯史诗《列王纪》（Shahnameh），包括章节、诗句和解释。

entries.english: SVG art engine controlled through JSON config: CSS keyframe and SMIL animations, parametric curves, filters, gradients and PNG preview.
entries.zh: 通过 JSON 配置控制的 SVG 艺术引擎，支持 CSS 关键帧和 SMIL 动画、参数曲线、滤镜、渐变及 PNG 预览。

entries.english: No-markup video, image and speech generation with 400+ Vercel AI Gateway models (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana, GPT Image) inside Claude or ChatGPT, billed to your own Gateway credits at provider price. Self-hosted on your own Vercel account.
entries.zh: 在 Claude 或 ChatGPT 中以服务商原价使用 400 多个 Vercel AI Gateway 模型（Veo、Kling、Seedance、Nano Banana、GPT Image）生成视频、图像和语音，不加价，费用从自己的 Gateway 额度扣除。自托管在自己的 Vercel 账号中。

entries.english: Search Archive of Our Own (AO3) and delegate full-fic reading to Gemini, so recommendations draw on the actual text rather than the blurb.
entries.zh: 搜索 Archive of Our Own（AO3），并将全文阅读委派给 Gemini，使推荐基于实际正文而非简介。

entries.english: Control JupyterCAD using natural language.
entries.zh: 使用自然语言控制 JupyterCAD。

entries.english: Image editing through Photopea: documents, layers, text, shapes, filters, effects and export.
entries.zh: 通过 Photopea 编辑图像，包括文档、图层、文本、形状、滤镜、特效和导出。

entries.english: Search hand-drawn Infyicon icons in four matching styles and fetch SVG markup or PNG URLs.
entries.zh: 搜索四种匹配风格的手绘 Infyicon 图标，并获取 SVG 标记或 PNG URL。

entries.english: Resize, compress, convert, remove backgrounds, strip metadata, watermark and export images locally through QuokkaPix, without uploading source images.
entries.zh: 通过 QuokkaPix 在本地调整图像大小、压缩、转换、移除背景、清除元数据、加水印和导出，无需上传源图。

entries.english: Deterministic music theory: chord and Roman numeral analysis, voicing and reharmonization.
entries.zh: 确定性的音乐理论工具：和弦与罗马数字分析、配音和重新和声。

entries.english: License-verified search across The Met, Cleveland, AIC, Wikimedia Commons and Europeana, limited to CC0 and public-domain works, with citations.
entries.zh: 在大都会艺术博物馆、克利夫兰艺术博物馆、AIC、Wikimedia Commons 和 Europeana 中搜索经许可验证的作品，仅限 CC0 和公共领域，并提供引用。

entries.english: Image generation, background removal and 4x upscaling, paid per image via x402 in USDC on Base.
entries.zh: 图像生成、背景移除和 4 倍放大，通过 Base 上的 x402 使用 USDC 按图付费。

entries.english: Apple Music integration: search the catalog, browse your library, manage playlists and get personalized recommendations.
entries.zh: Apple Music 集成：搜索目录、浏览资料库、管理播放列表并获取个性化推荐。

entries.english: Creative AI tools: image generation, upscaling, background removal, product mockups, CMYK conversion, print-ready PDFs, SVG vectorization and watermarking.
entries.zh: 创意 AI 工具：图像生成、放大、背景移除、产品样机、CMYK 转换、适合印刷的 PDF、SVG 矢量化和水印。

entries.english: View, edit and run ComfyUI node-based image generation workflows, with an embedded terminal.
entries.zh: 查看、编辑和运行 ComfyUI 节点式图像生成工作流，并提供嵌入式终端。

entries.english: Access media models such as Flux 2 Pro, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling and ElevenLabs for image, video, speech, 3D and branded graphics.
entries.zh: 访问 Flux 2 Pro、Nano Banana Pro、GPT Image 2、Veo 3.1、Sora 2、Kling 和 ElevenLabs 等媒体模型，生成图像、视频、语音、3D 和品牌图形。

entries.english: Interact with the Discogs API.
entries.zh: 与 Discogs API 交互。

entries.english: Machine-native listening platform for C.W.A.'s album Straight Outta Crompton, letting AI agents listen to it.
entries.zh: 面向机器的 C.W.A. 专辑 Straight Outta Crompton 收听平台，让 AI 代理能够收听该专辑。

entries.english: The Bible as a knowledge graph of verses, people, places, topics and Hebrew lexemes: scripture search, interlinear lookup, cross references and genealogy.
entries.zh: 将圣经组织为经文、人物、地点、主题和希伯来语词素的知识图谱，支持经文搜索、逐行对照查询、交叉引用和家谱。

entries.english: Render music notation as SVG, MusicXML and MIDI from a JSON score, analyze MusicXML harmonically and search a music-theory knowledge base.
entries.zh: 从 JSON 乐谱渲染 SVG、MusicXML 和 MIDI 格式的乐谱，对 MusicXML 进行和声分析，并搜索音乐理论知识库。

entries.english: Create pixel art using the Aseprite API.
entries.zh: 使用 Aseprite API 创建像素艺术。

entries.english: Interact with the Quran.com corpus via its REST API.
entries.zh: 通过 REST API 与 Quran.com 语料库交互。

entries.english: Build, edit and render JangaFX IlluGen node graphs (procedural textures, VFX flipbooks): 157 node types, typed pin checks, curves, gradients, subgraphs, and invisible rendering through your own IlluGen.
entries.zh: 构建、编辑并渲染 JangaFX IlluGen 节点图（程序纹理、VFX 翻页动画）：支持 157 种节点类型、带类型的引脚检查、曲线、渐变、子图和通过自己的 IlluGen 进行无界面渲染。

entries.english: Search and retrieve movie, TV show and person information from The Movie Database (TMDB) API.
entries.zh: 通过 The Movie Database（TMDB）API 搜索和获取电影、电视剧及人物信息。

entries.english: Connect AI assistants to a live Autodesk Inventor session over COM: inspect bodies and features, find sliver faces in imported models, dry-run Unwrap, and script the Inventor API.
entries.zh: 通过 COM 将 AI 助手连接到实时 Autodesk Inventor 会话：检查实体和特征、查找导入模型中的狭长面、试运行 Unwrap，并以脚本调用 Inventor API。

entries.english: Local bridge for DaVinci Resolve (Free and Studio): timeline inspection, zoom animation, color adjustments and duplicate-timeline review.
entries.zh: DaVinci Resolve（免费版和 Studio）的本地桥接，支持时间线检查、缩放动画、调色和复制时间线审查。

entries.english: Official 3D Texel server: search and download 7,000+ PBR materials, HDRIs, decals and 3D assets (1,600+ free CC0) and generate seamless PBR materials and HDRI skyboxes with credits.
entries.zh: 官方 3D Texel 服务器：搜索并下载 7,000 多个 PBR 材质、HDRI、贴花和 3D 资源（其中 1,600 多个为免费 CC0），并使用额度生成无缝 PBR 材质和 HDRI 天空盒。

entries.english: Drive a local FreeCAD from an agent: parametric CAD, TechDraw drawings with GD&T, CalculiX FEM, and CFD, thermal, EM and multiphysics simulation.
entries.zh: 让代理驱动本地 FreeCAD：参数化 CAD、带 GD&T 的 TechDraw 图纸、CalculiX 有限元分析，以及 CFD、热、电磁和多物理场仿真。

entries.english: Generate and edit SVGs via natural language, with real-time updates and secure file handling.
entries.zh: 使用自然语言生成和编辑 SVG，支持实时更新和安全文件处理。

entries.english: Tarot meanings for all 78 cards, upright and reversed interpretations, love and career readings, yes-or-no answers, random draws and three-card spreads.
entries.zh: 提供 78 张塔罗牌的牌义，包括正逆位解释、爱情与事业解读、是非回答、随机抽牌和三张牌阵。

entries.english: Spotify tools: smart shuffle, natural-language song search, vibe analysis, artist network mapping, taste evolution and playlist management.
entries.zh: Spotify 工具：智能随机播放、自然语言歌曲搜索、氛围分析、艺术家关系图、品味变化和播放列表管理。

entries.english: Discover Kavel's AI photo and video generators (hairstyles, figurines, pet portraits, yearbook photos, dance videos, HD restoration) and get tuned prompts.
entries.zh: 发现 Kavel 的 AI 照片和视频生成器（发型、公仔、宠物肖像、年鉴照片、舞蹈视频、高清修复），并获取优化后的提示词。

entries.english: Drive a running SolidWorks from an agent over COM: 86 tools for parametric parts and assemblies (extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, holes on any face, ribs, fillets, shells, patterns, mates, joints checked over their range, interference checks, STEP/STL export). Every modelling call returns measured volume and bounding box, so the agent can verify its own work.
entries.zh: 通过 COM 让代理操作运行中的 SolidWorks：86 个参数化零件和装配工具，涵盖拉伸、旋转、扫掠、放样、任意面打孔、加强筋、圆角、抽壳、阵列、配合、全范围关节检查、干涉检查及 STEP/STL 导出。每次建模调用返回测量体积和包围盒，供代理验证自己的工作。

entries.english: Image generation and editing with a curated prompt library, prompt enhancement and routing across local ComfyUI, MeiGen Cloud and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.zh: 通过精选提示词库、提示词增强以及本地 ComfyUI、MeiGen Cloud 和兼容 OpenAI 的 API 路由进行图像生成与编辑。

entries.english: Image and video generation, editing and region repair via Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, GPT Image 2, Grok Imagine and Veo 3, with style presets.
entries.zh: 通过 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image、GPT Image 2、Grok Imagine 和 Veo 3 生成、编辑和修复图像或视频区域，支持风格预设。

entries.english: Unofficial Yandex Music server: search, likes, listening history, My Wave, similar tracks, public playlists by link, playlist management and export of your library to TXT/CSV.
entries.zh: 非官方 Yandex Music 服务器：搜索、点赞、收听历史、My Wave、相似曲目、通过链接访问公开播放列表、管理播放列表，以及将资料库导出为 TXT/CSV。

entries.english: Bulk Spotify operations: confidence-scored song matching, batch playlist creation from CSV or podcast lists, and exports of your most-saved artists and albums.
entries.zh: 批量 Spotify 操作：带置信度评分的歌曲匹配、根据 CSV 或播客列表批量创建播放列表，以及导出收藏最多的艺术家和专辑。

entries.english: Manage your LabelGrid music distribution catalog, releases, analytics and royalties.
entries.zh: 管理 LabelGrid 音乐发行目录、发行作品、分析数据和版税。

entries.english: Search, read and discover visual aesthetics such as cottagecore, dark academia, Y2K and goblincore from the Aesthetics Wiki.
entries.zh: 从 Aesthetics Wiki 搜索、阅读和发现 cottagecore、dark academia、Y2K、goblincore 等视觉美学。

entries.english: Create memes from memebo.at templates: search the catalog, caption a template and get a shareable meme link.
entries.zh: 使用 memebo.at 模板创建模因：搜索目录、为模板添加文字并获取可分享链接。

entries.english: Search and display artworks via the Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API.
entries.zh: 通过大都会艺术博物馆馆藏 API 搜索和显示艺术品。

entries.english: Turn natural language into 3D models in Fusion 360, with CAD tools for sketches, extrudes, fillets and JIS standard parts.
entries.zh: 将自然语言转为 Fusion 360 中的 3D 模型，提供草图、拉伸、圆角和 JIS 标准件 CAD 工具。

entries.english: Access the Smithsonian Institution's Open Access collections.
entries.zh: 访问史密森学会开放获取馆藏。

entries.english: Query the Noteboxd fragrance encyclopedia for perfumes, notes, accords, brands, perfumers, reviews and charts.
entries.zh: 查询 Noteboxd 香水百科中的香水、香调、调和、品牌、调香师、评论和榜单。

entries.english: First-edition book identification using points of issue, number-line decoding and publisher rules, plus New Mexico book-donation logistics.
entries.zh: 使用版本特征、数字列解码和出版商规则识别初版书籍，并提供新墨西哥州图书捐赠物流信息。

entries.english: Read-only access to a self-hosted Calibre-Web or Calibre-Web Automated ebook library via OPDS: search, shelves, covers and per-format download links.
entries.zh: 通过 OPDS 只读访问自托管 Calibre-Web 或 Calibre-Web Automated 电子书库，提供搜索、书架、封面和按格式下载链接。

entries.english: Inspect and automate Ableton Live locally through a Python MIDI Remote Script, with MIDI editing, device control, audio analysis and groove tools.
entries.zh: 通过 Python MIDI Remote Script 在本地检查和自动化 Ableton Live，提供 MIDI 编辑、设备控制、音频分析和律动工具。

entries.english: 3D printer access: live printer state, webcam snapshots and printer control.
entries.zh: 访问 3D 打印机：实时打印机状态、摄像头快照和打印控制。

entries.english: Natural-language control of NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, OpenUSD and more, via a server and an extension.
entries.zh: 通过服务器和扩展用自然语言控制 NVIDIA Isaac Sim、Isaac Lab、OpenUSD 等。

entries.english: Control Ableton Live through a local Remote Script bridge: inspect sets, create tracks, scenes and clips, load devices, apply music recipes and verify changes.
entries.zh: 通过本地 Remote Script 桥接控制 Ableton Live：检查工程、创建音轨、场景和片段、加载设备、应用音乐方案并验证更改。

entries.english: Describe a visual to build a playable TouchDesigner network: audio-reactive, generative, particle, 3D and feedback systems with live knobs and MIDI/OSC/DMX.
entries.zh: 通过描述视觉效果构建可播放的 TouchDesigner 网络：音频响应、生成式、粒子、3D 和反馈系统，支持实时旋钮及 MIDI/OSC/DMX。

entries.english: Connect AI assistants to Autodesk Maya.
entries.zh: 将 AI 助手连接到 Autodesk Maya。

entries.english: Create, inspect and iterate on 3D geometry with build123d parametric CAD: render PNG/SVG views, measure geometry and export STEP/STL.
entries.zh: 使用 build123d 参数化 CAD 创建、检查和迭代 3D 几何体，渲染 PNG/SVG 视图、测量几何体并导出 STEP/STL。

entries.english: Drive BricsCAD on Linux via an AutoLISP bridge: 2D drafting with dimensions and hatches, 3D solids with booleans, generated drawing views and PDF export.
entries.zh: 通过 AutoLISP 桥接在 Linux 上驱动 BricsCAD：支持带标注和填充的 2D 绘图、布尔运算 3D 实体、生成工程视图和 PDF 导出。

entries.english: Generate images, video and audio with models such as Flux, GPT-Image-1, Imagen 4, Grok, Seedance and ElevenLabs, with prompt presets and batch generation.
entries.zh: 使用 Flux、GPT-Image-1、Imagen 4、Grok、Seedance 和 ElevenLabs 等模型生成图像、视频和音频，支持提示词预设和批量生成。

entries.english: Access historical WWII records, photographs and documents from the Netherlands (1940-1945) via the Oorlogsbronnen (War Sources) API.
entries.zh: 通过 Oorlogsbronnen（战争资料）API 访问荷兰 1940–1945 年二战历史记录、照片和文献。

entries.english: Generate images, videos and music with Fal.ai models such as FLUX, Stable Diffusion and MusicGen.
entries.zh: 使用 FLUX、Stable Diffusion 和 MusicGen 等 Fal.ai 模型生成图像、视频和音乐。

entries.english: Music metadata search over tracks, artists, labels and releases: genres, release dates, ISRC/ISWC codes and IDs for Spotify, Apple Music, Discogs and more.
entries.zh: 搜索曲目、艺术家、唱片公司及发行作品的音乐元数据，包括流派、发行日期、ISRC/ISWC 代码，以及 Spotify、Apple Music、Discogs 等平台的 ID。

entries.english: Control FL Studio: in-DAW mixing (gain staging, EQ, compression, reverb, reference matching), routing and composition.
entries.zh: 控制 FL Studio：在数字音频工作站中进行混音（增益分级、均衡、压缩、混响和参考匹配）、路由与作曲。

entries.english: Manage RunComfy ComfyUI serverless deployments, hosted model inference and LoRA training jobs.
entries.zh: 管理 RunComfy 的 ComfyUI 无服务器部署、托管模型推理和 LoRA 训练任务。

entries.english: DaVinci Resolve integration for video editing, color grading, media management and project control.
entries.zh: 集成 DaVinci Resolve，用于视频剪辑、调色、媒体管理和项目控制。

entries.english: Read a live Autodesk Revit model (elements, parameters, views, warnings, PNG exports); model changes are opt-in, with dry runs and post-commit verification.
entries.zh: 读取实时 Autodesk Revit 模型（元素、参数、视图、警告和 PNG 导出）；模型修改需主动启用，并支持试运行和提交后验证。

entries.english: Bazi (Four Pillars) charting with true solar time correction and output in Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean.
entries.zh: 使用真太阳时校正排八字（四柱），支持中文、英文、日文和韩文输出。

entries.english: Search tracks on LRCLIB and read their lyrics, including time-synced LRC lines, with compact search results.
entries.zh: 在 LRCLIB 搜索曲目并读取歌词，包括带时间同步的 LRC 行，返回精简搜索结果。

entries.english: Read IMSLP, the Petrucci Music Library: search works and composers, view catalogue numbers, key and instrumentation, and browse editions with copyright status.
entries.zh: 读取 Petrucci 音乐图书馆 IMSLP：搜索作品与作曲家、查看目录号、调性和配器，并按版权状态浏览版本。

entries.english: Search Shakespeare monologues by character, play or first line, and fetch full text, modern-English paraphrases and scene or play summaries.
entries.zh: 按角色、剧作或首句搜索莎士比亚独白，获取全文、现代英语释义以及场景或剧作摘要。

entries.english: Search the Internet Archive, the Library of Congress and the Bibliothèque nationale de France at once, across catalogues and inside scanned text.
entries.zh: 同时搜索 Internet Archive、美国国会图书馆和法国国家图书馆的目录及扫描文本内容。

entries.english: Read-only showtimes for California and Hawaii theaters, from repertory houses and 35mm/70mm screenings to chains, verified against each theater's calendar.
entries.zh: 只读查询加利福尼亚和夏威夷影院的放映时间，涵盖经典影院、35mm/70mm 放映及连锁影院，并与各影院日历核验。

entries.english: Offline image processing: resize, crop, convert, compress, rotate, flip, thumbnails, watermarks, effects, placeholders and overlays.
entries.zh: 离线图像处理：调整大小、裁剪、转换、压缩、旋转、翻转、缩略图、水印、效果、占位图和叠加层。

entries.english: Control the REAPER DAW for mixing, mastering, MIDI composition and music production.
entries.zh: 控制 REAPER 数字音频工作站进行混音、母带处理、MIDI 作曲和音乐制作。

entries.english: Generate 3D models and images from text or reference images, then remesh, retexture, auto-rig, animate and export GLB/FBX/OBJ via the PicoBerry API.
entries.zh: 根据文本或参考图像生成 3D 模型和图像，再通过 PicoBerry API 重新网格化、重做纹理、自动绑定、制作动画并导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ。

entries.english: Ask an AI assistant about your Serato DJ library: harmonic BPM and Camelot key search, crates, duplicate and missing-file audits, and new crates built with a preview before anything is written. Unofficial.
entries.zh: 向 AI 助手查询 Serato DJ 资料库：按和声 BPM 和 Camelot 调式搜索、查看唱片箱、审计重复和缺失文件，并在写入前预览新建唱片箱。非官方。

entries.english: Generate, edit and upscale AI video and images (Seedance, Veo, Kling, FLUX, Nano Banana) via VicSee.
entries.zh: 通过 VicSee 生成、编辑和放大 AI 视频与图像（Seedance、Veo、Kling、FLUX、Nano Banana）。

entries.english: Drive the REAPER DAW over a local file bridge: read plugins and parameters, set FX values, write automation and measure mix changes, all inside undo blocks.
entries.zh: 通过本地文件桥接驱动 REAPER：读取插件和参数、设置效果值、写入自动化并测量混音变化，所有操作均在可撤销块内进行。

entries.english: Conversational Spotify control: play by description and manage the queue, devices, playlists and library, with a guided setup wizard.
entries.zh: 对话式 Spotify 控制：根据描述播放，并管理队列、设备、播放列表及资料库，提供引导设置向导。

entries.english: MCP server giving AI agents spatial awareness inside Autodesk Maya — scene inspection, deterministic audit, checkpoint/rollback transactional safety, screenshot-based visual verification (Beta).
entries.zh: 为 AI 代理提供 Autodesk Maya 空间感知的 MCP 服务器，包括场景检查、确定性审计、检查点/回滚事务安全及基于截图的视觉验证（Beta）。

entries.english: Chinese almanac (Tung Shing): daily readings, hour-pillar luck ratings, NASA JPL-based solar terms, auspicious dates, zodiac horoscopes and lucky hours.
entries.zh: 中国通胜：每日信息、时柱吉凶评分、基于 NASA JPL 的节气、吉日、生肖运势和吉时。

entries.english: Generate and edit images via your own OpenAI-compatible or Gemini image APIs and save them into the project directory, with optional model fallback.
entries.zh: 通过自己的兼容 OpenAI 或 Gemini 图像 API 生成和编辑图像，并保存到项目目录，可选模型回退。

entries.english: Search Bide & Musique's hand-catalogued collection of forgotten French songs by performer, title, writer, lyrics, label or year, and read full records.
entries.zh: 按演出者、标题、作者、歌词、唱片公司或年份搜索 Bide & Musique 手工编目的法国冷门歌曲收藏，并阅读完整记录。

entries.english: AETumi MCP — gateway for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to production-ready Three.js/WebGL 3D web components, templates and interactive scenes.
entries.zh: AETumi MCP——连接 AI 编码助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex）与可用于生产的 Three.js/WebGL 3D 网页组件、模板和交互场景的网关。

entries.english: Deterministic AI data-center design for Korea (NVIDIA Rubin era, 22.9 kV intake): rack count, PUE, total MVA, cooling split, CDU planning, cost and timeline.
entries.zh: 针对韩国的确定性 AI 数据中心设计（NVIDIA Rubin 时代，22.9 kV 进线）：计算机架数量、PUE、总 MVA、冷却分配、CDU 规划、成本和时间表。

entries.english: Art-directed website prompts as slash commands for hero sections, landing pages, SaaS, portfolios, e-commerce and 3D/WebGL scenes, each with a live demo.
entries.zh: 将具有艺术指导的网站提示词作为斜杠命令，覆盖首屏、落地页、SaaS、作品集、电商和 3D/WebGL 场景，每项均有实时演示。

entries.english: Bidirectional Figma bridge: turn selections into framework-aware code reusing your components and tokens, or create frames, text, styles, variables and screens.
entries.zh: 双向 Figma 桥接：将选中内容转为复用现有组件和令牌、感知框架的代码，或创建画框、文本、样式、变量和屏幕。

entries.english: Lint web animations with deterministic checks on the live page (duration, easing, stagger, exits, reduced motion, hover) plus optional vision-LLM UX review.
entries.zh: 通过对实时页面进行确定性检查来 lint 网页动画（时长、缓动、错峰、退出、减少动态效果、悬停），可选视觉大模型 UX 审查。

entries.english: Turn a repo into Mermaid or Graphviz architecture diagrams from its file tree, import graph and entry points; also enforces architecture rules in CI.
entries.zh: 根据仓库文件树、导入图和入口点生成 Mermaid 或 Graphviz 架构图，也可在 CI 中强制执行架构规则。

entries.english: Generate Excalidraw architecture diagrams with auto-layout, technology-aware component styling (databases, queues, caches) and stateful editing.
entries.zh: 生成自动布局的 Excalidraw 架构图，依据数据库、队列、缓存等技术类型设置组件样式，并支持有状态编辑。

entries.english: Create and edit Excalidraw diagrams in a CanvasKeep workspace: generate diagrams from nodes and edges with auto-layout, organize them into folders, and read or save full scenes, with local decryption for encrypted diagrams.
entries.zh: 在 CanvasKeep 工作区创建和编辑 Excalidraw 图：根据节点和边自动布局生成、整理到文件夹、读取或保存完整场景，并在本地解密加密图。

entries.english: Local-first network design: create Cisco-style network master files, L1/L2/L3 topology diagrams, HTML viewers, device tables and AI context files.
entries.zh: 本地优先的网络设计：创建 Cisco 风格网络主文件、L1/L2/L3 拓扑图、HTML 查看器、设备表和 AI 上下文文件。

entries.english: Mechanically validated frontend aesthetics for coding agents: an evidence-ranked palette library, OKLCH harmony generation, WCAG 2.2 + APCA contrast gates, color-blind simulation and AI-slop detection; installable as an agent skill or MCP server via uvx.
entries.zh: 为编码代理提供机械验证的前端美学：按证据排序的调色板库、OKLCH 和谐配色生成、WCAG 2.2 + APCA 对比度门槛、色盲模拟和 AI 套话检测；可通过 uvx 安装为代理技能或 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Detect contradictions and architectural drift in Kubernetes manifests, READMEs, OpenAPI specs and Word docs, with deterministic scoring and resolution advice.
entries.zh: 检测 Kubernetes 清单、README、OpenAPI 规范和 Word 文档中的矛盾及架构漂移，提供确定性评分和解决建议。

entries.english: Draw and edit draw.io diagrams from your project's files on a live browser canvas you can also edit by hand, with version history, undo, AWS, Azure and GCP shape libraries and PNG or SVG export.
entries.zh: 根据项目文件在可手工编辑的实时浏览器画布中绘制和编辑 draw.io 图，支持版本历史、撤销、AWS/Azure/GCP 图形库及 PNG 或 SVG 导出。

entries.english: Expose a company's design system (colors, typography, logos, components, guidelines, CSS tokens) to AI tools, parsed from CSS, Markdown, PDF, SVG and fonts.
entries.zh: 将公司的设计系统（颜色、字体、标志、组件、指南和 CSS 令牌）提供给 AI 工具，从 CSS、Markdown、PDF、SVG 和字体解析。

entries.english: AI Diagram Maker: generate flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ERDs, architecture, UML and mind maps from text, code, ASCII, images or Mermaid, rendered inline.
entries.zh: AI Diagram Maker：从文本、代码、ASCII、图像或 Mermaid 生成流程图、时序图、ERD、架构图、UML 和思维导图，并内联渲染。

entries.english: Create workflow, sequence and architecture diagrams with the FlowZap Code DSL, with validation, playground links, syntax docs, export, diffing and patching.
entries.zh: 使用 FlowZap Code DSL 创建工作流、时序和架构图，支持验证、游乐场链接、语法文档、导出、差异比较和补丁。

entries.english: Turn local projects or GitHub repositories into Mermaid diagrams rendered via Kroki.
entries.zh: 将本地项目或 GitHub 仓库转换为通过 Kroki 渲染的 Mermaid 图。

entries.english: Open-source mind maps and whiteboard your agent draws on live: 22 tools for mind maps, notes, shapes, tables, charts, connectors, comments and HTML/PDF export; boards are local files.
entries.zh: 供代理实时绘制的开源思维导图和白板：22 个工具涵盖思维导图、笔记、形状、表格、图表、连接线、评论及 HTML/PDF 导出；画板为本地文件。

entries.english: Offline UI/UX design and marketing guidance for web, iOS, Android and macOS, plus generators for design tokens, color systems, type scales and WCAG checks.
entries.zh: 面向 Web、iOS、Android 和 macOS 的离线 UI/UX 设计与营销指导，以及设计令牌、配色系统、字体层级和 WCAG 检查生成器。

entries.english: Local design engine: create, edit and export branded social posts, flyers, decks and business cards, with print-ready PDFs and InDesign, PSD and PDF import.
entries.zh: 本地设计引擎：创建、编辑和导出品牌社交帖子、传单、演示文稿和名片，支持印刷用 PDF 及导入 InDesign、PSD 和 PDF。

entries.english: Bridge to live SysML v1 models in CATIA Magic: query, audit, trace and edit blocks, requirements, allocations and diagrams over a local, air-gapped connection.
entries.zh: 连接 CATIA Magic 中实时 SysML v1 模型：通过本地隔离网络查询、审计、追踪和编辑模块、需求、分配关系及图表。

entries.english: Generate iOS UI mockups as PNG and HTML from a text prompt, using Claude and a headless Playwright renderer.
entries.zh: 使用 Claude 和无头 Playwright 渲染器，根据文本提示生成 PNG 和 HTML 格式的 iOS 界面样稿。

entries.english: Design kits and brand workflows: browse and apply design systems, create shareable brand projects, and research names, domains and EUIPO trademarks.
entries.zh: 设计套件和品牌工作流：浏览并应用设计系统、创建可分享的品牌项目，并研究名称、域名和 EUIPO 商标。

entries.english: Construction plan takeoff: load plan PDFs, read title blocks, set drawing scale, trace rooms and export quantities like square footage and linear feet.
entries.zh: 建筑图纸工程量统计：加载图纸 PDF、读取标题栏、设置图纸比例、描绘房间，并导出平方英尺和线性英尺等数量。

entries.english: Official Luw.ai server: redesign rooms, building exteriors and gardens from photos, render sketches and CAD views, edit images, and create walkthrough videos and 3D models. Runs locally via npx or hosted at mcp.luw.ai with sign-in.
entries.zh: 官方 Luw.ai 服务器：根据照片重新设计房间、建筑外观和花园，渲染草图与 CAD 视图、编辑图像，并创建漫游视频和 3D 模型。可通过 npx 在本地运行，或登录使用托管于 mcp.luw.ai 的服务。

entries.english: Mermaid diagram generation (flowcharts, sequence, class, ER, architecture and state diagrams) with templates, layout engines and SVG/PNG/PDF export.
entries.zh: 生成 Mermaid 图，包括流程图、时序图、类图、ER 图、架构图和状态图，提供模板、布局引擎及 SVG/PNG/PDF 导出。

entries.english: Local-first design workspace: compose wireframes and branded multi-page HTML/CSS docs with live preview, brand and asset libraries, validation and PDF export.
entries.zh: 本地优先的设计工作区：组合线框图和品牌多页 HTML/CSS 文档，提供实时预览、品牌与素材库、验证和 PDF 导出。

entries.english: Korean architecture, engineering and construction knowledge: KDS, KCS and KS standards, statutes and expertise in one graph, with answers citing clauses.
entries.zh: 韩国建筑、工程与施工知识：将 KDS、KCS、KS 标准、法规和专业知识整合到一个图谱，回答时引用条款。

entries.english: Draw cloud architecture diagrams with the official AWS, Azure and GCP icons from a plain description, a JSON graph or Terraform code, with VPC, subnet and zone grouping. PNG, SVG and editable draw.io output.
entries.zh: 根据简单描述、JSON 图或 Terraform 代码，使用官方 AWS、Azure 和 GCP 图标绘制云架构图，支持 VPC、子网和可用区分组，并输出 PNG、SVG 和可编辑 draw.io 文件。

entries.english: Text language for human movement that LLMs can write, rendered as an anatomically constrained 3D human figure in the browser.
entries.zh: 供大语言模型编写的人体动作文本语言，在浏览器中渲染为符合解剖约束的 3D 人体。

entries.english: Declarative BIM / Building-as-Code engine: model buildings in YAML, compute deterministic QTO/cost estimations, compile to IFC4, and view interactive 3D WebGL models.
entries.zh: 声明式 BIM / 建筑即代码引擎：用 YAML 建模建筑、计算确定性的工程量和成本估计、编译为 IFC4，并查看交互式 3D WebGL 模型。

entries.english: Describe systems in natural language to get interactive architecture diagrams, export to frameworks like Spring Boot, FastAPI and Terraform, and detect drift.
entries.zh: 用自然语言描述系统，获取交互式架构图，导出到 Spring Boot、FastAPI、Terraform 等框架，并检测漂移。

entries.english: Generate and edit draw.io cloud architecture diagrams from prompts, Terraform or Kubernetes manifests, fix Well-Architected warnings and export to SVG.
entries.zh: 根据提示词、Terraform 或 Kubernetes 清单生成和编辑 draw.io 云架构图，修复 Well-Architected 警告并导出 SVG。

entries.english: Mix colors (including Kubelka-Munk paint physics), convert formats, generate harmonies and save named palettes, resolving hex, CSS and brand color names.
entries.zh: 混合颜色（包括 Kubelka-Munk 颜料物理模型）、转换格式、生成和谐配色并保存命名调色板，支持解析十六进制、CSS 和品牌颜色名称。

entries.english: Architectural decision tracking with testable predictions and outcome gates, stored in append-only JSONL.
entries.zh: 通过可测试的预测和结果关卡跟踪架构决策，存储在仅追加的 JSONL 中。

entries.english: Build and edit real websites from the coding agent you already pay for — no per-token AI fees. Browse the template catalogue, create and open a site, rewrite sections, add and link pages, insert blocks, keep reusable symbols in sync, screenshot any viewport, and export static HTML/CSS/JS. Drives an open Swebsy Studio tab over a local `127.0.0.1` WebSocket relay; nothing is proxied through our servers and Studio redacts secrets before anything crosses the bridge. Install via NPM: `npx -y @swebsy/mcp setup`
entries.zh: 从已付费的编码代理构建和编辑真实网站，无需按 token 支付 AI 费用。可浏览模板目录、创建和打开网站、重写章节、添加并链接页面、插入区块、同步可复用符号、截取任意视口，并导出静态 HTML/CSS/JS。通过本地 `127.0.0.1` WebSocket 中继驱动打开的 Swebsy Studio 标签页；数据不经其服务器代理，Studio 会在跨桥接前隐藏密钥。通过 NPM 安装：`npx -y @swebsy/mcp setup`

entries.english: Report the architecture rules a TypeScript repo already follows, inferred from its import graph, with the evidence for each, and check whether a change breaks them.
entries.zh: 根据 TypeScript 仓库的导入图推断其已遵循的架构规则，报告每条规则的证据，并检查更改是否破坏规则。

entries.english: Local architecture gate and CLI that diffs AI edits against git HEAD to detect new cross-layer dependencies and structural changes.
entries.zh: 本地架构关卡和 CLI，将 AI 编辑与 git HEAD 比较，检测新增跨层依赖和结构变化。

entries.english: UI/UX validation: model user journeys as state machines, find missing states, contrast and touch-target issues, and verify code against the design contract.
entries.zh: UI/UX 验证：将用户旅程建模为状态机，查找缺失状态、对比度和触摸目标问题，并依据设计契约验证代码。

entries.english: Create Mermaid diagrams in a shared workspace, with version history, comments, embedding, presentation decks and diagram linting.
entries.zh: 在共享工作区创建 Mermaid 图，支持版本历史、评论、嵌入、演示文稿和图表 lint。

entries.english: Checks an IFC building model against Türkiye's building-permit BIM regulation (Official Gazette 33331, in force Sept 2027): mandatory IFC 4.3 classes and category codes, per-class attribute and property-set requirements (all 68 annex tables, incl. the Türkiye-specific `TREpys_` sets), TUREF coordinate system, naming templates and space geometry — and fills in the regulation's 21-row Annex-9 quality-control form. Findings cite the article and annex table with GlobalIds; rows a machine cannot verify are reported as manual, never as passed. Also exports buildingSMART IDS. `uvx ifc-ruhsat mcp`; on the official registry as `io.github.BerkantACUN/ifc-ruhsat`.
entries.zh: 依据土耳其建筑许可 BIM 法规（官方公报 33331，2027 年 9 月生效）检查 IFC 建筑模型：强制 IFC 4.3 类和类别代码、每类属性及属性集要求（全部 68 张附表，包括土耳其专用 `TREpys_` 集）、TUREF 坐标系、命名模板和空间几何，并填写法规中有 21 行的附件 9 质量控制表。结果以 GlobalId 引用条文和附表；机器无法验证的行标记为人工检查，绝不标为通过。也可导出 buildingSMART IDS。`uvx ifc-ruhsat mcp`；官方注册表名称为 `io.github.BerkantACUN/ifc-ruhsat`。

entries.english: Run reproducible Nextflow bioinformatics pipelines with verifiable Workflow Run RO-Crate provenance: container digests, tool versions and checksums.
entries.zh: 运行可复现的 Nextflow 生物信息学流水线，并提供可验证的 Workflow Run RO-Crate 来源信息，包括容器摘要、工具版本和校验和。

entries.english: Search, download, track and analyze functional genomics experiments from the ENCODE Project.
entries.zh: 搜索、下载、跟踪和分析 ENCODE 项目的功能基因组学实验。

entries.english: Spatial transcriptomics analysis: cell annotation, deconvolution, spatial statistics and visualization.
entries.zh: 空间转录组分析：细胞注释、反卷积、空间统计与可视化。

entries.english: Match US medical practices with healthcare service vendors for billing, credentialing, EHR, compliance and legal.
entries.zh: 为美国医疗机构匹配处理账单、资质认证、EHR、合规和法律事务的医疗服务商。

entries.english: Run MMseqs2 homology search, ESMFold structure prediction and sequence tools on your own GPUs, with GPU-aware scheduling on shared machines, input prechecks and per-run provenance.
entries.zh: 在自己的 GPU 上运行 MMseqs2 同源搜索、ESMFold 结构预测及序列工具，在共享机器上进行 GPU 感知调度、输入预检和逐次运行来源记录。

entries.english: Local-first access to the Google Health API for Fitbit and Pixel Watch activity, sleep, heart, nutrition and reconciled health data.
entries.zh: 本地优先访问 Google Health API，获取 Fitbit 和 Pixel Watch 的活动、睡眠、心脏、营养及整合健康数据。

entries.english: Local-first continuous glucose monitor data from the Dexcom Developer API and FreeStyle Libre via LibreLink Up.
entries.zh: 通过 Dexcom Developer API 和 LibreLink Up 获取 FreeStyle Libre 数据，以本地优先方式访问连续血糖监测数据。

entries.english: Nutrition and hydration tracking: food search, barcode lookup, meal estimation, intake logs and daily summaries.
entries.zh: 营养和饮水跟踪：食物搜索、条形码查询、餐食估计、摄入记录和每日汇总。

entries.english: Real-time access to the 1000 Genomes Project dataset.
entries.zh: 实时访问 1000 Genomes Project 数据集。

entries.english: Nutrition analysis from a food photo or text description: calories, macros, vitamins, minerals, allergens and dietary flags.
entries.zh: 根据食物照片或文字描述分析营养，包括热量、宏量营养素、维生素、矿物质、过敏原及饮食标记。

entries.english: Search Evipedia's evidence-based reviews of health and longevity interventions, fetch conclusions and metadata with PMIDs, and suggest new interventions.
entries.zh: 搜索 Evipedia 基于证据的健康和长寿干预综述，获取带 PMID 的结论与元数据，并建议新的干预措施。

entries.english: Access personal health and biometric data (sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, glucose, workouts), calendar and location via the Fulcra Life API.
entries.zh: 通过 Fulcra Life API 访问个人健康和生物识别数据（睡眠阶段、心率、HRV、血糖、锻炼）、日历和位置。

entries.english: Typed FHIR tools: build, read, validate and code FHIR resources from a patient bundle, with terminology lookup and machine-readable validation reports.
entries.zh: 带类型的 FHIR 工具：从患者数据包构建、读取、验证并编码 FHIR 资源，提供术语查询和机器可读验证报告。

entries.english: Read-only biomedical literature search over a PubMed-derived corpus by natural language or PMID/DOI/PMCID, with citation and semantic graph traversal.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言或 PMID/DOI/PMCID 对源自 PubMed 的生物医学文献语料进行只读搜索，并支持引用和语义图遍历。

entries.english: Interact with the UCSC Genome Browser API to find genomes, chromosomes and more.
entries.zh: 与 UCSC Genome Browser API 交互，查找基因组、染色体等信息。

entries.english: Estimate solar vitamin D synthesis: whether it happens now, minutes needed by Fitzpatrick skin type and viable months by latitude, using Open-Meteo UV data.
entries.zh: 使用 Open-Meteo 紫外线数据估计日照维生素 D 合成：当前是否发生、不同 Fitzpatrick 肤质所需分钟数以及不同纬度的可行月份。

entries.english: Read-only FHIR access to the Practice Fusion EHR: search patients and review appointments, conditions, medications and lab results.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Practice Fusion 电子健康记录中的 FHIR 数据：搜索患者并查看预约、病症、药物和实验室结果。

entries.english: Race nutrition planning for endurance athletes: carb, sodium and fluid targets plus Lecka product recommendations by race type, conditions and weight.
entries.zh: 为耐力运动员规划比赛营养：根据比赛类型、条件和体重设定碳水化合物、钠和水分目标，并推荐 Lecka 产品。

entries.english: Healthcare billing: ICD-10, CPT and HCPCS code lookup, prior authorization prediction, claims validation, denial-risk scoring and HIPAA compliance auditing.
entries.zh: 医疗账单工具：查询 ICD-10、CPT 和 HCPCS 代码、预测事先授权、验证索赔、评估拒付风险并审计 HIPAA 合规性。

entries.english: Lets agents read raw lab-instrument files without vendor software: microscopy, mass spectrometry, chromatography, flow cytometry, NMR, electrophysiology, plate readers and qPCR. Returns metadata, images, spectra and traces as JSON, checks files for damage, and converts them to open formats (OME-TIFF, OME-Zarr, mzML, Parquet).
entries.zh: 无需厂商软件即可让代理读取原始实验仪器文件：显微镜、质谱、色谱、流式细胞术、核磁共振、电泳、酶标仪和 qPCR。以 JSON 返回元数据、图像、光谱和轨迹，检查文件损坏，并转换为开放格式（OME-TIFF、OME-Zarr、mzML、Parquet）。

entries.english: Bio-robotics engine that converts biological data from the UniProt API into Cartesian G-code coordinates.
entries.zh: 生物机器人引擎，将 UniProt API 的生物数据转换为笛卡尔 G-code 坐标。

entries.english: Academic, code and medical-regulatory trend monitoring across arXiv, PubMed, GitHub, Hugging Face and openFDA, with newspaper-style briefings.
entries.zh: 跨 arXiv、PubMed、GitHub、Hugging Face 和 openFDA 监控学术、代码及医疗监管趋势，并提供报纸式简报。

entries.english: Bridge DICOM, HL7v2 and FHIR: cross-standard mapping, Mirth Connect channel generation, vendor private tag decoding and integration patterns.
entries.zh: 桥接 DICOM、HL7v2 和 FHIR：跨标准映射、生成 Mirth Connect 通道、解码厂商私有标签和集成模式。

entries.english: Plant genomics locus lookup across Ensembl Plants, Phytozome, UniProtKB, KEGG, STRING-DB, NCBI BLAST and more, with batch and cross-source queries.
entries.zh: 跨 Ensembl Plants、Phytozome、UniProtKB、KEGG、STRING-DB、NCBI BLAST 等查询植物基因组位点，支持批量和跨来源查询。

entries.english: Health economics and outcomes research: literature search across PubMed, NICE, CADTH, ICER and more, cost-effectiveness modeling and HTA dossier preparation.
entries.zh: 卫生经济学与结局研究：跨 PubMed、NICE、CADTH、ICER 等检索文献，进行成本效益建模并准备卫生技术评估档案。

entries.english: PubMed, Europe PMC (including preprints), FDA/DailyMed and UK eMC drug labelling, and ClinicalTrials.gov for AI assistants, including side-by-side US vs UK label comparison. Every result cites its PMID, NCT ID or DOI; no API key required.
entries.zh: 为 AI 助手提供 PubMed、Europe PMC（含预印本）、FDA/DailyMed、英国 eMC 药品标签和 ClinicalTrials.gov 信息，包括美英药品标签并排比较。每项结果引用 PMID、NCT ID 或 DOI；无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Map clinical terminology to OMOP concepts using LLMs for healthcare data standardization and interoperability.
entries.zh: 使用大语言模型将临床术语映射到 OMOP 概念，以支持医疗数据标准化和互操作。

entries.english: Access a DICOMweb archive: search studies, series and instances, inspect metadata, read structured reports, extract PDF text and render frames.
entries.zh: 访问 DICOMweb 归档：搜索检查、序列和实例，查看元数据、读取结构化报告、提取 PDF 文本并渲染帧。

entries.english: Taiwan National Health Insurance (NHI) data: rejection codes, ICD-10 to procedure mappings, audit indicators and semantic search over NHI documentation.
entries.zh: 台湾全民健康保险数据：核退代码、ICD-10 与处置映射、审核指标，以及对健保文档的语义搜索。

entries.english: Clinical research tools for trial coordinators and life sciences teams: real-time access to PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov.
entries.zh: 为试验协调员和生命科学团队提供临床研究工具，实时访问 PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov。

entries.english: Search PubMed and summarize biomedical literature.
entries.zh: 搜索 PubMed 并总结生物医学文献。

entries.english: Read-only, self-hosted access to Oura Ring sleep, readiness, activity, stress and heart rate data.
entries.zh: 只读、自托管访问 Oura Ring 的睡眠、身体准备度、活动、压力和心率数据。

entries.english: Garmin Connect data in your assistant: sleep, HRV, training readiness, activities, workouts, weight and more across 193 tools. Use the free hosted connector (https://garmin.ficdev.xyz/claude) or run it locally via npm or the Claude Desktop extension.
entries.zh: 在助手中访问 Garmin Connect 数据：通过 193 个工具获取睡眠、HRV、训练准备度、活动、锻炼、体重等。可使用免费托管连接器（https://garmin.ficdev.xyz/claude），或通过 npm 或 Claude Desktop 扩展在本地运行。

entries.english: Discover EGA, ENA, ENCODE, GEO and NCBI datasets; retrieve bounded reads, variants, sequence and signal from indexed genomic files; and query versioned reference evidence.
entries.zh: 发现 EGA、ENA、ENCODE、GEO 和 NCBI 数据集；从带索引的基因组文件中获取限定范围的 reads、变异、序列和信号，并查询带版本的参考证据。

entries.english: Manage images and annotations in the Image Label annotation tool (histopathology, microscopy): bulk upload, annotation clean-up and COCO/YOLO dataset export.
entries.zh: 在 Image Label 标注工具中管理图像及标注（组织病理学、显微镜），支持批量上传、标注清理和 COCO/YOLO 数据集导出。

entries.english: Citation-grounded biomedical literature review over PubMed, Europe PMC, NCBI Gene and UniProt, with a citation-accuracy benchmark.
entries.zh: 基于引用的生物医学文献综述，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、NCBI Gene 和 UniProt，并提供引用准确性基准。

entries.english: Look up medical terminologies: ICD-11, LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC, Brazil's CID-10 (DataSUS) and optionally SNOMED CT.
entries.zh: 查询医疗术语：ICD-11、LOINC、RxNorm、MeSH、ATC、巴西 CID-10（DataSUS），以及可选的 SNOMED CT。

entries.english: Clinical audit of Glooko diabetes data from any pump or CGM: time in range, GMI, trends and bolus/basal analysis, adapting to the data your devices report.
entries.zh: 对来自任意胰岛素泵或连续血糖监测仪的 Glooko 糖尿病数据进行临床审计：目标范围内时间、GMI、趋势和餐时/基础胰岛素分析，并适配设备实际报告的数据。

entries.english: AlphaFold DB and other public biomedical sources in a local SQLite knowledge graph for structure confidence, variants, diseases, drug targets and orthology.
entries.zh: 将 AlphaFold DB 和其他公开生物医学来源纳入本地 SQLite 知识图谱，用于结构置信度、变异、疾病、药物靶点和直系同源分析。

entries.english: Query the UniProt knowledgebase (entries, features, variants, PTMs, GO terms, cross-references) with per-query SHA-256 provenance and offline replay.
entries.zh: 查询 UniProt 知识库（条目、特征、变异、翻译后修饰、GO 术语、交叉引用），每次查询附 SHA-256 来源记录并支持离线重放。

entries.english: Access and analyze exported Apple Health data.
entries.zh: 访问并分析导出的 Apple Health 数据。

entries.english: Connect to FHIR servers, for example to query patient history in natural language.
entries.zh: 连接 FHIR 服务器，例如使用自然语言查询患者病史。

entries.english: Condition-aware safety checks for ingredients, products and supplements, with cited evidence verdicts, claim fact-checking and FDA recall lookup.
entries.zh: 依据健康状况检查成分、产品和补充剂的安全性，提供带引用的证据结论、主张事实核查和 FDA 召回查询。

entries.english: FDA and NHTSA regulatory risk data: device compliance risk, 510(k) evidence, predicate chains, postmarket signals, reimbursement pathways and vehicle safety.
entries.zh: FDA 和 NHTSA 监管风险数据：设备合规风险、510(k) 证据、谓词设备链、上市后信号、报销路径和车辆安全。

entries.english: Classify the likely biological cause of 3am wakeups from symptom descriptions using The Longevity Vault's five-cause framework.
entries.zh: 使用 The Longevity Vault 的五原因框架，根据症状描述分类凌晨 3 点醒来的可能生物学原因。

entries.english: Medicare and commercial payer medical policy, prior authorization checks, claim risk and medical code lookup with cited sources, via hosted OAuth remote or local stdio.
entries.zh: 通过托管 OAuth 远程服务或本地 stdio 查询 Medicare 和商业支付方医疗政策、事先授权、索赔风险及医疗代码，并提供来源引用。

entries.english: Headless PyMOL for molecular visualization, GROMACS/LAMMPS trajectories and clathrate-hydrate cage analysis, including H-bond networks and order parameters.
entries.zh: 用于分子可视化、GROMACS/LAMMPS 轨迹及笼形水合物笼分析的无界面 PyMOL，涵盖氢键网络和序参量。

entries.english: Web scraping for AI agents: scrape, map, crawl and batch public pages into Markdown, tables and JSON, each with an Evidence Record (final URL, HTTP status, robots.txt decision, content hashes); a blocked or empty page comes back with the reason. Hosted at `https://mcp.octocrawl.dev/mcp` or local via `npx -y @octocrawl/mcp`. [Setup](https://octocrawl.dev/docs/connect-mcp/?utm_source=awesome-mcp-servers&utm_medium=listing).
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的网页抓取：抓取、映射、爬取和批量处理公共页面，输出 Markdown、表格和 JSON，每项附证据记录（最终 URL、HTTP 状态、robots.txt 决定和内容哈希）；被阻止或空页面会返回原因。可使用托管端点 `https://mcp.octocrawl.dev/mcp`，或通过 `npx -y @octocrawl/mcp` 在本地运行。[设置](https://octocrawl.dev/docs/connect-mcp/?utm_source=awesome-mcp-servers&utm_medium=listing)。

entries.english: Native Safari browser automation without a Chrome dependency.
entries.zh: 不依赖 Chrome 的原生 Safari 浏览器自动化。

entries.english: Local browser MCP for coding-agent QA with verified actions, screenshots, read-only network and console inspection, and interruption recovery warnings.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理 QA 的本地浏览器 MCP，支持已验证操作、截图、只读网络和控制台检查，以及中断恢复警告。

entries.english: Stealth automation of unmodified Chrome over raw CDP, using accessibility-tree element refs; can attach to a running Chrome to reuse logged-in sessions.
entries.zh: 通过原始 CDP 隐蔽自动化未修改的 Chrome，使用无障碍树元素引用；可连接运行中的 Chrome 复用登录会话。

entries.english: Drive a local Playwright browser through residential proxies with a chosen exit country or city and a sticky identity per task.
entries.zh: 通过住宅代理驱动本地 Playwright 浏览器，可选择出口国家或城市，并为每项任务保持固定身份。

entries.english: Browser automation using Puppeteer, supporting local and remote browser connections.
entries.zh: 使用 Puppeteer 自动化浏览器，支持连接本地和远程浏览器。

entries.english: Control your real, logged-in Chrome browser via an extension, with multiple concurrent color-coded sessions.
entries.zh: 通过扩展控制真实已登录的 Chrome 浏览器，支持多个并发且颜色区分的会话。

entries.english: Tactile browser control and multimodal visual vision MCP bridge for Google Chrome.
entries.zh: 面向 Google Chrome 的触觉浏览器控制与多模态视觉 MCP 桥接。

entries.english: Code-aware browser testing that reads routes, forms and existing tests, runs Playwright scenarios, and keeps regression history and screenshot reports.
entries.zh: 代码感知的浏览器测试：读取路由、表单和现有测试，运行 Playwright 场景，并保留回归历史和截图报告。

entries.english: Web scraper that returns clean Markdown, distributed as a single binary.
entries.zh: 以单一二进制文件分发的网页抓取器，返回整洁 Markdown。

entries.english: Visual, multimodal web scraping without CSS selectors, plus phishing and crypto drainer detection.
entries.zh: 无需 CSS 选择器的视觉多模态网页抓取，并检测钓鱼和加密资产窃取程序。

entries.english: Web scraping, Llama 3 digests and Twitter intelligence, paid per call in USDC via x402 on Base.
entries.zh: 网页抓取、Llama 3 摘要和 Twitter 情报，通过 Base 上的 x402 使用 USDC 按次付费。

entries.english: Undetected Chrome automation via nodriver for anti-bot protected sites: accessibility snapshots, input automation, network inspection and persistent sessions.
entries.zh: 使用 nodriver 对受反机器人保护的网站进行不易被检测的 Chrome 自动化，支持无障碍快照、输入自动化、网络检查和持久会话。

entries.english: Web scraping: clean content extraction, CSS-selector scraping, Playwright screenshots, link and metadata extraction, and Google search.
entries.zh: 网页抓取：提取整洁内容、使用 CSS 选择器抓取、Playwright 截图、链接和元数据提取，以及 Google 搜索。

entries.english: Browse the web with filesystem commands (ls, cd, grep, click) by mapping Chrome's accessibility tree to a virtual filesystem via an extension.
entries.zh: 通过扩展将 Chrome 无障碍树映射到虚拟文件系统，使用文件系统命令（ls、cd、grep、click）浏览网页。

entries.english: Access and organize open tabs, bookmarks and recent links across macOS browsers via the SupaSidebar app.
entries.zh: 通过 SupaSidebar 应用访问并整理 macOS 浏览器中的打开标签页、书签和近期链接。

entries.english: Connect compatible agents to an existing Chrome profile through an extension and local MCP bridge, with background task windows, pause and human takeover.
entries.zh: 通过扩展和本地 MCP 桥接，将兼容代理连接到现有 Chrome 配置文件，支持后台任务窗口、暂停和人工接管。

entries.english: Token-budgeted web fetching that routes between Trafilatura, Jina Reader, Firecrawl and pypdf by URL, with token estimates, caching and truncation.
entries.zh: 按 token 预算获取网页内容，根据 URL 在 Trafilatura、Jina Reader、Firecrawl 和 pypdf 之间路由，提供 token 估计、缓存和截断。

entries.english: One-click browser-tab screenshots, captured by a companion extension and served locally to the model on demand.
entries.zh: 一键截取浏览器标签页，由配套扩展捕获并按需在本地提供给模型。

entries.english: Fetch web content as clean Markdown through a multi-tier fallback chain, handling tweets, YouTube, arXiv, PDFs and regular pages.
entries.zh: 通过多级回退链将网页内容获取为整洁 Markdown，支持推文、YouTube、arXiv、PDF 和普通页面。

entries.english: Self-hosted stealth browser built on a Firefox fork with fingerprint spoofing, shadow-DOM-aware page reading, login state detection and evidence recording.
entries.zh: 基于 Firefox 分支的自托管隐蔽浏览器，支持指纹伪装、识别 shadow DOM 的页面读取、登录状态检测和证据记录。

entries.english: Headless browser automation and web scraping via the Browserless smart scraper API.
entries.zh: 通过 Browserless 智能抓取 API 进行无头浏览器自动化和网页抓取。

entries.english: Automate your local Chrome browser.
entries.zh: 自动化本地 Chrome 浏览器。

entries.english: Convert URLs into screenshots, PDFs or structured extracts.
entries.zh: 将 URL 转换为截图、PDF 或结构化提取结果。

entries.english: Intent-aware visual verification: declare what a UI change should affect, then diff the page against a baseline and flag changes outside that scope.
entries.zh: 意图感知的视觉验证：声明界面更改应影响的范围，然后将页面与基线比较，并标记范围外的变化。

entries.english: Rent residential Chrome browsers run by real people, with real fingerprints and residential IPs.
entries.zh: 租用由真人操作的住宅 Chrome 浏览器，使用真实指纹和住宅 IP。

entries.english: Record your authenticated browser session (rrweb DOM, console, network) to local SQLite with PII masking, so coding agents can query it or drive the browser.
entries.zh: 将已认证浏览器会话（rrweb DOM、控制台和网络）记录到本地 SQLite，并对个人身份信息脱敏，供编码代理查询或驱动浏览器。

entries.english: Generate screenshots, PDFs, OG images and narrated video recordings.
entries.zh: 生成截图、PDF、OG 图片和带旁白的视频录像。

entries.english: Control Chromium-based browsers such as Arc, Vivaldi and Brave via an extension: navigate, click, read pages, run JavaScript and record GIFs.
entries.zh: 通过扩展控制 Arc、Vivaldi、Brave 等基于 Chromium 的浏览器：导航、点击、读取页面、运行 JavaScript 和录制 GIF。

entries.english: Deterministic attack-surface perception for AI security agents. Attaches over `chrome.debugger` to the Chrome you're already logged into (cookies, MFA and SSO already done) and turns the live page into a short numbered interaction graph an agent can act on (`[03] button 'Sign In'`), with CSS selectors kept server-side and out of the model's context. Cross-identity tools (`compare_identities`, `replay`) flag a byte-identical response across two logged-in users as a cross-tenant IDOR, and `scan` maps the attack surface from the CLI. No LLM in the parse; 71% fewer tokens than Playwright's ARIA snapshot mode.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 安全代理的确定性攻击面感知。通过 `chrome.debugger` 连接已经登录的 Chrome（Cookie、MFA 和 SSO 已完成），将实时页面转为代理可操作的简短编号交互图（`[03] button 'Sign In'`）；CSS 选择器保留在服务器端，不进入模型上下文。跨身份工具（`compare_identities`、`replay`）会将两个已登录用户收到逐字节相同的响应标记为跨租户 IDOR，`scan` 可从 CLI 绘制攻击面。解析不使用大语言模型；相较 Playwright 的 ARIA 快照模式节省 71% token。

entries.english: Web search, reading and research through stealth-patched Chrome: strips hidden text, ranks passages across sources and returns SHA-256 provenance receipts.
entries.zh: 通过隐蔽补丁 Chrome 进行网页搜索、阅读和研究：移除隐藏文本、跨来源排序段落，并返回 SHA-256 来源收据。

entries.english: A browser shared by a human and an AI — same tabs, same live session; 24 MCP tools (snapshot, click, type, screenshot, tabs, annotations), built-in models or any MCP client, Esc takeover.
entries.zh: 人类与 AI 共享的浏览器——相同标签页和实时会话；提供 24 个 MCP 工具（快照、点击、输入、截图、标签页、批注），可使用内置模型或任意 MCP 客户端，按 Esc 接管。

entries.english: Control the user's Firefox browser via a companion extension.
entries.zh: 通过配套扩展控制用户的 Firefox 浏览器。

entries.english: In-page debug bridge for web apps: read the DOM, console logs and network requests and interact with the page, in any browser or Cypress/Playwright run.
entries.zh: Web 应用的页面内调试桥接：在任意浏览器或 Cypress/Playwright 运行中读取 DOM、控制台日志和网络请求，并与页面交互。

entries.english: Firecrawl web scraping: search, scrape, crawl, map and extract structured data, with live browser interaction and website change monitoring.
entries.zh: Firecrawl 网页抓取：搜索、抓取、爬取、映射和提取结构化数据，支持实时浏览器交互和网站变更监控。

entries.english: Drive your logged-in Chrome via an extension: compact element refs, visual regression, accessibility, SEO and security audits, and network mocking.
entries.zh: 通过扩展驱动已登录的 Chrome：精简元素引用、视觉回归、无障碍、SEO 和安全审计，以及网络模拟。

entries.english: Chrome extension plus MCP server that lets any MCP client drive your own signed in Chrome by reading the live DOM instead of screenshots, with no API key. 69 tools, session replay, and an encrypted credential vault.
entries.zh: Chrome 扩展与 MCP 服务器，让任意 MCP 客户端通过读取实时 DOM 而非截图来驱动自己的已登录 Chrome，无需 API 密钥。提供 69 个工具、会话重放和加密凭据库。

entries.english: Design debugging in Chrome: which CSS rule wins (with file and line), its blast radius, scoped fix selectors, live fix trials and WCAG contrast audits.
entries.zh: 在 Chrome 中调试设计：查看生效的 CSS 规则及文件和行号、影响范围、限定范围的修复选择器、实时修复试验和 WCAG 对比度审计。

entries.english: Self-hosted web scraping: scrape, extract, crawl, map, search, academic papers, research and monitoring, with a tiered fallback including Cloudflare bypass.
entries.zh: 自托管网页抓取：抓取、提取、爬取、映射、搜索、学术论文、研究和监控，并提供包含 Cloudflare 绕过的分级回退。

entries.english: Website testing with Playwright: assertions, auto form-fill, persistent logins, network mocking, and accessibility, SEO, GEO and Lighthouse audits.
entries.zh: 使用 Playwright 测试网站：断言、自动填写表单、持久登录、网络模拟，以及无障碍、SEO、GEO 和 Lighthouse 审计。

entries.english: Zen Browser automation via WebDriver BiDi: navigation, form filling, screenshots and JavaScript evaluation.
entries.zh: 通过 WebDriver BiDi 自动化 Zen Browser：导航、表单填写、截图和 JavaScript 执行。

entries.english: MCP server + Chrome extension (MV3) that lets coding agents read pages through the user's real, logged-in Chrome; stdlib-only, local.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器加 Chrome 扩展（MV3），让编码代理通过用户真实已登录的 Chrome 读取页面；仅使用标准库，在本地运行。

entries.english: Connect to the Perplexity Comet browser for agentic browsing, deep research and real-time task monitoring.
entries.zh: 连接 Perplexity Comet 浏览器，进行代理式浏览、深度研究和实时任务监控。

entries.english: Pay-per-call web scraping via x402 on Base, with structured extraction, screenshots, metadata, browser sessions and workflows.
entries.zh: 通过 Base 上的 x402 按次付费抓取网页，支持结构化提取、截图、元数据、浏览器会话和工作流。

entries.english: Drive your open, logged-in Chrome with token-budgeted page reading, complex SPA form and survey handling, and headless Ubuntu support.
entries.zh: 驱动已打开且登录的 Chrome，按 token 预算读取页面，处理复杂 SPA 表单和调查，并支持无头 Ubuntu。

entries.english: Virtual staging for real estate: stage empty rooms, turn floor plans into 3D renders, classify room images, write property descriptions and suggest styles.
entries.zh: 房地产虚拟布置：布置空房间、将平面图转为 3D 渲染图、分类房间图像、撰写房源描述并建议风格。

entries.english: Compile browser automation into deterministic plans that run in your logged-in Chrome without runtime LLM calls, detecting drift when sites change.
entries.zh: 将浏览器自动化编译为确定性计划，在已登录 Chrome 中运行时无需调用大语言模型，并在网站变化时检测漂移。

entries.english: Token-efficient browser automation: semantic page snapshots and stable element IDs instead of raw DOM or screenshots, driving Chrome over CDP.
entries.zh: token 高效的浏览器自动化：使用语义页面快照和稳定元素 ID 替代原始 DOM 或截图，通过 CDP 驱动 Chrome。

entries.english: Create, run, debug and manage Selenix browser automation tests through natural language.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言创建、运行、调试和管理 Selenix 浏览器自动化测试。

entries.english: Numbered, logged-in Chrome slots (1-30) driven over raw CDP that several Claude Code sessions and subagents share, with per-tab command queues, agent-to-agent messages, and recovery after reboots and Chrome updates.
entries.zh: 通过原始 CDP 驱动编号为 1–30 的已登录 Chrome 槽位，供多个 Claude Code 会话和子代理共享，支持逐标签页命令队列、代理间消息，以及重启和 Chrome 更新后的恢复。

entries.english: Local-first web reading escalating from HTTP to a real browser when blocked: clean Markdown, site crawls, search, row extraction and local CAPTCHA handling.
entries.zh: 本地优先的网页阅读：被阻止时从 HTTP 升级到真实浏览器，提供整洁 Markdown、网站爬取、搜索、表格行提取和本地验证码处理。

entries.english: Autonomous browser automation.
entries.zh: 自主浏览器自动化。

entries.english: Get transcripts and metadata for summarization and content analysis.
entries.zh: 获取转录文本和元数据，用于摘要及内容分析。

entries.english: Web intelligence API: screenshots, PDF generation, page metadata and specialized extractors for news, social media, search results, prices and more.
entries.zh: 网页情报 API：截图、PDF 生成、页面元数据，以及新闻、社交媒体、搜索结果、价格等专用提取器。

entries.english: Headless browser for AI and web automation with a built-in MCP server.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 和网页自动化的无头浏览器，内置 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Browser agent with human takeover via noVNC, reusable auth profiles, approval and audit controls, and isolated Docker sessions.
entries.zh: 支持通过 noVNC 人工接管的浏览器代理，提供可复用认证配置、审批和审计控制，以及隔离 Docker 会话。

entries.english: Control Safari via a web extension: navigate, read pages, click elements, fill forms and manage tabs, without Playwright or WebDriver.
entries.zh: 通过网页扩展控制 Safari：导航、读取页面、点击元素、填写表单和管理标签页，无需 Playwright 或 WebDriver。

entries.english: Read any URL as a clean AIDocument (Markdown plus structure) through Lyrenth's cached index.
entries.zh: 通过 Lyrenth 的缓存索引，将任意 URL 读取为整洁 AIDocument（Markdown 加结构）。

entries.english: Web scraping with escalating fetch tiers on detected blocks, returning clean Markdown or saving large scrapes to SQLite for read-only SQL queries.
entries.zh: 检测到阻止时逐级升级获取方式的网页抓取，返回整洁 Markdown，或将大型抓取结果保存到 SQLite 供只读 SQL 查询。

entries.english: Use the Firefox you already use, including logged-in tabs, while agents can access only tabs or tab groups you explicitly share. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zamery/browser-mcp) · [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=io.github.maemreyo%2Fzamery-browser)
entries.zh: 使用你已有的 Firefox（包括已登录标签页），同时让代理只能访问你明确分享的标签页或标签组。[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zamery/browser-mcp) · [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=io.github.maemreyo%2Fzamery-browser)

entries.english: Browser automation for your existing Chrome or Firefox via CDP and BiDi, with stealth mode, Lighthouse audits, YAML action batching and raw protocol access.
entries.zh: 通过 CDP 和 BiDi 自动化现有 Chrome 或 Firefox，支持隐蔽模式、Lighthouse 审计、YAML 操作批处理和原始协议访问。

entries.english: Playwright browser automation: interact with web pages through structured accessibility snapshots.
entries.zh: Playwright 浏览器自动化：通过结构化无障碍快照与网页交互。

entries.english: Screen-to-Action Protocol: Turn screen recordings directly into automated Playwright E2E reproduction tests, structured GitHub bug reports with video timestamps, and SOP walkthroughs.
entries.zh: Screen-to-Action Protocol：将屏幕录制直接转为自动化 Playwright 端到端复现测试、带视频时间戳的结构化 GitHub 错误报告和标准操作流程演示。

entries.english: Autonomous, goal-driven LLM web crawler with stealth browsing, distributed as a single binary.
entries.zh: 自主、目标驱动的大语言模型网页爬虫，支持隐蔽浏览，以单一二进制文件分发。

entries.english: MCP server for AgentGo, a real Chromium browser for agents: compact page outlines with stable refs, diff-only replies after each action, real pointer and keyboard input, human approval for payments, and an optional on-device model for routine steps. [AgentGo browser](https://github.com/Moha2005269/agentgo)
entries.zh: AgentGo 的 MCP 服务器：面向代理的真实 Chromium 浏览器，提供带稳定引用的精简页面大纲、每次操作后仅返回差异、真实指针和键盘输入、支付前人工批准，以及可选的本地模型处理常规步骤。[AgentGo 浏览器](https://github.com/Moha2005269/agentgo)

entries.english: Manage local Chrome profiles, each with its own cookies, sessions and proxy: create, launch and stop them, assign and check proxies, tags, notes and trash with restore. Only whitelisted profiles are visible and there is no cookie-reading tool. Requires the Morfiade desktop app (Windows).
entries.zh: 管理本地 Chrome 配置文件，每个配置拥有独立 Cookie、会话和代理：创建、启动和停止配置，分配及检查代理、标签、备注和可恢复回收站。仅显示白名单配置，且没有读取 Cookie 的工具。需要 Morfiade 桌面应用（Windows）。

entries.english: Interact with your local browsers.
entries.zh: 与本地浏览器交互。

entries.english: iOS Safari debugging via ios-webkit-debug-proxy with WebKit Inspector Protocol support: DOM, CSS, network, storage, debugger and more.
entries.zh: 通过 ios-webkit-debug-proxy 调试 iOS Safari，支持 WebKit Inspector Protocol，可检查 DOM、CSS、网络、存储、调试器等。

entries.english: Web scraping, crawling and search API: extract content as Markdown or JSON, batch-process URLs and get answers with citations.
entries.zh: 网页抓取、爬取和搜索 API：以 Markdown 或 JSON 提取内容、批量处理 URL，并提供带引用的回答。

entries.english: Control the user's real Chrome browser via an extension, reusing existing sessions, logins and cookies.
entries.zh: 通过扩展控制用户真实的 Chrome 浏览器，复用现有会话、登录状态和 Cookie。

entries.english: Security-hardened Chrome automation and logins with post-quantum encryption, a credential vault, memory scrubbing and audit logging.
entries.zh: 经过安全加固的 Chrome 自动化与登录，提供后量子加密、凭据库、内存清理和审计日志。

entries.english: Website screenshots from a local headless Chrome, with selector, text-pattern and rectangle redaction before capture; also a CLI.
entries.zh: 使用本地无头 Chrome 截取网站，可在捕获前按选择器、文本模式和矩形区域遮盖内容；也提供 CLI。

entries.english: Web automation through Selenium WebDriver.
entries.zh: 通过 Selenium WebDriver 自动化网页。

entries.english: Accessibility-tree browser automation with deterministic snapshots, human approval gates, redacted audit logs and console, network and Web Vitals monitoring.
entries.zh: 基于无障碍树的浏览器自动化，支持确定性快照、人工批准关卡、脱敏审计日志以及控制台、网络和 Web Vitals 监控。

entries.english: Lightweight native browser that runs JavaScript, follows links, fills forms, manages cookies and returns low-token BlockMaps, without Chrome.
entries.zh: 轻量级原生浏览器，无需 Chrome 即可运行 JavaScript、跟随链接、填写表单、管理 Cookie，并返回低 token 的 BlockMap。

entries.english: Real-browser QA audits of a URL: broken signup, login and checkout flows, console errors, missing analytics, security headers, tap targets and accessibility.
