entries.zh: 对 URL 进行真实浏览器 QA 审计：检查注册、登录和结账流程损坏、控制台错误、缺失分析、HTTP 安全头、触摸目标和无障碍问题。

entries.english: Record actions on any website and replay them in headless Playwright, with encrypted credentials and AI-based selector healing.
entries.zh: 记录任意网站上的操作并在无头 Playwright 中重放，支持加密凭据和基于 AI 的选择器自修复。

entries.english: Web scraping, structured data extraction and screenshots with JavaScript rendering, residential proxy rotation and automatic retries.
entries.zh: 网页抓取、结构化数据提取和截图，支持 JavaScript 渲染、住宅代理轮换和自动重试。

entries.english: Diagnostics for MCP servers: discover client configs, test connections, audit security issues and benchmark latency.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器诊断：发现客户端配置、测试连接、审计安全问题并对延迟进行基准测试。

entries.english: Render terminal output, syntax-highlighted code, web pages, Markdown, HTML and git diffs as PNG, JPEG, PDF or GIF locally via Playwright.
entries.zh: 通过 Playwright 在本地将终端输出、语法高亮代码、网页、Markdown、HTML 和 git diff 渲染为 PNG、JPEG、PDF 或 GIF。

entries.english: Compress web page HTML into compact structured maps that preserve actionable elements, so agents can read and interact with pages using fewer tokens.
entries.zh: 将网页 HTML 压缩成保留可操作元素的精简结构化映射，让代理以更少 token 阅读和操作页面。

entries.english: MCP server plus Firefox add-on that lets your agent work in your real, logged-in Firefox: accessibility snapshots with stable element refs, logins filled by alias from a local vault, hardened mode by default. Free for personal use.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器加 Firefox 扩展，让代理在真实已登录的 Firefox 中工作：提供带稳定元素引用的无障碍快照、从本地凭据库按别名填写登录信息，默认启用加固模式。个人使用免费。

entries.english: Fetch web page HTML, AI-parsed JSON or Google results through the ScrapeUnblocker anti-bot API.
entries.zh: 通过 ScrapeUnblocker 反机器人 API 获取网页 HTML、AI 解析的 JSON 或 Google 结果。

entries.english: Capture web pages as images or PDFs with element targeting, device and viewport controls, location selection, page interactions and blocking options.
entries.zh: 将网页捕获为图像或 PDF，支持元素定位、设备和视口控制、位置选择、页面交互和阻止选项。

entries.english: Browser automation, testing and bot-detection bypass using SeleniumBase CDP Mode with Chromium, including click-based CAPTCHA solving.
entries.zh: 使用 SeleniumBase CDP Mode 与 Chromium 进行浏览器自动化、测试和机器人检测绕过，包括点击式验证码处理。

entries.english: Selenium WebDriver automation with assertions and self-healing locators, plus code generation for Java, Python and C# test frameworks and CI pipelines.
entries.zh: 使用 Selenium WebDriver 自动化，支持断言和自修复定位器，并为 Java、Python、C# 测试框架及 CI 流水线生成代码。

entries.english: Chrome automation over raw CDP with multiple tabs, cached accessibility-tree refs, server-side multi-step flow execution and a Python scripting API.
entries.zh: 通过原始 CDP 自动化 Chrome，支持多标签页、缓存无障碍树引用、服务器端多步骤流程执行和 Python 脚本 API。

entries.english: Website screenshots via Chromium with full-page capture, country-specific proxies and automatic ad and cookie-banner removal.
entries.zh: 通过 Chromium 截取网站，支持整页捕获、特定国家代理，以及自动移除广告和 Cookie 横幅。

entries.english: Let coding agents drive VS Code's Integrated Browser alongside you: snapshots, mouse and keyboard, forms, tabs, screenshots, console and network logs, a visible agent cursor, and click-to-source for React (Vite, Next.js).
entries.zh: 让编码代理与你一起驱动 VS Code 的集成浏览器：支持快照、鼠标和键盘、表单、标签页、截图、控制台及网络日志、可见代理光标，以及 React（Vite、Next.js）点击定位源码。

entries.english: Capture any URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or HTML, diff page versions to catch visual regressions, and get AI page summaries.
entries.zh: 将任意 URL 捕获为 PNG、JPEG、WebP、PDF 或 HTML，比对页面版本以发现视觉回归，并获取 AI 页面摘要。

entries.english: Detect and solve Cloudflare Turnstile challenges: inspect whether a page uses Turnstile or another CAPTCHA and get a solved token when needed.
entries.zh: 检测和处理 Cloudflare Turnstile 挑战：检查页面使用 Turnstile 还是其他验证码，并在需要时获取已解决的 token。

entries.english: Save browser, HTTP API and MCP workflows as JSON, then replay CSV/XLSX batches with explicit result checks and a local journal for crash recovery.
entries.zh: 将浏览器、HTTP API 和 MCP 工作流保存为 JSON，再批量重放 CSV/XLSX，提供明确的结果检查和本地日志以支持崩溃恢复。

entries.english: Playwright MCP-compatible browser automation using CloakBrowser Chromium.
entries.zh: 使用 CloakBrowser Chromium 的兼容 Playwright MCP 的浏览器自动化。

entries.english: Visible local browser automation in your signed-in Chromium profile, with recovery and optional policy and audit controls.
entries.zh: 在你已登录的 Chromium 配置中进行可见的本地浏览器自动化，支持恢复和可选的策略与审计控制。

entries.english: Give coding agents real eyes: one tool call returns a screenshot PNG plus the accessibility tree and page text; segment_height paginates long pages into readable tiles.
entries.zh: 给编码代理真正的“眼睛”：一次工具调用返回 PNG 截图、无障碍树和页面文本；segment_height 将长页面分页为可读区块。

entries.english: Self-hosted stealth Chrome automation via Patchright: parallel persistent profiles, encrypted credential vault with 2FA, and prompt-injection scanning.
entries.zh: 通过 Patchright 自托管隐蔽 Chrome 自动化：并行持久配置、支持双因素认证的加密凭据库，以及提示词注入扫描。

entries.english: Capture websites as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF with device emulation, dark mode, ad blocking and cookie banner removal.
entries.zh: 将网站捕获为 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 PDF，支持设备模拟、深色模式、广告拦截和移除 Cookie 横幅。

entries.english: Render any URL or raw HTML as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with batch processing, geo-targeting and async webhooks.
entries.zh: 将任意 URL 或原始 HTML 渲染为 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 PDF，支持批处理、地理定位和异步 webhook。

entries.english: Drive a browser or Expo/React Native app alongside your dev server on one correlated timeline, lining up frontend errors with backend stack traces.
entries.zh: 将浏览器或 Expo/React Native 应用与开发服务器放在一条关联时间线上驱动，把前端错误与后端堆栈跟踪对应起来。

entries.english: Browser and mobile app automation with WebdriverIO: control browsers and automate native Android and iOS apps via WebDriver and Appium.
entries.zh: 使用 WebdriverIO 自动化浏览器和移动应用：通过 WebDriver 与 Appium 控制浏览器并自动化原生 Android 和 iOS 应用。

entries.english: Fetch trending videos from Bilibili.
entries.zh: 获取 Bilibili 热门视频。

entries.english: Chromium-free agent browser with built-in V8: tiered fetching, multi-engine search, screenshots, persistent login sessions and CDP access.
entries.zh: 不依赖 Chromium、内置 V8 的代理浏览器：分级获取、多引擎搜索、截图、持久登录会话和 CDP 访问。

entries.english: Fetch content from login-protected pages such as Notion, Google Docs, Jira and Confluence via a real browser login with persistent session caching.
entries.zh: 通过真实浏览器登录和持久会话缓存，获取 Notion、Google Docs、Jira 和 Confluence 等受登录保护页面的内容。

entries.english: Real-time data from GitHub, Hacker News, Scholar, arXiv, YC, jobs, finance and package trends, with every result timestamped for freshness.
entries.zh: 实时获取 GitHub、Hacker News、Scholar、arXiv、YC、职位、金融和软件包趋势数据，每项结果均带时间戳以反映新鲜度。

entries.english: Read Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu and any web page through your own logged-in Chrome; returns titles, captions, stats and media links as JSON.
entries.zh: 通过自己已登录的 Chrome 阅读 Bilibili、抖音、小红书及任意网页，以 JSON 返回标题、字幕、统计和媒体链接。

entries.english: Browser navigation and verification: compact semantic page digests, ranked text search, and typed diffs after each action with assertions.
entries.zh: 浏览器导航与验证：提供精简语义页面摘要、排序文本搜索，以及每次操作后带断言的类型化差异。

entries.english: Glint Render web rendering and evidence API: screenshots, PDFs, OG images, monitoring, extraction and tamper-evident evidence capture.
entries.zh: Glint Render 网页渲染与证据 API：截图、PDF、OG 图片、监控、提取和防篡改证据捕获。

entries.english: Identify CAPTCHA types and parameters, create solving tasks and retrieve results via the CapMonster Cloud API, with access to its docs.
entries.zh: 通过 CapMonster Cloud API 识别验证码类型和参数、创建求解任务并获取结果，同时可访问其文档。

entries.english: Governed Ceph storage operations via the ceph-mgr Dashboard REST API — HEALTH_WARN root-cause analysis, OSD/PG/pool/RBD/CephFS/RGW, recovery, and capacity (37 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 通过 ceph-mgr Dashboard REST API 受治理地操作 Ceph 存储：HEALTH_WARN 根因分析、OSD/PG/池/RBD/CephFS/RGW、恢复和容量（37 个工具），并提供不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护、试运行和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Keycloak multi-realm admin (users, clients, roles, groups) — safe-by-default access modes, realm allowlists, protected realms, delete gating, dry-run, and audit logging. `npx -y @dockndevai/mcp-keycloak`
entries.zh: Keycloak 多 realm 管理（用户、客户端、角色、组），提供默认安全的访问模式、realm 白名单、受保护 realm、删除关卡、试运行和审计日志。`npx -y @dockndevai/mcp-keycloak`

entries.english: Multi-cluster Kubernetes monitoring and operations with safe access modes, namespace allowlists, gated delete/apply/exec, dry-run and audit logging.
entries.zh: 多集群 Kubernetes 监控和操作，提供安全访问模式、命名空间白名单、受控删除/apply/exec、试运行和审计日志。

entries.english: Governed Docker + Portainer container-host operations (non-Kubernetes) — restart-loop and resource-pressure RCA, image/volume bloat, and guardrailed lifecycle writes (38 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 Docker 和 Portainer 容器主机（非 Kubernetes）：分析重启循环、资源压力以及镜像/卷膨胀根因，并提供带防护的生命周期写入（38 个工具）、不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护、试运行和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Governed Kubernetes operations for k3s, EKS, GKE and AKS: workloads, jobs, config, storage, networking and rollouts, with audit logging, dry-run and rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 k3s、EKS、GKE 和 AKS Kubernetes，包括工作负载、作业、配置、存储、网络和发布，提供审计日志、试运行和回滚。

entries.english: Read-only Oracle Cloud (OCI) resource discovery, dependency mapping and reproducible Terraform generation, with secret redaction.
entries.zh: 只读发现 Oracle Cloud（OCI）资源、映射依赖并生成可复现 Terraform，同时对密钥脱敏。

entries.english: Azure Resource Manager inventory, tags and VM lifecycle management, with resource-group allowlists, delete gating and typed confirmation.
entries.zh: Azure Resource Manager 资源清单、标签和虚拟机生命周期管理，支持资源组白名单、删除关卡和类型化确认。

entries.english: OpenShift and Kubernetes operations on pods, deployments, routes and builds, with access modes, namespace allowlists, dry-run and Secret redaction.
entries.zh: 对 OpenShift 和 Kubernetes 的 pod、部署、路由及构建进行操作，支持访问模式、命名空间白名单、试运行和 Secret 脱敏。

entries.english: Deploy and manage SnapDeploy apps (Docker containers on AWS) from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Gemini CLI: builds, logs, env vars, add-ons, domains
entries.zh: 通过 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 或 Gemini CLI 部署和管理 SnapDeploy 应用（AWS 上的 Docker 容器），包括构建、日志、环境变量、附加组件和域名。

entries.english: Manage Adios workspaces, previews, builds, logs, services and production deployments.
entries.zh: 管理 Adios 工作区、预览、构建、日志、服务和生产部署。

entries.english: Governed MinIO object-storage operations — capacity, exposure-surface audit, lifecycle, and healing RCA, plus guardrailed bucket writes (48 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 MinIO 对象存储：容量、暴露面审计、生命周期和修复根因分析，以及带防护的存储桶写入（48 个工具）、不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护、试运行和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Governed Nutanix Prism Central operations: clusters, VMs, storage, networking, snapshots/DR, alerts and LCM, with audit logging, dry-run and rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 Nutanix Prism Central，包括集群、虚拟机、存储、网络、快照/灾备、告警和生命周期管理，支持审计日志、试运行和回滚。

entries.english: Manage BasicDeploy containers, each with PostgreSQL, S3-compatible storage and a public URL: deploy apps, run commands, read logs and toggle always-on.
entries.zh: 管理 BasicDeploy 容器，每个容器均带 PostgreSQL、兼容 S3 的存储和公开 URL：部署应用、运行命令、读取日志并切换常开状态。

entries.english: Governed multi-vendor network device operations via NAPALM (Cisco IOS/NX-OS/IOS-XR, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos) plus NetBox — config management and read-only queries (33 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget guards, and rollback.
entries.zh: 通过 NAPALM（Cisco IOS/NX-OS/IOS-XR、Arista EOS、Juniper Junos）和 NetBox 受治理地操作多厂商网络设备：配置管理和只读查询（33 个工具），提供不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算保护和回滚。

entries.english: Manage Adobe Edge Delivery Services (AEM EDS): preview, publish, bulk operations, content, Core Web Vitals, 404 tracking, A/B experiments and redirects.
entries.zh: 管理 Adobe Edge Delivery Services（AEM EDS）：预览、发布、批量操作、内容、Core Web Vitals、404 跟踪、A/B 实验和重定向。

entries.english: AWS SSO integration: log in, list accounts and roles, and run AWS CLI commands with temporary credentials.
entries.zh: AWS SSO 集成：登录、列出账号和角色，并使用临时凭据运行 AWS CLI 命令。

entries.english: Governed Proxmox VE operations — VM/LXC lifecycle, snapshots, cluster, storage, backup, and HA (43 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 Proxmox VE：虚拟机/LXC 生命周期、快照、集群、存储、备份和高可用（43 个工具），提供不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护、试运行和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Provision, SSH into, run commands on and manage Linux VPSes, paying with USDC over x402 or by card.
entries.zh: 配置、通过 SSH 连接、运行命令并管理 Linux VPS，通过 x402 使用 USDC 或银行卡支付。

entries.english: Build and run a backend on the Anythink platform: relational data with row-level security, search, RBAC, workflows, growth and retention tools, and payments.
entries.zh: 在 Anythink 平台构建和运行后端：带行级安全的关系数据、搜索、RBAC、工作流、增长与留存工具，以及支付。

entries.english: Governed reverse-proxy operations (Traefik + Caddy + HAProxy) — backend-health, certificate-expiry, 5xx, and route-conflict RCA (28 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作反向代理（Traefik、Caddy、HAProxy）：分析后端健康、证书过期、5xx 和路由冲突的根因（28 个工具），提供不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Unified deployment dashboard for Vercel, Render, Railway and Fly.io: deploy status, logs, environment variables, rollbacks and health checks.
entries.zh: 面向 Vercel、Render、Railway 和 Fly.io 的统一部署仪表盘：部署状态、日志、环境变量、回滚和健康检查。

entries.english: Governed TrueNAS SCALE operations — pools, datasets, snapshots, disks, alerts, and services (25 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 TrueNAS SCALE：池、数据集、快照、磁盘、告警和服务（25 个工具），提供不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护、试运行和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Manage Spot.io (Spotinst) Ocean clusters, VNGs, Elastigroups, costs, right-sizing and logs across AWS and Azure accounts.
entries.zh: 跨 AWS 和 Azure 账号管理 Spot.io（Spotinst）Ocean 集群、VNG、Elastigroup、成本、规格优化和日志。

entries.english: Manage pfSense firewalls: rules, DHCP leases, DNS overrides, gateway monitoring, ARP table and services, with two-step confirmation for destructive actions.
entries.zh: 管理 pfSense 防火墙：规则、DHCP 租约、DNS 覆盖、网关监控、ARP 表和服务，破坏性操作需要两步确认。

entries.english: Manage Proxmox VE clusters: VMs, containers, snapshots, templates, cloud-init, firewall and migrations, with two-step confirmation for destructive actions.
entries.zh: 管理 Proxmox VE 集群：虚拟机、容器、快照、模板、cloud-init、防火墙和迁移，破坏性操作需要两步确认。

entries.english: Azure cost management: spending analysis, forecasts, anomaly detection, budgets, optimization tips, idle resource detection and tag-based cost allocation.
entries.zh: Azure 成本管理：支出分析、预测、异常检测、预算、优化建议、空闲资源检测和基于标签的成本分配。

entries.english: Compare compute, storage, managed Postgres, egress and GPU prices across AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI, plus FinOps tools for break-even, TCO and migration analysis.
entries.zh: 比较 AWS、Azure、GCP 和 OCI 的计算、存储、托管 Postgres、出站流量和 GPU 价格，并提供盈亏平衡、总拥有成本和迁移分析等 FinOps 工具。

entries.english: Undoable SFTP deploys to shared hosting (cPanel, Plesk, any SFTP host): backs up every file it replaces on the server, restores with one call and refuses if a live file was edited since; deploy and restore only run a previewed plan, with no delete or skip-backup tools.
entries.zh: 通过 SFTP 将可撤销的部署发布到共享主机（cPanel、Plesk 或任意 SFTP 主机）：备份服务器上被替换的每个文件、一次调用恢复，并在实时文件此后被编辑时拒绝恢复；部署和恢复仅执行已预览的计划，没有删除或跳过备份工具。

entries.english: Manage MikroTik RouterOS devices: interfaces, firewall, DHCP, DNS, routes, WireGuard, WiFi, BGP/OSPF and VLANs, with dry-run previews, RBAC and rollback.
entries.zh: 管理 MikroTik RouterOS 设备：接口、防火墙、DHCP、DNS、路由、WireGuard、WiFi、BGP/OSPF 和 VLAN，支持试运行预览、RBAC 和回滚。

entries.english: Find, quote, rent and stop GPUs on AmpleRun, paid from a USDC or USDT balance on Base. Read-only unless you allow spending; every rental has a hard budget cap.
entries.zh: 在 AmpleRun 上查找、询价、租用和停止 GPU，使用 Base 上的 USDC 或 USDT 余额支付。除非允许支出否则只读；每次租用均有硬性预算上限。

entries.english: Suite of servers for integrating with AWS services and resources.
entries.zh: 用于集成 AWS 服务和资源的一组服务器。

entries.english: Manage Backblaze B2 buckets, files, keys, Object Lock and S3-compatible storage.
entries.zh: 管理 Backblaze B2 存储桶、文件、密钥、Object Lock 和兼容 S3 的存储。

entries.english: Manage BlazingCDN zones, cache purge and warm-up, traffic metrics, custom domains, cloud storage and Video CDN; read-only by default.
entries.zh: 管理 BlazingCDN 区域、缓存清除与预热、流量指标、自定义域名、云存储和 Video CDN；默认只读。

entries.english: Local-first, read-only FinOps assistant: analyze AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, SaaS and AI bills, find waste and get fixes as pull requests.
entries.zh: 本地优先、只读的 FinOps 助手：分析 AWS、Azure、GCP、Kubernetes、SaaS 和 AI 账单，发现浪费并以 pull request 形式获取修复。

entries.english: Access the entire OVH API through search and execute tools that run sandboxed JavaScript (Code Mode).
entries.zh: 通过运行沙箱 JavaScript（Code Mode）的搜索和执行工具访问整个 OVH API。

entries.english: Manage Kubernetes resources through the Cyclops abstraction.
entries.zh: 通过 Cyclops 抽象管理 Kubernetes 资源。

entries.english: Publish pages written in chat or a local folder to a live HTTPS URL, with static hosting on Cloudflare's edge.
entries.zh: 将聊天中或本地文件夹内的页面发布到公开 HTTPS URL，由 Cloudflare 边缘提供静态托管。

entries.english: Kubernetes operations via kubectl and helm through natural language, integrated with Open WebUI.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言使用 kubectl 和 helm 操作 Kubernetes，并集成 Open WebUI。

entries.english: Azure Data Lake Storage: manage containers and file metadata, and read, write, upload and download files.
entries.zh: Azure Data Lake Storage：管理容器和文件元数据，读取、写入、上传及下载文件。

entries.english: Manage and control ESP RainMaker devices.
entries.zh: 管理和控制 ESP RainMaker 设备。

entries.english: Manage Nginx Proxy Manager proxy hosts, redirections, streams, Let's Encrypt certificates, and access lists with dry-run previews and a one-shot HTTPS host workflow.
entries.zh: 管理 Nginx Proxy Manager 的代理主机、重定向、流、Let's Encrypt 证书和访问列表，提供试运行预览及一次性 HTTPS 主机工作流。

entries.english: Docker container management: health checks, auto-restart, Compose lifecycle and log streaming.
entries.zh: Docker 容器管理：健康检查、自动重启、Compose 生命周期和日志流。

entries.english: Manage self-hosted Coolify PaaS: deployments with verified builds, app diagnostics, database backups, offline docs search and confirmed destructive actions.
entries.zh: 管理自托管 Coolify PaaS：经验证构建的部署、应用诊断、数据库备份、离线文档搜索和需确认的破坏性操作。

entries.english: Deploy and run apps on gagarin.cloud from your agent: services, Postgres, Qdrant, Valkey and S3 buckets, domains, logs, alerts, rollback and project memory, with deletions waiting for email approval. Remote server with OAuth sign-in.
entries.zh: 从代理在 gagarin.cloud 上部署和运行应用：管理服务、Postgres、Qdrant、Valkey、S3 存储桶、域名、日志、告警、回滚和项目记忆；删除需等待邮件批准。远程服务器使用 OAuth 登录。

entries.english: Access Cloudeval project context and reports for cloud evaluations of Azure and AWS CloudFormation, with a read-only toolset.
entries.zh: 访问 Cloudeval 项目上下文和报告，以只读工具评估 Azure 和 AWS CloudFormation 云环境。

entries.english: CNCF release intelligence: security fixes, breaking changes and deprecations from graduated and incubating project release notes, with local version checks.
entries.zh: CNCF 发行版情报：从毕业及孵化项目的发行说明中提取安全修复、破坏性更改和弃用，并在本地检查版本。

entries.english: Manage Spinnaker applications, pipelines, executions and cloud infrastructure via the Gate API.
entries.zh: 通过 Gate API 管理 Spinnaker 应用、流水线、执行和云基础设施。

entries.english: Self-hosted, MCP-native deployment platform (AppCrane): AI agents deploy apps, manage secrets, read logs, and roll back on your own server. Enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC/SCIM) and per-user audit.
entries.zh: 自托管的 MCP 原生部署平台 AppCrane：AI 代理在自己的服务器上部署应用、管理密钥、读取日志并回滚，提供企业 SSO（SAML/OIDC/SCIM）和按用户审计。

entries.english: Query, analyze and monitor Azure resources at scale using Azure Resource Graph.
entries.zh: 使用 Azure Resource Graph 大规模查询、分析和监控 Azure 资源。

entries.english: Terraform ecosystem integration: provider discovery, module analysis and Terraform Registry API access for infrastructure-as-code workflows.
entries.zh: Terraform 生态集成：为基础设施即代码工作流提供服务商发现、模块分析和 Terraform Registry API 访问。

entries.english: Manage Cloudflare DNS, zones, Workers, KV, R2, D1, Pages, WAF, SSL, Email Routing and more via the REST API, with human approval for every change.
entries.zh: 通过 REST API 管理 Cloudflare DNS、区域、Workers、KV、R2、D1、Pages、WAF、SSL、Email Routing 等，每次更改均需人工批准。

entries.english: Control Easypanel deployments, services, environment variables, logs, domains, databases and monitoring, with confirmation for destructive actions.
entries.zh: 控制 Easypanel 部署、服务、环境变量、日志、域名、数据库和监控，破坏性操作需要确认。

entries.english: Hostodo VPS management: VM details, power control, renaming, OS reinstalls, guest-agent commands and artifact uploads, with scoped tokens and audit logs.
entries.zh: Hostodo VPS 管理：虚拟机详情、电源控制、重命名、重装操作系统、客户机代理命令和上传产物，支持限定范围的 token 和审计日志。

entries.english: Agentic hosting service for static sites and files. Publish sites, PDFs, images, video, or ZIP archives to a public URL directly from Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client. Custom domains, password protection, free tier, EU data residency option.
entries.zh: 面向静态网站和文件的代理式托管服务，可直接从 Cursor、Claude 或任意 MCP 客户端将网站、PDF、图像、视频或 ZIP 归档发布到公开 URL，支持自定义域名、密码保护、免费套餐和欧盟数据驻留选项。

entries.english: Publish HTML, Markdown, CSV or Mermaid artifacts to temp.md under a stable public link that updates in place, with activity-based expiry.
entries.zh: 将 HTML、Markdown、CSV 或 Mermaid 产物发布到 temp.md，生成可原位更新的稳定公开链接，并根据活动情况过期。

entries.english: Manage the Marzban proxy/VPN panel: users, subscriptions, nodes, hosts, config and system stats, with confirmation for destructive calls.
entries.zh: 管理 Marzban 代理/VPN 面板：用户、订阅、节点、主机、配置和系统统计，破坏性调用需要确认。

entries.english: Privacy-first, no-KYC offshore hosting an AI agent can run end to end: self-onboard an anonymous account (no e-mail), fund it in Bitcoin/Monero, deploy apps to managed VPSes with reviewed cold failover to another country, and manage domains/DNS + VPS lifecycle. Remote OAuth or `npx -y impreza-mcp`.
entries.zh: 注重隐私、无需 KYC 的离岸托管服务，AI 代理可端到端操作：自主创建匿名账号（无需电子邮件）、以 Bitcoin/Monero 充值、在托管 VPS 上部署应用并通过经审核的冷故障转移切换到另一国家，以及管理域名/DNS 和 VPS 生命周期。支持远程 OAuth 或 `npx -y impreza-mcp`。

entries.english: Azure FinOps cost optimization: idle resources, rightsizing and Reserved Instance recommendations.
entries.zh: Azure FinOps 成本优化：检测闲置资源、推荐合适规格和预留实例。

entries.english: Inspect and manage IONOS Cloud infrastructure.
entries.zh: 检查和管理 IONOS Cloud 基础设施。

entries.english: Compare real-time cloud instance prices across AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI, with workload calculators and migration savings estimates.
entries.zh: 比较 AWS、Azure、GCP 和 OCI 的实时云实例价格，并提供工作负载计算器和迁移节省估算。

entries.english: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure price data with cost calculators and cross-provider comparisons.
entries.zh: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 价格数据，提供成本计算器和跨服务商比较。

entries.english: Manage Proxmox VE, Backup Server, Mail Gateway and Datacenter Manager with dry-run plans, snapshots and a tamper-evident audit log; read-only by default.
entries.zh: 管理 Proxmox VE、Backup Server、Mail Gateway 和 Datacenter Manager，支持试运行计划、快照及防篡改审计日志；默认只读。

entries.english: Read-only kubectl with structured JSON output, hardcoded safe verbs, withheld Secret and ConfigMap values, and one-shot cluster triage and inventory.
entries.zh: 只读 kubectl，提供结构化 JSON 输出、硬编码安全动词、不暴露 Secret 和 ConfigMap 值，并支持一次性集群诊断与资源盘点。

entries.english: Provision and manage Krova Cloud Cubes (Firecracker microVMs with root access), plus custom domains, TCP port mappings and snapshots.
entries.zh: 配置和管理 Krova Cloud Cube（具有 root 权限的 Firecracker 微型虚拟机），以及自定义域名、TCP 端口映射和快照。

entries.english: Deploy AI-generated HTML, CSS and JavaScript to a public HTTPS URL.
entries.zh: 将 AI 生成的 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 部署到公开 HTTPS URL。

entries.english: Manage local or remote Docker daemons: containers, images, Compose, Swarm, Buildx, Scout and OCI registries, with read-only hosts for safe monitoring.
entries.zh: 管理本地或远程 Docker 守护进程：容器、镜像、Compose、Swarm、Buildx、Scout 和 OCI 注册表，并可使用只读主机进行安全监控。

entries.english: Manage the software licensing lifecycle in Labs64 NetLicensing through natural language.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言管理 Labs64 NetLicensing 软件许可生命周期。

entries.english: Manage Dynadot domains, DNS, WHOIS, nameservers, transfers and aftermarket listings.
entries.zh: 管理 Dynadot 域名、DNS、WHOIS、域名服务器、转移和二级市场条目。

entries.english: Create, modify and delete Liveblocks rooms, threads, comments, notifications and more, with read access to Storage and Yjs.
entries.zh: 创建、修改和删除 Liveblocks 房间、主题、评论、通知等，并只读访问 Storage 和 Yjs。

entries.english: Deploy services on Lizard with managed Postgres, Redis and S3, logs and metrics, secrets, scaling and custom domains.
entries.zh: 在 Lizard 上部署服务，使用托管 Postgres、Redis 和 S3，以及日志、指标、密钥、扩缩容和自定义域名。

entries.english: Manage LocalStack local AWS environments: lifecycle operations, infrastructure deployments, log analysis, fault injection and state management.
entries.zh: 管理 LocalStack 本地 AWS 环境：生命周期操作、基础设施部署、日志分析、故障注入和状态管理。

entries.english: LUNO hosted backend platform: CMS, forms, auth and storage. Unrelated to the Luno cryptocurrency exchange.
entries.zh: LUNO 托管后端平台：CMS、表单、认证和存储。与 Luno 加密货币交易所无关。

entries.english: Cloudflare API v4 server: 28 tools across zones, DNS, WAF/firewall, rate limits, HTTP request logs, Security Center insights, and threat intelligence (IP/domain/ASN/WHOIS/passive DNS). Currently read-only. Install with `go run github.com/M-Yamashita01/cloudflare-mcp-go@latest`.
entries.zh: Cloudflare API v4 服务器：28 个工具覆盖区域、DNS、WAF/防火墙、速率限制、HTTP 请求日志、安全中心洞察和威胁情报（IP/域名/ASN/WHOIS/被动 DNS）。目前只读。使用 `go run github.com/M-Yamashita01/cloudflare-mcp-go@latest` 安装。

entries.english: Dynadot domain registrar API: domain search, registration, DNS, contacts, transfers and marketplace.
entries.zh: Dynadot 域名注册商 API：域名搜索、注册、DNS、联系人、转移和市场。

entries.english: Unofficial Infomaniak integration: web hosting, mail, kDrive, domains, DNS, FTP/SSH users and more, with two-phase commits and undo for destructive actions.
entries.zh: 非官方 Infomaniak 集成：网页托管、邮件、kDrive、域名、DNS、FTP/SSH 用户等，对破坏性操作提供两阶段提交和撤销。

entries.english: Manage Hetzner DNS zones and records via the Hetzner Cloud API: RRSet CRUD, zonefile import/export, TTL and protection changes, and nameservers.
entries.zh: 通过 Hetzner Cloud API 管理 Hetzner DNS 区域和记录：RRSet 增删改查、区域文件导入/导出、TTL 和保护更改以及域名服务器。

entries.english: Microsoft Graph access to Outlook mail and calendar, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, OneNote, Planner and Entra ID.
entries.zh: 通过 Microsoft Graph 访问 Outlook 邮件和日历、Teams、OneDrive、SharePoint、OneNote、Planner 和 Entra ID。

entries.english: Create, check, deploy and host static sites.
entries.zh: 创建、检查、部署和托管静态网站。

entries.english: Administer a self-hosted wg-easy (WireGuard Easy) instance: manage VPN clients, fetch configs and QR codes, create one-time links and check server status.
entries.zh: 管理自托管 wg-easy（WireGuard Easy）实例：管理 VPN 客户端、获取配置和二维码、创建一次性链接并检查服务器状态。

entries.english: Official Porkbun server: domain availability and pricing, registration and renewals, DNS records, nameservers, DNSSEC, URL forwarding, DNS restore points, static hosting deploys and Cloudflare-connected domains. Also hosted at https://mcp.porkbun.com/mcp with Porkbun sign-in.
entries.zh: 官方 Porkbun 服务器：域名可用性与价格、注册和续费、DNS 记录、域名服务器、DNSSEC、URL 转发、DNS 恢复点、静态托管部署和连接 Cloudflare 的域名。也在 https://mcp.porkbun.com/mcp 提供托管服务，需使用 Porkbun 登录。

entries.english: App hosting for agents: deploy to a live URL, verify, view logs, inspect, roll back and delete, with human approval for production.
entries.zh: 面向代理的应用托管：部署到实时 URL、验证、查看日志、检查、回滚和删除，生产环境操作需要人工批准。

entries.english: OpenStack cloud infrastructure management based on openstacksdk.
entries.zh: 基于 openstacksdk 的 OpenStack 云基础设施管理。

entries.english: Manage Cloudflare Workers, KV, R2, Pages, DNS and cache.
entries.zh: 管理 Cloudflare Workers、KV、R2、Pages、DNS 和缓存。

entries.english: AWS S3 operations: list buckets, browse objects, upload and download files, and generate presigned URLs.
entries.zh: AWS S3 操作：列出存储桶、浏览对象、上传和下载文件，以及生成预签名 URL。

entries.english: Read-only FinOps reference library for agents: six tools that list, filter by FinOps Framework facet, and fetch guides on cloud billing mechanics, commitments, allocation and chargeback for AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Kubernetes and data platforms, plus named waste-pattern playbooks with detection queries. Includes AI inference spend (managed APIs, provisioned capacity, self-hosted models, coding-tool seats). Content is bundled in the package; no cloud credentials. CC BY-SA 4.0. `uvx cloud-finops-mcp`
entries.zh: 供代理使用的只读 FinOps 参考库：6 个工具可列出、按 FinOps Framework 维度过滤并获取关于 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI、Kubernetes 和数据平台的云账单机制、承诺、分配和费用回收指南，还提供具名浪费模式操作手册及检测查询。包括 AI 推理支出（托管 API、预配容量、自托管模型、编码工具席位）。内容随包提供，无需云凭据。CC BY-SA 4.0。`uvx cloud-finops-mcp`

entries.english: Manage and troubleshoot cert-manager.
entries.zh: 管理和排查 cert-manager。

entries.english: Publish HTML written in chat or local files and folders to a public URL, preserving folder structure.
entries.zh: 将聊天中编写的 HTML 或本地文件与文件夹发布到公开 URL，并保留文件夹结构。

entries.english: Rent and operate VPSes paid in USDC or USDT: register, provision and control power, hostname, root password, reinstalls, metrics and cancellation.
entries.zh: 使用 USDC 或 USDT 租用和操作 VPS：注册、配置和控制电源、主机名、root 密码、重装、指标及取消。

entries.english: Interact with Portainer instances: container management, deployment operations and infrastructure monitoring.
entries.zh: 与 Portainer 实例交互，进行容器管理、部署操作和基础设施监控。

entries.english: Track LLM token costs across Claude, GPT and Gemini, with optimization hints and savings estimates.
entries.zh: 跟踪 Claude、GPT 和 Gemini 的 LLM token 成本，提供优化建议和节省估算。

entries.english: Portkey Admin API control plane: prompts, configs, keys, analytics, guardrails, integrations and deployments.
entries.zh: Portkey Admin API 控制平面：提示词、配置、密钥、分析、防护规则、集成和部署。

entries.english: Publish AI-generated HTML or static files to a shareable URL, with optional permanent hosting, in-place updates and password or members-only access.
entries.zh: 将 AI 生成的 HTML 或静态文件发布为可分享 URL，可选永久托管、原位更新、密码保护或仅成员访问。

entries.english: Integration with the PythonAnywhere cloud platform.
entries.zh: 集成 PythonAnywhere 云平台。

entries.english: Safe, auditable, inventory-driven access to Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Proxmox, Grafana and Cisco infrastructure through named read-only-by-default tools, without giving agents raw SSH access.
entries.zh: 通过具名工具安全、可审计且基于清单地访问 Linux、Docker、Kubernetes、Proxmox、Grafana 和 Cisco 基础设施；默认只读，不向代理提供原始 SSH 访问。

entries.english: Terraform operations with two-step confirmation for plan/apply/destroy, plan risk and cost analysis, drift detection, import/taint/refresh and audit logging.
entries.zh: Terraform 操作：plan/apply/destroy 需要两步确认，并支持计划风险与成本分析、漂移检测、import/taint/refresh 和审计日志。

entries.english: Manage Redis Cloud resources in natural language: create databases, monitor subscriptions and configure cloud deployments.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言管理 Redis Cloud 资源：创建数据库、监控订阅并配置云部署。

entries.english: Interact with Kubernetes clusters: API resource discovery, resource management, pod logs, metrics and events.
entries.zh: 与 Kubernetes 集群交互：API 资源发现、资源管理、pod 日志、指标和事件。

entries.english: Interact with Kubernetes clusters through natural language.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言与 Kubernetes 集群交互。

entries.english: Self-hosted server suite for Odoo ERP 15-19, plus GitHub, Portainer, OCA and Teams, with a browser terminal, Qdrant/Ollama memory and Bulgarian localization.
entries.zh: 面向 Odoo ERP 15–19 的自托管服务器套件，另支持 GitHub、Portainer、OCA 和 Teams，提供浏览器终端、Qdrant/Ollama 记忆和保加利亚语本地化。

entries.english: Control a Portveil WireGuard VPN account: list devices with their live speed, and move, rotate, reconnect or disconnect agent machines between exit countries. Moves only count once the exit server confirms the device.
entries.zh: 控制 Portveil WireGuard VPN 账号：列出设备及实时速度，在出口国家之间移动、轮换、重新连接或断开代理机器。只有出口服务器确认设备后才算移动完成。

entries.english: Manage Sevalla cloud infrastructure.
entries.zh: 管理 Sevalla 云基础设施。

entries.english: Deploy static HTML folders to permanent Vibie URLs, with folder markers for easy redeploys.
entries.zh: 将静态 HTML 文件夹部署到永久 Vibie URL，使用文件夹标记方便重新部署。

entries.english: Deploy and manage static sites: upload files, get a URL and connect custom domains.
entries.zh: 部署和管理静态网站：上传文件、获取 URL 并连接自定义域名。

entries.english: Cloud infrastructure analysis: detect IaC drift, missing indexes, security gaps and performance anti-patterns across AWS services and databases.
entries.zh: 云基础设施分析：检测 AWS 服务和数据库中的 IaC 漂移、缺失索引、安全缺口和性能反模式。

entries.english: Deploy live HTTPS websites on subdomains or custom .xyz domains, paid in USDC on Base, with templates for crypto tokens and AI agent profiles.
entries.zh: 在子域名或自定义 .xyz 域名上部署实时 HTTPS 网站，通过 Base 上的 USDC 支付，并提供加密代币和 AI 代理资料模板。

entries.english: Manage domains, DNS records, contacts and marketplace listings via the Spaceship API.
entries.zh: 通过 Spaceship API 管理域名、DNS 记录、联系人和市场条目。

entries.english: SRE observability for Kubernetes and OpenShift: Tekton pipeline debugging, log analysis, root cause analysis and predictive monitoring.
entries.zh: 面向 Kubernetes 和 OpenShift 的 SRE 可观测性：Tekton 流水线调试、日志分析、根因分析和预测性监控。

entries.english: Interact with Kubernetes clusters: list and apply Kubernetes resources.
entries.zh: 与 Kubernetes 集群交互：列出并应用 Kubernetes 资源。

entries.english: Interact with OCI registries: retrieve container image information, list tags and more.
entries.zh: 与 OCI 注册表交互：获取容器镜像信息、列出标签等。

entries.english: Publish a static site or edge function to the web in one call, then manage updates, custom domains, SSL, env vars, databases and email.
entries.zh: 一次调用即可将静态网站或边缘函数发布到网络，随后管理更新、自定义域名、SSL、环境变量、数据库和邮件。

entries.english: Publish agent-made HTML to private, unguessable URLs with passcode or email-domain gating, expiry, burn-after-read and in-place updates.
entries.zh: 将代理制作的 HTML 发布到私有且难以猜测的 URL，支持密码或邮件域名限制、过期、阅后即焚和原位更新。

entries.english: Backend services for WeChat Mini Programs and full-stack apps: serverless cloud functions, databases and one-click deployment.
entries.zh: 面向微信小程序和全栈应用的后端服务：无服务器云函数、数据库和一键部署。

entries.english: Interface with Nutanix Prism Central resources.
entries.zh: 访问 Nutanix Prism Central 资源。

entries.english: Get up-to-date EC2 prices in one call from a pre-parsed AWS price catalogue.
entries.zh: 通过预解析的 AWS 价格目录，一次调用获取最新 EC2 价格。

entries.english: Kubernetes bulk port forwarding with service discovery, /etc/hosts management, traffic monitoring and pod log streaming.
entries.zh: Kubernetes 批量端口转发，支持服务发现、/etc/hosts 管理、流量监控和 pod 日志流。

entries.english: Multi-client MCP proxy: read across every client's accounts, write only to the named one, via providers' own MCP tools (Cloudflare, Vercel, Notion and more).
entries.zh: 多客户端 MCP 代理：通过服务商自己的 MCP 工具（Cloudflare、Vercel、Notion 等）读取所有客户端账号，但仅写入指定账号。

entries.english: Query book information.
entries.zh: 查询图书信息。

entries.english: Multi-cluster Kubernetes management and operations, embeddable as an SDK, covering common DevOps tasks for standard and CRD resources.
entries.zh: 多集群 Kubernetes 管理和操作，可嵌入为 SDK，涵盖标准资源和 CRD 资源的常见 DevOps 任务。

entries.english: Kubernetes cluster operations: inspect pods, deployments, services and logs.
entries.zh: Kubernetes 集群操作：检查 pod、部署、服务和日志。

entries.english: Build and host full-stack web apps and sites on Hatchable, with per-project database, auth, storage, domains and cron.
entries.zh: 在 Hatchable 上构建和托管全栈网页应用与网站，为每个项目提供数据库、认证、存储、域名和定时任务。

entries.english: Live AWS, GCP and Azure prices for FinOps: public list prices and enterprise negotiated rates (Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, CUDs, EDPs).
entries.zh: 供 FinOps 使用的 AWS、GCP 和 Azure 实时价格：公开标价和企业协商价格（Reserved Instances、Savings Plans、CUDs、EDPs）。

entries.english: Cloud architecture design for AWS, GCP, Azure and Databricks: cost estimates, compliance checks, Terraform/CloudFormation export and blast-radius analysis.
entries.zh: 面向 AWS、GCP、Azure 和 Databricks 的云架构设计：成本估算、合规检查、Terraform/CloudFormation 导出和影响范围分析。

entries.english: Install and manage a self-hosted XNS Relayer, S3-compatible object storage on a decentralized provider network: setup, health, configuration and backups.
entries.zh: 安装和管理自托管 XNS Relayer，它是去中心化服务商网络上的兼容 S3 对象存储：支持设置、健康状态、配置和备份。

entries.english: VMware vSphere/vCenter management: VM lifecycle, deployment, guest operations, snapshots and clusters, with confirmation gates, dry-run mode and audit logging.
entries.zh: VMware vSphere/vCenter 管理：虚拟机生命周期、部署、客户机操作、快照和集群，支持确认关卡、试运行模式和审计日志。

entries.english: VMware Avi Load Balancer (NSX ALB) management with AKO Kubernetes integration: virtual services, pools, analytics metrics and AKO lifecycle.
entries.zh: 管理 VMware Avi Load Balancer（NSX ALB），并集成 AKO Kubernetes：虚拟服务、池、分析指标和 AKO 生命周期。

entries.english: Read-only VMware vSphere/vCenter monitoring: inventory, alarms, events, host health, VM info and snapshot listing.
entries.zh: 只读监控 VMware vSphere/vCenter：资源清单、告警、事件、主机健康状态、虚拟机信息和快照列表。

entries.english: VMware NSX network management: segments, Tier-0/Tier-1 gateways, NAT rules, static/BGP routing and IPAM pools, with dry-run previews and delete confirmation.
entries.zh: VMware NSX 网络管理：网段、Tier-0/Tier-1 网关、NAT 规则、静态/BGP 路由和 IPAM 池，支持试运行预览与删除确认。

entries.english: VMware NSX security: Distributed Firewall policies and rules, security groups, Traceflow troubleshooting and IDS/IPS profiles, with checks before deletion.
entries.zh: VMware NSX 安全：分布式防火墙策略和规则、安全组、Traceflow 故障排查和 IDS/IPS 配置，并在删除前检查。

entries.english: VMware vSphere storage management: NFS/VMFS datastores, iSCSI software adapters and dynamic targets, and vSAN cluster operations, with dry-run previews.
entries.zh: VMware vSphere 存储管理：NFS/VMFS 数据存储、iSCSI 软件适配器和动态目标，以及 vSAN 集群操作，支持试运行预览。

entries.english: VMware Tanzu / vSphere Kubernetes Service: Supervisor cluster, namespace and Tanzu Kubernetes Cluster lifecycle, with dry-run mode and kubeconfig export.
entries.zh: VMware Tanzu / vSphere Kubernetes Service：Supervisor 集群、命名空间和 Tanzu Kubernetes Cluster 生命周期，支持试运行模式及 kubeconfig 导出。

entries.english: Publish Markdown or HTML to a public shareable link, served script-free from a separate cookieless origin.
entries.zh: 将 Markdown 或 HTML 发布为公开可分享链接，从独立、不带 Cookie 的源以无脚本形式提供。

entries.english: Run JavaScript snippets in isolated Docker sandboxes with on-the-fly npm dependency installation and clean teardown.
entries.zh: 在隔离 Docker 沙箱中运行 JavaScript 片段，支持按需安装 npm 依赖和干净清理。

entries.english: Execute code through the Piston remote code execution engine.
entries.zh: 通过 Piston 远程代码执行引擎执行代码。

entries.english: E2B cloud sandboxes: create isolated Linux VMs, clone repos, run commands, manage files and perform git operations without touching the local machine.
entries.zh: E2B 云沙箱：创建隔离 Linux 虚拟机、克隆仓库、运行命令、管理文件和执行 git 操作，无需触及本机。

entries.english: MCP server for Terse, an AI-native code language for coding agents: parse, evaluate, transpile to Python, and token-count Terse source over stdio.
entries.zh: 面向 Terse 的 MCP 服务器；Terse 是面向编码代理的 AI 原生代码语言。通过 stdio 解析、求值、转译为 Python，并统计 Terse 源码 token。

entries.english: Access any API through its existing OpenAPI documentation.
entries.zh: 通过现有 OpenAPI 文档访问任意 API。

entries.english: Containerized environments for coding agents: each agent works in its own fresh container and git branch, with execution history and terminal access.
entries.zh: 供编码代理使用的容器化环境：每个代理在全新独立容器和 git 分支中工作，并拥有执行历史和终端访问。

entries.english: Dedicated Linux VM sandboxes for untrusted, model-generated code: run commands, move files, expose a preview URL and destroy the VM.
entries.zh: 用于运行不可信模型生成代码的专用 Linux 虚拟机沙箱：运行命令、移动文件、提供预览 URL 并销毁虚拟机。

entries.english: Delegate tasks to other AI providers' models, e.g. ask OpenAI to generate an image.
entries.zh: 将任务委派给其他 AI 服务商的模型，例如请求 OpenAI 生成图像。

entries.english: Python runtime interpreter that executes submitted code in an isolated environment.
entries.zh: Python 运行时解释器，在隔离环境中执行提交的代码。

entries.english: Submit SLURM jobs, run YAML workflows, monitor GPU resources, manage SSH profiles and sync files with local or SSH-remote HPC clusters.
entries.zh: 在本地或 SSH 远程高性能计算集群上提交 SLURM 作业、运行 YAML 工作流、监控 GPU 资源、管理 SSH 配置并同步文件。

entries.english: Run untrusted Python/JavaScript code in WebAssembly sandboxes.
entries.zh: 在 WebAssembly 沙箱中运行不可信的 Python/JavaScript 代码。

entries.english: Self-hostable GPU-aware job broker: dispatch long-running or GPU jobs that outlive the session, route them by VRAM tier and monitor them across sessions.
entries.zh: 可自托管、感知 GPU 的作业代理：调度超出会话时长的长期或 GPU 作业，按显存级别路由，并跨会话监控。

entries.english: MATLAB integration: execute code, run async jobs with progress reporting, get interactive Plotly plots and expose custom .m functions as tools.
entries.zh: MATLAB 集成：执行代码、运行带进度报告的异步作业、获取交互式 Plotly 图，并将自定义 .m 函数公开为工具。

entries.english: Access any API via its OpenAPI specification, with full JSON Schema support for parameters and request bodies.
entries.zh: 通过 OpenAPI 规范访问任意 API，完整支持参数和请求体的 JSON Schema。

entries.english: Give any AI assistant a code run button: execute code in 24 languages on HackerEarth's sandboxed servers. `uvx hackerearth-mcp`.
entries.zh: 为任意 AI 助手提供代码运行按钮：在 HackerEarth 沙箱服务器中执行 24 种语言的代码。`uvx hackerearth-mcp`。

entries.english: JavaScript sandbox that uses V8 isolation to run AI-generated code locally, with heap snapshotting for persistent sessions.
entries.zh: 使用 V8 隔离在本地运行 AI 生成代码的 JavaScript 沙箱，并通过堆快照支持持久会话。

entries.english: Persistent cloud dev environments for coding agents: create, run commands, checkpoint and fork, with files, services and terminal state kept between calls.
entries.zh: 供编码代理使用的持久云开发环境：创建环境、运行命令、建立检查点和分叉，并在调用间保留文件、服务和终端状态。

entries.english: SWI-Prolog execution for LLMs with CLP(FD), negation as failure and recursion.
entries.zh: 供大语言模型使用的 SWI-Prolog 执行环境，支持 CLP(FD)、失败即否定和递归。

entries.english: Control Google Colab notebooks and assign GPUs (T4/L4/A100). Fork of Google's colab-mcp with all tools visible at startup and Windows support.
entries.zh: 控制 Google Colab 笔记本并分配 GPU（T4/L4/A100）。它是 Google colab-mcp 的分叉，启动时显示所有工具并支持 Windows。

entries.english: Agent-oriented programming language: agents emit a JSON AST that the compiler validates, type- and effect-checks, verifies with Z3/SMT and compiles to WASM.
entries.zh: 面向代理的编程语言：代理输出 JSON AST，编译器对其进行验证、类型和效果检查、使用 Z3/SMT 验证并编译为 WASM。

entries.english: Code-mode MCP server: collapses user-defined tools into code execution plus docs search, sandboxed in node:vm, WASM or remote microVMs.
entries.zh: 代码模式 MCP 服务器：将用户定义工具压缩为代码执行加文档搜索，在 node:vm、WASM 或远程微型虚拟机中运行沙箱。

entries.english: Code and logic calculator with an offline core: run code, exact symbolic math, SMT/logic and complexity analysis, with optional gVisor/AppContainer sandboxing.
entries.zh: 带离线核心的代码与逻辑计算器：运行代码、精确符号数学、SMT/逻辑和复杂度分析，可选 gVisor/AppContainer 沙箱。

entries.english: Run LLM-generated code in a YepCode sandbox and create custom MCP tools in JavaScript or Python with npm and PyPI packages.
entries.zh: 在 YepCode 沙箱中运行大语言模型生成的代码，并使用 npm 和 PyPI 包以 JavaScript 或 Python 创建自定义 MCP 工具。

entries.english: Localhost review board where different coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Trae, ZCode) review each other's work: objections must state flip conditions, revisions clear all verdicts, resolution requires the whole active quorum, and every vote is append-only audited. Ships its own audited self-review history as evidence. Install: `pipx install mcp-review-board`.
entries.zh: 本地审查委员会，让不同编码代理（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Trae、ZCode）互相审查：异议必须写明改变立场的条件，修订后清除全部裁决，解决问题需要所有活跃法定成员同意，每次投票都以仅追加方式审计。项目附带其自身经过审计的自审历史作为证据。安装：`pipx install mcp-review-board`。

entries.english: Shared session bus for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Grok: list, read, hand off, message and spawn live agent sessions via MCP or CLI.
entries.zh: 供 Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok 等编码代理使用的共享会话总线：通过 MCP 或 CLI 列出、读取、交接、发送消息和生成实时代理会话。

entries.english: Manage a 5dive agent fleet: file tasks, message and inspect agents, and read the fleet digest.
entries.zh: 管理 5dive 代理集群：创建任务、发送消息、检查代理并读取集群摘要。

entries.english: Explore and download AI agent blueprints: list them, get summaries and download full Agent Skills directories for coding agents to implement.
entries.zh: 探索并下载 AI 代理蓝图：列出蓝图、获取摘要，并下载完整 Agent Skills 目录供编码代理实现。

entries.english: Self-hosted relay where coding-agent sessions on different machines share a team board, message each other and check for git conflicts, with isolated teams, private sessions and an OAuth MCP endpoint for Claude in the cloud.
entries.zh: 自托管中继，让不同机器上的编码代理会话共享团队看板、互发消息并检查 git 冲突，支持隔离团队、私有会话以及供云端 Claude 使用的 OAuth MCP 端点。

entries.english: Document exchange for coding agents across services: versioned Markdown store, pub-sub notifications with structured diffs and lifecycle stage tracking.
entries.zh: 跨服务编码代理文档交换：版本化 Markdown 存储、带结构化差异的发布订阅通知及生命周期阶段跟踪。

entries.english: AI council: query CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode) in parallel with deliberation rounds.
entries.zh: AI 议会：并行查询 CLI 代理（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、OpenCode），并进行多轮讨论。

entries.english: Delegate tasks to the Antigravity CLI (Gemini): file analysis, repo archaeology, web lookups and second-opinion code reviews, with quota-aware model failover.
entries.zh: 将任务委派给 Antigravity CLI（Gemini）：文件分析、仓库考古、网页查询和第二意见代码审查，支持感知配额的模型故障转移。

entries.english: DevOps and networking tools: network monitoring, system diagnostics, automation workflows and infrastructure management.
entries.zh: DevOps 和网络工具：网络监控、系统诊断、自动化工作流和基础设施管理。

entries.english: Control plane for long-running Codex Desktop tasks: submit asynchronously, poll state, approve Plan Mode, recover retries and search SQLite-backed history.
entries.zh: 长时间运行的 Codex Desktop 任务控制平面：异步提交、轮询状态、批准计划模式、恢复重试并搜索 SQLite 支持的历史记录。

entries.english: Structured, model-driven interaction with network devices via Cisco pyATS.
entries.zh: 通过 Cisco pyATS 以结构化、模型驱动方式与网络设备交互。

entries.english: Adversarial test generation in Cline: detects the stack, writes and runs tests, and classifies failures as real bugs, environment problems or test bugs.
entries.zh: 在 Cline 中生成对抗性测试：检测技术栈、编写并运行测试，将失败分类为真实错误、环境问题或测试错误。

entries.english: Local MCP that lets a Chief of Staff client find, create and register Codex projects; submit exact prompts; track durable receipts; continue existing tasks; and organize scoped work inside allowlisted directories.
entries.zh: 本地 MCP，让 Chief of Staff 客户端查找、创建并注册 Codex 项目；提交精确提示词；跟踪持久收据；继续现有任务；并在白名单目录中组织限定范围的工作。

entries.english: Interact with TUI/CLI applications through a structured terminal state tree with element detection, like Playwright for terminals.
entries.zh: 通过带元素检测的结构化终端状态树与 TUI/CLI 应用交互，类似面向终端的 Playwright。

entries.english: IDE assistance for the Intlayer i18n/CMS tool: CLI access and documentation.
entries.zh: 为 Intlayer 国际化/CMS 工具提供 IDE 辅助：CLI 访问与文档。

entries.english: Self-hosted Slack bot: mention it and Claude Code or Codex investigates CloudWatch logs, runs tests and opens PRs, with credentials held by an MCP server.
entries.zh: 自托管 Slack 机器人：提及时由 Claude Code 或 Codex 调查 CloudWatch 日志、运行测试并创建 PR，凭据由 MCP 服务器保管。

entries.english: Delegates tasks between local coding-agent CLIs, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Antigravity, and returns results to the calling agent.
entries.zh: 在 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 和 Antigravity 等本地编码代理 CLI 之间委派任务，并将结果返回给调用代理。

entries.english: Shared, signed index of failures other coding agents already solved: check it before retrying and ingest fixes so the next agent does not repeat the work.
entries.zh: 其他编码代理已解决故障的共享签名索引：重试前检查并收录修复，避免下一个代理重复工作。

entries.english: Multi-agent consultation for Claude Code: MCP servers wrapping Codex, Gemini and Qwen CLIs for parallel code review and problem-solving with fallback chains.
entries.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的多模型咨询：将 Codex、Gemini 和 Qwen CLI 包装为 MCP 服务器，以回退链并行进行代码审查和问题解决。

entries.english: SSH control for Linux and Windows servers, with long-running commands and execution on multiple hosts at once.
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 控制 Linux 和 Windows 服务器，支持长时间运行的命令以及同时在多台主机执行。

entries.english: Local router for Agent Skills across coding agents and MCP clients, with hybrid matching on the local CPU that spends no tokens.
entries.zh: 跨编码代理和 MCP 客户端的 Agent Skills 本地路由器，在本地 CPU 上进行混合匹配，不消耗 token。

entries.english: Deterministic orchestrator for CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Aider, with per-agent git worktrees, an audit trail and cost-aware routing.
entries.zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Aider 等 CLI 编码代理的确定性编排器，提供逐代理 git 工作树、审计轨迹和成本感知路由。

entries.english: Delegate multi-file implementation to Cursor's CLI agent over ACP and get typed results: final message, changed files, session ID and plan.
entries.zh: 通过 ACP 将多文件实现委派给 Cursor CLI 代理，并获取带类型的结果：最终消息、变更文件、会话 ID 和计划。

entries.english: Coordination bus for multiple coding agents: atomic claims, advisory file leases, a shared event ledger, presence, handoffs and a task graph. Self-hostable.
entries.zh: 多编码代理协调总线：原子认领、建议性文件租约、共享事件账本、在线状态、交接和任务图。可自托管。

entries.english: Coordinate parallel coding agents: TTL file claims across git worktrees, hooks blocking colliding edits, presence, handoff notes and searchable lessons.
entries.zh: 协调并行编码代理：跨 git 工作树的带 TTL 文件认领、阻止冲突编辑的钩子、在线状态、交接笔记和可搜索经验。

entries.english: Search, retrieve and solve LeetCode problems, with metadata filtering and access to user profiles, submissions and contest data.
entries.zh: 搜索、获取和解决 LeetCode 问题，支持元数据过滤，并可访问用户资料、提交和竞赛数据。

entries.english: Turn any CLI tool with --help output into an MCP server, with caching.
entries.zh: 将任何具有 --help 输出的 CLI 工具转换为 MCP 服务器，并支持缓存。

entries.english: Reasoning, code, anti-deception and memory tools for AI agents.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的推理、代码、反欺骗和记忆工具。

entries.english: Lets Claude Code and Codex steer each other's live desktop chats through Windows UI Automation: list and read chats, send messages or mid-turn steers, and pause, resume or edit Codex goals.
entries.zh: 通过 Windows UI Automation 让 Claude Code 和 Codex 相互操控实时桌面聊天：列出和读取聊天、发送消息或任务中途指令，并暂停、恢复或编辑 Codex 目标。

entries.english: Coding agent with basic read, write and command line tools.
entries.zh: 具有基础读取、写入和命令行工具的编码代理。

entries.english: Local Clef-Flash decision model for coding agents: `clef_decide` returns probability distributions over your options (choice/score/yes-no) via llama.cpp, fully offline, one-command install.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理的本地 Clef-Flash 决策模型：`clef_decide` 通过 llama.cpp 返回选项的概率分布（选择/评分/是非），完全离线，一条命令安装。

entries.english: Multi-LLM deliberation with anonymized peer review: parallel responses, anonymous ranking and synthesis, based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Council concept.
entries.zh: 使用匿名同行评审的多大模型讨论：并行回答、匿名排序与综合，基于 Andrej Karpathy 的 LLM Council 概念。

entries.english: Communication and shared work state across coding agent harnesses: live messages, scope claims before editing, preserved decisions and evidence handoffs.
entries.zh: 跨编码代理运行框架的通信和共享工作状态：实时消息、编辑前范围认领、决策记录和证据交接。

entries.english: Local daemon that pre-indexes a codebase into a SQLite catalog and serves AST-compressed snapshots on every query to reduce token usage.
entries.zh: 本地守护进程将代码库预先索引到 SQLite 目录，并在每次查询时提供 AST 压缩快照以减少 token 使用。

entries.english: Structured planning and validation for Claude Code: turns an objective into a validated DAG of modules built by worker agents in parallel git worktrees.
entries.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的结构化规划与验证：将目标转为经验证的模块 DAG，由工作代理在并行 git 工作树中构建。

entries.english: Rust reimplementation of WCGW for coding agents: shell execution and file management.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理的 WCGW Rust 重实现，支持 shell 执行和文件管理。

entries.english: Wraps the Claude Code CLI as MCP tools for queries, search, structured output and sessions, with budget caps and granular tool sandboxing.
entries.zh: 将 Claude Code CLI 包装为 MCP 工具，提供查询、搜索、结构化输出和会话，支持预算上限和细粒度工具沙箱。

entries.english: Two-model council: ChatGPT (through the Codex CLI) and Claude (through Claude Code) answer independently, then exchange replies until both agree on one answer. Runs on your own subscriptions (no API keys); both read your project read-only.
entries.zh: 双模型议会：ChatGPT（通过 Codex CLI）和 Claude（通过 Claude Code）独立回答，然后交换回复直至双方达成一致。使用你自己的订阅运行（无需 API 密钥）；两者均以只读方式查看项目。

entries.english: Requires every AI agent code change to leave a problem, reason and approach audit record before commit, with a pre-commit hook and audit trail dashboard.
entries.zh: 要求每次 AI 代理代码更改在提交前留下问题、原因和方法审计记录，并提供提交前钩子及审计轨迹仪表盘。

entries.english: Delegate real-world actions to Hermes Agent: research, browser workflows, messaging, scheduling and skills, with risky actions requiring approval.
entries.zh: 将现实世界操作委派给 Hermes Agent：研究、浏览器工作流、消息、日程和技能，风险操作需批准。

entries.english: See and control long-running processes such as web servers: start, stop, restart and read logs.
entries.zh: 查看和控制 Web 服务器等长时间运行的进程：启动、停止、重启并读取日志。

entries.english: Specialist agent council for AI coding CLIs with a self-learning router, cross-CLI memory and guards against dependency hallucinations and decision drift.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码 CLI 的专业代理议会，提供自学习路由器、跨 CLI 记忆，以及防止依赖幻觉和决策漂移的保护。

entries.english: Work in a VS Code workspace: read the directory structure, see linter and language server problems, read code files and make edits.
entries.zh: 在 VS Code 工作区中工作：读取目录结构、查看 lint 和语言服务器问题、读取代码文件并编辑。

entries.english: Governed runtime for AI coding agents with budget caps, verifier gates, runaway-loop prevention, rollback evidence and inspectable run receipts.
entries.zh: 受治理的 AI 编码代理运行时，提供预算上限、验证关卡、失控循环防护、回滚证据和可检查的运行收据。

entries.english: Git-backed message bus for coding agents on different machines, with no server: questions, answers, decisions, claimable tasks and delegated repo reviews.
entries.zh: 面向不同机器上编码代理的 Git 消息总线，无需服务器：问题、回答、决策、可认领任务和委派式仓库审查。

entries.english: Desktop GUI automation on Windows, macOS and Linux via accessibility APIs instead of screenshots, plus workflow recording, data extraction and DOM inspection.
entries.zh: 通过无障碍 API 而非截图自动化 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 桌面 GUI，并支持工作流录制、数据提取和 DOM 检查。

entries.english: Local server and Agent Skill for TraeCN desktop automation on macOS.
entries.zh: 用于 macOS 上 TraeCN 桌面自动化的本地服务器和 Agent Skill。

entries.english: Safe Python interpreter based on Hugging Face smolagents' LocalPythonExecutor.
entries.zh: 基于 Hugging Face smolagents 的 LocalPythonExecutor 的安全 Python 解释器。

entries.english: Convert source code into an AST, regardless of language.
entries.zh: 将源代码转换为 AST，不受语言限制。

entries.english: List and terminate OS processes via natural language queries.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言查询列出并终止操作系统进程。

entries.english: Convert a codebase into a local AST knowledge graph that gives coding agents structural context for navigation and refactoring.
entries.zh: 将代码库转换为本地 AST 知识图谱，为编码代理导航和重构提供结构上下文。

entries.english: Bidirectional bridge between Gemini Spark and the Antigravity IDE: coding subagent dispatch, shared memory, local file operations and Spark app orchestration.
entries.zh: Gemini Spark 和 Antigravity IDE 之间的双向桥接：编码子代理调度、共享记忆、本地文件操作和 Spark 应用编排。

entries.english: Deterministic repository context packing for coding agents: selects, compresses, caches and budgets only the files a task needs, without an LLM in the loop.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理的确定性仓库上下文打包：只选择、压缩、缓存并按预算处理任务所需文件，不使用大语言模型。

entries.english: Bridge to multiple OpenAI-compatible LLMs for rubber duck debugging: explain a problem to several AI ducks and get different perspectives.
entries.zh: 连接多个兼容 OpenAI 的大语言模型进行橡皮鸭调试：向多只 AI 鸭解释问题，获取不同视角。

entries.english: Search the Arch Wiki and AUR, get package info, check for updates, install packages and analyze PKGBUILDs, from Arch or non-Arch systems.
entries.zh: 搜索 Arch Wiki 和 AUR、获取软件包信息、检查更新、安装软件包并分析 PKGBUILD，适用于 Arch 或非 Arch 系统。

entries.english: Connects different people's coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) through a self-hostable hub: live team status, a co-written master prompt with a vote, a dependency-aware task board, file claims and agent-to-agent questions.
entries.zh: 通过可自托管中心连接不同人员的编码代理（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）：提供实时团队状态、共同编写并投票的主提示词、感知依赖的任务看板、文件认领和代理间提问。

entries.english: Console automation and monitoring, like Playwright for terminal apps: session management, SSH, testing, monitoring and background jobs.
entries.zh: 控制台自动化和监控，类似面向终端应用的 Playwright：会话管理、SSH、测试、监控和后台作业。

entries.english: Coding agent that uses language servers for symbolic code operations.
entries.zh: 使用语言服务器执行符号级代码操作的编码代理。

entries.english: Approval-first local terminal control: policy-based command planning and approval, DeepSeek as an advisor, and signed execution receipts.
entries.zh: 先批准后执行的本地终端控制：基于策略规划和批准命令、以 DeepSeek 为顾问，并生成签名执行收据。

entries.english: Local agent OS for spec-first AI coding: a replayable, ledger-recorded interview, seed, execute, evaluate and evolve loop that MCP clients can drive.
entries.zh: 面向规格优先 AI 编码的本地代理操作系统：可重放、记入账本的访谈、种子、执行、评估和演进循环，可由 MCP 客户端驱动。

entries.english: Letters between existing Claude Code and Codex sessions on one machine: join a named bag, send through each agent's native input, read one append-only ledger, leave when done.
entries.zh: 在同一机器上的现有 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话之间传递信件：加入命名 bag、通过各代理原生输入发送、读取一个仅追加账本，并在完成后离开。

entries.english: Dynamic map of chat-related repository files with their function prototypes and related files, ranked by relevance, based on Aider's Repo Map.
entries.zh: 基于 Aider Repo Map，按相关性排列与聊天相关的仓库文件动态图，包括函数原型和相关文件。

entries.english: Local messaging between AI sessions on one PC: role accounts that persist across restarts, 1:1 DMs, channels and inboxes, with a live log viewer and an admin app.
entries.zh: 单台电脑上 AI 会话间的本地消息：重启后仍保留的角色账号、单对单私信、频道和收件箱，并提供实时日志查看器和管理应用。

entries.english: Create and drive hosted plori agents with persistent disk, tools and memory: invoke agents, manage the human-in-the-loop queue and schedule deferred runs.
entries.zh: 创建和驱动具有持久磁盘、工具和记忆的托管 plori 代理：调用代理、管理人工参与队列并安排延迟运行。

entries.english: Catch vague Claude Code prompts before they waste tokens: prompt scorecards, session history search, cross-service contract awareness and cost estimation.
entries.zh: 在模糊的 Claude Code 提示词浪费 token 前将其发现：提供提示词评分卡、会话历史搜索、跨服务契约感知和成本估算。

entries.english: Run DeepSeek as a sub-agent in Claude Code or Codex CLI, with its own agent loop for reading, editing and running commands in a sandboxed workspace.
entries.zh: 在 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI 中将 DeepSeek 作为子代理运行，拥有在沙箱工作区读取、编辑和执行命令的独立代理循环。

entries.english: Run GLM (Zhipu/Z.ai) as a sub-agent in Claude Code or GitHub Copilot with its own read/write/edit/run loop, Opus-vs-GLM routing and diff/dry-run oversight.
entries.zh: 在 Claude Code 或 GitHub Copilot 中将 GLM（智谱/Z.ai）作为子代理运行，拥有独立读写编辑执行循环、Opus 与 GLM 路由以及 diff/试运行监督。

entries.english: Parallel multi-model code review, security analysis and debate with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, including consensus and OWASP Top 10 checks.
entries.zh: 使用 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 并行进行多模型代码审查、安全分析和辩论，包括共识和 OWASP Top 10 检查。

entries.english: Checks what local coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor really did: files changed, commands run and test results read from test output, not the agent's word. Read-only.
entries.zh: 检查 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 等本地编码代理实际做了什么：从测试输出读取文件更改、运行命令和测试结果，而不是仅听代理陈述。只读。

entries.english: Framework for building multi-agent systems that coordinate over MCP, with task management, shared context and RAG.
entries.zh: 构建通过 MCP 协作的多代理系统框架，提供任务管理、共享上下文和 RAG。

entries.english: Unofficial bridge from Warp's Oz coding agent to any IDE or MCP client, plus native @oz in VS Code Copilot Chat.
entries.zh: 从 Warp 的 Oz 编码代理连接到任意 IDE 或 MCP 客户端的非官方桥接，并在 VS Code Copilot Chat 中提供原生 @oz。

entries.english: Index local code into a graph database to give AI assistants context, with graphical code visualizations for humans.
entries.zh: 将本地代码索引到图数据库，为 AI 助手提供上下文，同时为人类提供图形化代码可视化。

entries.english: Make AI self-correct its generated output through prompt injection, independent self-auditing and context isolation.
entries.zh: 通过提示词注入、独立自审和上下文隔离，使 AI 自行纠正生成的输出。

entries.english: Use Claude Code Skills from any IDE or CLI.
entries.zh: 在任意 IDE 或 CLI 中使用 Claude Code Skills。

entries.english: Run shell commands securely, auditably and on demand in isolated environments such as Docker.
entries.zh: 在 Docker 等隔离环境中按需、安全且可审计地运行 shell 命令。

entries.english: Coding agent with basic tools for listing, reading, editing and writing files, running commands and web search, supporting multiple projects at once.
entries.zh: 具有列出、读取、编辑和写入文件、运行命令及网页搜索等基础工具的编码代理，支持同时处理多个项目。

entries.english: Learning sidecar for AI coding assistants: quizzes developers on AI-generated changes and gives agents persistent project-specific debugging memory via RAG.
entries.zh: AI 编码助手的学习侧车：就 AI 生成的更改向开发者提问，并通过 RAG 为代理提供持久的项目专属调试记忆。

entries.english: Coding agent for Max (Max/MSP/Jitter), the visual programming language for music and multimedia.
entries.zh: 面向音乐和多媒体可视化编程语言 Max（Max/MSP/Jitter）的编码代理。

entries.english: Coordinate parallel coding agents: TTL file claims, a task board with dependencies, versioned interface contracts, change notices and a decisions log.
entries.zh: 协调并行编码代理：带 TTL 的文件认领、具有依赖关系的任务看板、版本化接口契约、变更通知和决策日志。

entries.english: SSH control for Linux and Windows servers: execute remote shell commands with password or SSH key authentication.
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 控制远程 Linux 和 Windows 服务器：使用密码或 SSH 密钥认证执行远程 shell 命令。

entries.english: See, find and interact with UI elements in any desktop application, like Playwright for the whole OS.
entries.zh: 查看、查找并操作任意桌面应用中的界面元素，类似面向整个操作系统的 Playwright。

entries.english: Coordination for multiple coding agents on one repo: agents register edit intent and overlapping tree-sitter symbols are flagged before the edit rather than at merge time, plus agent-to-agent messaging and cross-machine task delegation.
entries.zh: 协调同一仓库中的多个编码代理：代理登记编辑意图，重叠的 tree-sitter 符号在编辑前而非合并时标记，并支持代理间消息和跨机器任务委派。

entries.english: Run Codex agents from Claude Code through MCP and Channels, with live progress notifications, mid-task steering and session continuation.
entries.zh: 通过 MCP 和 Channels 从 Claude Code 运行 Codex 代理，支持实时进度通知、任务中途指令和会话继续。

entries.english: Developer tools for file editing, shell command execution and screen capture.
entries.zh: 用于编辑文件、执行 shell 命令和截取屏幕的开发者工具。

entries.english: Build, deploy and manage hosted VibeKit apps, each with a live URL and its own persistent server-side agent to chat with.
entries.zh: 构建、部署和管理托管 VibeKit 应用，每个应用都有实时 URL 和可聊天的持久服务器端代理。

entries.english: Deterministic context pruning middleware for AI coding agents. Cuts input tokens by 60%, drops local CPU TTFT by 62%, and enforces formal IP isolation via AST-RDF contracts.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的确定性上下文裁剪中间件。其声称将输入 token 减少 60%、本地 CPU 首 token 时间减少 62%，并通过 AST-RDF 契约强制执行形式化知识产权隔离。

entries.english: Runtime and skill library for coding agents: C4 workflow gates, guarded command execution and reasoning engines like Tree of Thoughts and 5 Whys.
entries.zh: 编码代理运行时和技能库：C4 工作流关卡、受保护的命令执行，以及 Tree of Thoughts、5 Whys 等推理引擎。

entries.english: Code intelligence for Elixir: module search, function tracking and PR attribution via tree-sitter AST parsing.
entries.zh: Elixir 代码智能：通过 tree-sitter AST 解析进行模块搜索、函数跟踪和 PR 归属。

entries.english: Manage and execute programs, and read, write, search and edit code and text files.
entries.zh: 管理和执行程序，并读取、写入、搜索及编辑代码和文本文件。

entries.english: Code tools for LLMs to read, understand and modify code, using a tree-sitter parser, SQLite index and transactional writes.
entries.zh: 供大语言模型读取、理解和修改代码的工具，使用 tree-sitter 解析器、SQLite 索引和事务式写入。

entries.english: Connect an IDE or AI assistant to Codex CLI for code analysis and editing, with support for multiple models.
entries.zh: 将 IDE 或 AI 助手连接到 Codex CLI 进行代码分析和编辑，支持多种模型。

entries.english: Connect an IDE or AI assistant to GitHub Copilot CLI for code analysis, review and batch processing.
entries.zh: 将 IDE 或 AI 助手连接到 GitHub Copilot CLI，进行代码分析、审查和批处理。

entries.english: Post and fund TaskBounty bounties for GitHub bugs and test coverage, or solve them with PRs that include regression tests and are verified in a sandbox.
entries.zh: 为 GitHub 错误和测试覆盖率发布并资助 TaskBounty 赏金，或通过包含回归测试且在沙箱中验证的 PR 完成赏金。

entries.english: Local task bus for CLI AI agents such as Codex and Claude Code: route work, persist state in SQLite and collaborate through a shared server.
entries.zh: 面向 Codex 和 Claude Code 等 CLI AI 代理的本地任务总线：路由工作、在 SQLite 中持久化状态，并通过共享服务器协作。

entries.english: Control plane for AI coding agents: time-locks writing, requires evidence for claims, runs adversarial review and keeps a sealed verification record.
entries.zh: AI 编码代理控制平面：对写入设置时间锁、要求主张有证据、运行对抗性审查并保存封存的验证记录。

entries.english: Secure remote MCP bridge to paired computers: files, terminal sessions, screenshots, search, processes, and binary transfers with outbound-only device agents.
entries.zh: 连接已配对计算机的安全远程 MCP 桥接：支持文件、终端会话、截图、搜索、进程和二进制传输，设备代理只发起出站连接。

entries.english: Outbound-only remote shell, detached long-running jobs and temporary file transfer for AI agents, without exposing SSH, ports or a VPN.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的仅出站远程 shell、分离式长任务和临时文件传输，无需暴露 SSH、端口或 VPN。

entries.english: Read-only access to your local shell history and AI coding agent sessions: search commands, recent failures and risky commands, and see what each agent session changed in git.
entries.zh: 只读访问本地 shell 历史和 AI 编码代理会话：搜索命令、近期失败和风险命令，查看每个代理会话在 git 中的更改。

entries.english: Manage multiple SSH servers: commands, file transfer and rsync, database dumps and queries, backups, health monitoring, tunnels and per-server security modes.
entries.zh: 管理多个 SSH 服务器：执行命令、文件传输和 rsync、数据库转储与查询、备份、健康监控、隧道以及每台服务器的安全模式。

entries.english: SSH control of remote Linux, macOS and Windows servers: line-level file editing, background tasks, sudo, host aliases, and directory and archive operations.
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 控制远程 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器：逐行编辑文件、后台任务、sudo、主机别名及目录和归档操作。

entries.english: SSH connection manager with a TUI dashboard for discovering, searching and running commands on remote hosts.
entries.zh: 带 TUI 仪表盘的 SSH 连接管理器，可发现、搜索远程主机并在其上执行命令。

entries.english: Run commands on machines you cannot SSH into, such as air-gapped or bastion-only hosts, via git, file shares or S3, with timestamped run logs.
entries.zh: 通过 git、文件共享或 S3 在无法 SSH 连接的机器（如隔离网络或仅可经堡垒机访问的主机）上运行命令，并生成带时间戳的运行日志。

entries.english: Drive full-screen terminal programs such as vim, htop and lazygit by reading the screen as a live cell grid with cursor, selection and alt-screen state.
entries.zh: 通过读取包含光标、选择和备用屏幕状态的实时单元格网格，驱动 vim、htop、lazygit 等全屏终端程序。

entries.english: SSH access with persistent sessions, SFTP and port forwarding, with secrets injected via stdin and redacted from output before reaching the LLM.
entries.zh: SSH 访问支持持久会话、SFTP 和端口转发；密钥通过标准输入注入，并在输出到达大语言模型之前脱敏。

entries.english: Administer a Linux server: read files and logs, manage systemd services and cron jobs, run read-only MySQL queries, WP-CLI, Git and sandboxed Python.
entries.zh: 管理 Linux 服务器：读取文件和日志、管理 systemd 服务与 cron 作业、执行只读 MySQL 查询、WP-CLI、Git 和沙箱 Python。

entries.english: Remote server work via the local OpenSSH client: run commands, transfer files with checksums, search logs and audit hosts, with destructive commands blocked.
entries.zh: 通过本地 OpenSSH 客户端操作远程服务器：运行命令、传输带校验和的文件、搜索日志并审计主机，同时阻止破坏性命令。

entries.english: Linux system administration via typed actions instead of shell strings, with a signed audit log, one-time approval receipts and automatic rollback.
entries.zh: 通过类型化操作而非 shell 字符串管理 Linux 系统，提供签名审计日志、一次性批准收据和自动回滚。

entries.english: Self-hosted SSH and Kubernetes access broker: ephemeral per-operation credentials the model never sees, per-command firewall, human approvals and audit log.
entries.zh: 自托管 SSH 和 Kubernetes 访问代理：使用模型不可见的逐操作临时凭据、逐命令防火墙、人工批准和审计日志。

entries.english: Launch, screenshot and interact with any TUI app.
entries.zh: 启动、截屏并操作任意 TUI 应用。

entries.english: Safety gate between AI agents and your servers: 25 typed tools (services, logs, Docker, disk, ports, files, nginx) that build their own argv, so the agent never passes a command string. Deny-by-default observe / operate / full modes per host, human approval for every change via MCP elicitation, and a hash-chained audit log that also records refusals. Local or over SSH with known_hosts verification.
entries.zh: AI 代理与服务器之间的安全关卡：25 个类型化工具（服务、日志、Docker、磁盘、端口、文件、nginx）自行构建 argv，代理无需传递命令字符串。每台主机具有默认拒绝的观察/操作/完全模式，通过 MCP elicitation 对每次更改请求人工批准，并在哈希链审计日志中记录拒绝操作。可在本地或通过验证 known_hosts 的 SSH 使用。

entries.english: Local command wrapper for AI coding agents: runs shell commands, stores history locally and returns compressed terminal output to reduce context noise.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的本地命令包装器：运行 shell 命令、在本地保存历史，并返回压缩的终端输出以减少上下文噪声。

entries.english: Interactive PTY sessions for AI agents: local shells, persistent SSH sessions with attach/detach, and serial ports.
entries.zh: 供 AI 代理使用的交互式 PTY 会话：本地 shell、可连接/分离的持久 SSH 会话和串口。

entries.english: Search, retrieve and diff the output of past terminal commands, recorded locally with exit codes, cwd and duration, with secret redaction by default.
entries.zh: 搜索、获取和比较过去终端命令的输出，在本地记录退出码、工作目录和时长，默认对密钥脱敏。

entries.english: Terminal for AI coding agents: persistent PTY sessions, incremental reads, headless screen capture, multi-agent orchestration and a web dashboard.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的终端：持久 PTY 会话、增量读取、无界面屏幕捕获、多代理编排和 Web 仪表盘。

entries.english: Developer toolkit: stack detection for AI context files, port conflicts, .env schema validation, docs drift, dependency license audits and task timing.
entries.zh: 开发者工具包：为 AI 上下文文件检测技术栈、检查端口冲突、验证 .env 模式、检测文档漂移、审计依赖许可和统计任务时间。

entries.english: Terminal, filesystem and background-job tools for Linux and macOS.
entries.zh: 适用于 Linux 和 macOS 的终端、文件系统和后台作业工具。

entries.english: Local full-text search over zsh, bash and fish history, with secret redaction and optional capture of cwd, exit code and duration.
entries.zh: 本地全文搜索 zsh、bash 和 fish 历史，提供密钥脱敏，并可选择记录工作目录、退出码和时长。

entries.english: Inspect, manage and kill local dev servers: see what listens on each port, diagnose port conflicts, find zombie processes and kill by PID or port.
entries.zh: 检查、管理和终止本地开发服务器：查看各端口监听者、诊断端口冲突、查找僵尸进程，并按 PID 或端口终止。

entries.english: Drive tmux locally or over SSH: sessions, windows, panes, keystrokes, pane capture and raw commands, with shared sessions for pair programming.
entries.zh: 在本地或通过 SSH 驱动 tmux：会话、窗口、窗格、按键、窗格捕获和原始命令，并支持结对编程共享会话。

entries.english: Manage AWS EC2, Hetzner, OVH and SSH servers: commands, logs, CloudWatch/CloudTrail queries, fleet health, IP banning and S3, with tiered safety guards.
entries.zh: 管理 AWS EC2、Hetzner、OVH 和 SSH 服务器：命令、日志、CloudWatch/CloudTrail 查询、集群健康、IP 封禁和 S3，提供分级安全保护。

entries.english: Stateful, auditable shell sessions over local, SSH and Docker, with secret redaction, output budgeting and a read-only live transcript viewer.
entries.zh: 通过本地、SSH 和 Docker 提供有状态、可审计的 shell 会话，支持密钥脱敏、输出预算和只读实时记录查看器。

entries.english: Read-only SSH diagnostics for Linux and Docker servers using a fixed command allowlist, with secret redaction and per-command timeouts.
entries.zh: 使用固定命令白名单对 Linux 和 Docker 服务器进行只读 SSH 诊断，支持密钥脱敏和逐命令超时。

entries.english: Run privileged commands locally or over SSH, each gated by a single-keypress human approval before sudo, with audit logging and no stored password.
entries.zh: 在本地或通过 SSH 运行特权命令；每次 sudo 前均需人工按单键批准，提供审计日志且不保存密码。

entries.english: Google Chat API: list and search spaces, read and send messages, and work with threads and reactions.
entries.zh: Google Chat API：列出和搜索空间、读取和发送消息，并处理主题与回应。

entries.english: Gmail API: search, read and send email, and manage drafts, labels and the trash.
entries.zh: Gmail API：搜索、读取和发送电子邮件，并管理草稿、标签和垃圾箱。

entries.english: Email for any IMAP provider: search, read, draft and allowlisted sending, with every message fenced as untrusted input and warnings for hidden text and injected instructions.
entries.zh: 适用于任意 IMAP 服务商的邮件工具：搜索、读取、起草和白名单发送；每封邮件都被隔离为不可信输入，并对隐藏文本和注入指令发出警告。

entries.english: Microsoft 365 or IMAP mail and calendar: read, search, draft and find free slots, with out-of-band human approval for sends, deletes and calendar writes.
entries.zh: Microsoft 365 或 IMAP 邮件和日历：读取、搜索、起草和查找空闲时段；发送、删除和日历写入需带外人工批准。

entries.english: Email and SMS for AI agents via a local mail server: disposable inboxes, sending and receiving email, and fetching verification codes.
entries.zh: 通过本地邮件服务器为 AI 代理提供邮件和短信：一次性收件箱、收发邮件及获取验证码。

entries.english: Email for AI agents: create inboxes on the fly to send, receive and act on email.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的邮件工具：动态创建收件箱以发送、接收和处理邮件。

entries.english: Ephemeral rendezvous for agents: expiring threads with a secret read key and public write address, plus an open board where agents find each other.
entries.zh: 代理的临时会合点：带秘密读取密钥和公开写入地址的过期主题，以及供代理互相发现的公开看板。

entries.english: Email for Gmail, Fastmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, Yandex and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox: read, search, send, organize, draft, schedule and auto-triage mail.
entries.zh: 支持 Gmail、Fastmail、iCloud、Yahoo、Zoho、Yandex 和任意 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱：读取、搜索、发送、整理、起草、定时和自动分拣邮件。

entries.english: Self-hosted, multi-account Gmail for Claude and Codex over Streamable HTTP, with owner-only OAuth, explicit account aliases, encrypted credentials, and optional sending and label changes.
entries.zh: 通过 Streamable HTTP 为 Claude 和 Codex 提供自托管多账号 Gmail，支持仅所有者 OAuth、明确账号别名、加密凭据，以及可选发送和标签更改。

entries.english: Email verification for AI agents: returns send, hold or kill for an address with a reason, using local DNS checks or a hosted SMTP probe.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的邮件地址验证：通过本地 DNS 检查或托管 SMTP 探测，对地址返回发送、暂缓或终止及原因。

entries.english: Write and preview emails: render Markdown into email-safe HTML for Outlook and Gmail, lint drafts for deliverability and get a live preview link.
entries.zh: 撰写和预览邮件：将 Markdown 渲染为适用于 Outlook 和 Gmail 的 HTML，检查草稿送达性并提供实时预览链接。

entries.english: Physical mail API for AI agents: send letters, certified mail, postcards and batch mailings with cost previews, approval controls, tracking and webhooks.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的实体邮件 API：发送信件、挂号信、明信片和批量邮件，提供费用预览、批准控制、跟踪和 webhook。

entries.english: Email for AI agents: autonomous inbox registration via proof-of-work, custom domains, and sending and receiving over the open JMAP standard.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的邮件服务：通过工作量证明自主注册收件箱，支持自定义域名和使用开放 JMAP 标准收发邮件。

entries.english: Publish content to DEV.to, Hashnode, GitHub Discussions, Reddit, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Medium and Twitter, adapted per platform with idempotent state.
entries.zh: 向 DEV.to、Hashnode、GitHub Discussions、Reddit、Bluesky、LinkedIn、Medium 和 Twitter 发布内容，按平台调整并保持幂等状态。

entries.english: Message queue that lets AI coding assistants message each other across sessions and machines. Self-hostable.
entries.zh: 消息队列，让 AI 编码助手跨会话和机器互发消息。可自托管。

entries.english: Gmail server that runs on your machine and calls the Gmail API directly with your own OAuth client, with no third-party middleman. Search with Gmail query syntax, read messages, send or draft mail with local file attachments and in-thread replies, and list or modify labels.
entries.zh: 在本机运行并使用自己的 OAuth 客户端直接调用 Gmail API 的服务器，无第三方中间商。支持 Gmail 查询语法搜索、读取消息、发送或起草带本地附件的邮件和主题内回复，以及列出或修改标签。

entries.english: Self-hosted digests of your Telegram channels over MCP: AI summaries, the last digest and raw per-channel messages, with OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama.
entries.zh: 通过 MCP 自托管 Telegram 频道摘要：使用 OpenAI、Anthropic 或 Ollama 提供 AI 摘要、最近摘要和各频道原始消息。

entries.english: Convert .eml exports to Markdown with YAML front matter for RAG pipelines: thread splitting, signature stripping, attachment extraction and calendar parsing.
entries.zh: 将 .eml 导出转换为带 YAML front matter 的 Markdown，供 RAG 流水线使用：拆分主题、移除签名、提取附件和解析日历。

entries.english: Send desktop notifications with a sound effect when agent tasks complete.
entries.zh: 代理任务完成时发送带音效的桌面通知。

entries.english: Telegram API integration: access user data, manage dialogs (chats, channels, groups), retrieve messages and handle read status.
entries.zh: Telegram API 集成：访问用户数据、管理对话（聊天、频道、群组）、获取消息并处理已读状态。

entries.english: Chatmaid WhatsApp API: send messages to contacts and groups from a linked WhatsApp number, read replies, check delivery status and usage.
entries.zh: Chatmaid WhatsApp API：从关联的 WhatsApp 号码向联系人和群组发送消息、读取回复，并检查送达状态和用量。

entries.english: Telegram API integration: access user data, manage dialogs (chats, channels, groups), retrieve and send messages, and handle read status.
entries.zh: Telegram API 集成：访问用户数据、管理对话（聊天、频道、群组）、获取和发送消息，并处理已读状态。

entries.english: Security-focused SendGrid email sending with recipient/domain allowlists, send caps, review mode, an audit log and no silent BCC.
entries.zh: 注重安全的 SendGrid 邮件发送，提供收件人/域名白名单、发送上限、审查模式、审计日志，并禁止静默密送。

entries.english: Self-hosted email for Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com and IMAP/SMTP: read, search, draft, send, schedule and organize mail, with per-client permissions.
entries.zh: 面向 Gmail、Microsoft 365、Outlook.com 和 IMAP/SMTP 的自托管邮件：读取、搜索、起草、发送、定时和整理邮件，支持逐客户端权限。

entries.english: Email infrastructure for AI agents: create inboxes on the fly, send and receive email, search messages and manage threads.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的邮件基础设施：动态创建收件箱、收发和搜索邮件并管理主题。

entries.english: IMAP/SMTP email across multiple accounts: read, search, send, schedule and manage mail, with IMAP IDLE push, AI triage and desktop notifications.
entries.zh: 跨多账号的 IMAP/SMTP 邮件工具：读取、搜索、发送、定时和管理邮件，支持 IMAP IDLE 推送、AI 分拣和桌面通知。

entries.english: Search CometChat documentation and get curated implementation bundles for adding real-time chat, voice, video and moderation to apps.
entries.zh: 搜索 CometChat 文档并获取精选实现包，为应用添加实时聊天、语音、视频和内容审核。

entries.english: Email for AI agents: send email, read replies as threads, and reply in context, with per-key send limits and approvals. Remote at `https://mcp.sendraven.ai/mcp` (OAuth) or `npx -y @sendraven/mcp` with `SENDRAVEN_API_KEY`. Requires a SendRaven account.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的邮件工具：发送邮件、按主题读取回复并在上下文中回复，支持按密钥的发送上限和批准。可通过 `https://mcp.sendraven.ai/mcp`（OAuth）远程使用，或使用 `npx -y @sendraven/mcp` 和 `SENDRAVEN_API_KEY`。需要 SendRaven 账号。

entries.english: Mattermost API integration: list channels, read and post messages, manage threads and reactions, and monitor topics.
entries.zh: Mattermost API 集成：列出频道、读取和发布消息、管理主题与回应，并监控话题。

entries.english: Local Microsoft Outlook calendar and mail via Microsoft Graph, with multi-account support and OS keychain token storage.
entries.zh: 通过 Microsoft Graph 在本地访问 Outlook 日历和邮件，支持多账号及操作系统钥匙串 token 存储。

entries.english: Place consent-based outbound phone calls and retrieve transcripts, summaries and outcomes.
entries.zh: 在取得同意的前提下拨打外呼电话，并获取转录、摘要和结果。

entries.english: Discourse forum integration: search topics, read posts, manage categories and tags, discover users and interact with communities.
entries.zh: Discourse 论坛集成：搜索话题、阅读帖子、管理分类和标签、发现用户并与社区互动。

entries.english: Outlook mail via Microsoft Graph: read, search, draft, send and organize email. Read-only by default, with audit logs and confirmation before send or delete.
entries.zh: 通过 Microsoft Graph 访问 Outlook 邮件：读取、搜索、起草、发送和整理邮件。默认只读，提供审计日志，并在发送或删除前确认。

entries.english: Let an agent ask its owner first, on their phone, before doing something irreversible. `ask_approval` blocks until a person answers and distinguishes DENIED from NO ANSWER, so a timeout is never read as consent; a fingerprint can be required, and the answer records that a human gave it. `send_notification` covers one-way alerts with priorities and quiet hours. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf or anything else that speaks MCP — `npx -y lauther-mcp`.
entries.zh: 让代理在执行不可逆操作之前先通过手机询问其所有者。`ask_approval` 会阻塞直到有人回答，并区分 DENIED 与 NO ANSWER，因此超时绝不会被视为同意；可要求指纹，并记录回答由人类作出。`send_notification` 提供带优先级和免打扰时段的单向通知。适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 或其他支持 MCP 的客户端——`npx -y lauther-mcp`。

entries.english: Email read tracking via Gmail: send tracked emails and check whether they were opened, with open count, device and timing.
entries.zh: 通过 Gmail 跟踪邮件阅读：发送带跟踪的邮件并检查是否打开，包括打开次数、设备和时间。

entries.english: Gmail mailbox control via the live Gmail API: search, read, label, archive, trash, download attachments and snooze threads until a date.
entries.zh: 通过实时 Gmail API 控制邮箱：搜索、读取、加标签、归档、移入垃圾箱、下载附件，并将主题暂缓到指定日期。

entries.english: Free, self-hosted MCP server you deploy to your own Vercel: 62 tools for Gmail (app password), Discord (bot) and X search, with an owner dashboard, per-tool switches and a read-only mode. No database needed.
