entries.zh: 免费自托管 MCP 服务器，部署到自己的 Vercel：为 Gmail（应用密码）、Discord（机器人）和 X 搜索提供 62 个工具，带所有者仪表盘、逐工具开关和只读模式。无需数据库。

entries.english: Convert Markdown to WhatsApp formatting so agent output shows bold, lists and quotes instead of raw asterisks, with tables rendered as monospace boxes.
entries.zh: 将 Markdown 转换为 WhatsApp 格式，让代理输出显示粗体、列表和引用而非原始星号，并将表格渲染成等宽字符框。

entries.english: Full-featured personal WhatsApp: read and full-text search all chats, send, reply, react, edit and delete, polls, media as raw files, groups and communities, multi-account, live notifications on new messages. Rust server with a Go whatsmeow bridge, local SQLite.
entries.zh: 功能完整的个人 WhatsApp：读取并全文搜索所有聊天、发送、回复、回应、编辑和删除，支持投票、媒体原始文件、群组和社区、多账号及新消息实时通知。Rust 服务器搭配 Go whatsmeow 桥接，使用本地 SQLite。

entries.english: Feishu/Lark integration: send messages as the actual user rather than a bot, plus docs, Bitable, wiki, Drive, calendar, tasks and OKRs.
entries.zh: 飞书/Lark 集成：以真实用户而非机器人身份发送消息，并访问文档、多维表格、知识库、云盘、日历、任务和 OKR。

entries.english: Compose, price and send physical letters and postcards, paid with Solana.
entries.zh: 撰写、计价和发送实体信件与明信片，使用 Solana 支付。

entries.english: Covers the entire Telegram Bot API.
entries.zh: 覆盖完整 Telegram Bot API。

entries.english: Instagram creator toolkit: download Reels, Stories and photos, extract audio, check engagement, research hashtags and get hook templates and posting times.
entries.zh: Instagram 创作者工具包：下载 Reels、Stories 和照片、提取音频、检查互动、研究话题标签，并获取开场模板与发布时间。

entries.english: X (Twitter) creator toolkit: tweet media downloads, curated hashtags, posting times, hook formulas, engagement calculators and a thread splitter.
entries.zh: X（Twitter）创作者工具包：下载推文媒体、精选话题标签、发布时间、开场公式、互动计算器和长帖拆分器。

entries.english: Proton Mail access through the local Proton Mail Bridge: search and read emails, inspect attachments, and create drafts. No send, delete or move tools.
entries.zh: 通过本地 Proton Mail Bridge 访问 Proton Mail：搜索和读取邮件、检查附件并创建草稿。不提供发送、删除或移动工具。

entries.english: Gambot WhatsApp Business API: send WhatsApp messages and templates, and manage CRM contacts, leads, cases, tasks, quotes, invoices, orders and campaigns.
entries.zh: Gambot WhatsApp Business API：发送 WhatsApp 消息和模板，并管理 CRM 联系人、线索、案件、任务、报价、发票、订单及活动。

entries.english: Make phone calls using VoIP/SIP and OpenAI's Realtime API, and observe the transcript.
entries.zh: 使用 VoIP/SIP 和 OpenAI Realtime API 拨打电话，并查看转录。

entries.english: Search and browse Telegram chat history stored in Telegram Archive: list chats, retrieve messages and run full-text search.
entries.zh: 搜索和浏览存储在 Telegram Archive 中的 Telegram 聊天历史：列出聊天、获取消息并执行全文搜索。

entries.english: EU-hosted email API: send transactional and marketing email, manage contacts and segments, run broadcasts, render templates and read analytics.
entries.zh: 托管在欧盟的邮件 API：发送事务和营销邮件、管理联系人和分组、进行群发、渲染模板并读取分析数据。

entries.english: Email verification: mailbox existence checks, including catch-all, accept-all and SEG-protected addresses (Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda), single or bulk.
entries.zh: 邮件验证：检查邮箱是否存在，包括 catch-all、accept-all 和受安全邮件网关保护的地址（Proofpoint、Mimecast、Barracuda），支持单个或批量检查。

entries.english: Send and fetch ntfy notifications on a self-hosted ntfy server, with token auth support.
entries.zh: 在自托管 ntfy 服务器上发送和获取 ntfy 通知，支持 token 认证。

entries.english: Local-first Proton Mail MCP server and CLI via Proton Mail Bridge: search, read, draft, send, triage threads, answer calendar invitations, reply reminders, multiple accounts, and a local SQLite index. Safety presets from read-only to full, with send confirmation and an outbound-to-self mode.
entries.zh: 通过 Proton Mail Bridge 提供本地优先的 Proton Mail MCP 服务器和 CLI：搜索、读取、起草、发送、分拣主题、回应日历邀请、回复提醒、多账号和本地 SQLite 索引。提供从只读到完全访问的安全预设、发送确认及仅向自己发送模式。

entries.english: Signal messenger via a local signal-cli: send and receive messages, manage groups and contacts, search history, and handle attachments and reactions.
entries.zh: 通过本地 signal-cli 使用 Signal：发送和接收消息、管理群组和联系人、搜索历史，并处理附件和回应。

entries.english: Pair two AI coding agents on different machines over an end-to-end encrypted relay to exchange files and messages, with human consent before any file write.
entries.zh: 通过端到端加密中继连接不同机器上的两个 AI 编码代理，交换文件和消息；任何文件写入前均需人工同意。

entries.english: Send and schedule transactional email, check delivery, and set up sending domains, templates, webhooks and suppressions with Groundmail. Runs locally over stdio or hosted with OAuth at `https://mcp.groundmail.dev/mcp`.
entries.zh: 通过 Groundmail 发送和定时事务邮件、检查送达情况，并设置发件域名、模板、webhook 和抑制列表。可在本地通过 stdio 运行，或通过 `https://mcp.groundmail.dev/mcp` 使用 OAuth 托管服务。

entries.english: Two-way WhatsApp notifications for AI agents: send messages, ask questions with tap-to-answer buttons and check replies, without a Meta account.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的双向 WhatsApp 通知：发送消息、使用点击回答按钮提问并检查回复，无需 Meta 账号。

entries.english: Public message board for AI agents: read and post in rooms and threads with no account, plus optional Ed25519 identity, private and sealed conversations, claimable work items and a Bitcoin-anchored transparency log. Hosted at swarmmemo.com/mcp, or run the Go server with the local Python bridge.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的公开留言板：无需账号即可在房间和主题中阅读及发帖，可选 Ed25519 身份、私密和密封会话、可认领工作项及锚定 Bitcoin 的透明日志。托管于 swarmmemo.com/mcp，也可通过本地 Python 桥接运行 Go 服务器。

entries.english: macOS WeChat integration: read chats, send text, files and stickers, retrieve context and monitor allowlisted chats, without screenshots or private protocols.
entries.zh: macOS 微信集成：读取聊天、发送文本、文件和表情、获取上下文并监控白名单聊天，无需截图或私有协议。

entries.english: Local Maildir access via notmuch: full-text search, tag filtering, threads, attachments and unanswered-mail tracking, with optional drafts and tagging.
entries.zh: 通过 notmuch 访问本地 Maildir：全文搜索、标签过滤、主题、附件和未回复邮件跟踪，可选草稿和标记。

entries.english: Full Resend email API coverage plus diagnostics: deliverability analysis, DNS troubleshooting, email inspection, bounce explanations and account audits.
entries.zh: 完整覆盖 Resend 邮件 API 并提供诊断：送达率分析、DNS 故障排查、邮件检查、退信解释和账号审计。

entries.english: MCP server for ICTFax, an open source FreeSWITCH-based fax server. Lists inbound and outbound fax transmissions with status, contact and page count, and polls a single transmission after sending. Uploading a document and sending a fax dial a real number and cost money, so neither tool is registered with the model unless `ICTFAX_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true`. Talks to the ICTCore REST API. Zero-install via `npx -y ictfax-mcp`.
entries.zh: 用于开源、基于 FreeSWITCH 的传真服务器 ICTFax 的 MCP 服务器。列出入站和出站传真及其状态、联系人和页数，并在发送后轮询单次传输。上传文档和发送传真会拨打真实号码并产生费用，因此除非设置 `ICTFAX_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=true`，否则这两个工具不会注册给模型。通过 ICTCore REST API 通信。零安装运行：`npx -y ictfax-mcp`。

entries.english: Read-only access to ICTPBX, a multi-tenant IP PBX on ICTCore and FreeSWITCH: PBX statistics, extensions, DIDs, providers and tenants.
entries.zh: 只读访问基于 ICTCore 和 FreeSWITCH 的多租户 IP PBX——ICTPBX：PBX 统计、分机、DID、服务商和租户。

entries.english: Asterisk and FreeSWITCH PBX state over AMI and ESL: extensions, active channels, trunk and SIP peer status, dialplan and call history; read-only by default.
entries.zh: 通过 AMI 和 ESL 获取 Asterisk 与 FreeSWITCH PBX 状态：分机、活动通道、中继和 SIP 对端状态、拨号计划及通话历史；默认只读。

entries.english: ICTBroadcast voice, SMS and fax broadcasting: list campaigns and read live status and per-call results, with optional tools to start and stop campaigns.
entries.zh: ICTBroadcast 语音、短信和传真广播：列出活动、读取实时状态和每次通话结果，可选启动和停止活动的工具。

entries.english: Send SMS, query delivery reports, manage senders and blacklists, and register and check İYS (Turkish consent registry) records via the iletiMerkezi API.
entries.zh: 通过 iletiMerkezi API 发送短信、查询送达报告、管理发送方和黑名单，并登记及检查 İYS（土耳其同意登记系统）记录。

entries.english: Apple Mail access: list accounts and mailboxes, fetch emails with filters, full-text search via an FTS5 index and extract attachments.
entries.zh: 访问 Apple Mail：列出账号和邮箱、按条件获取邮件、通过 FTS5 索引全文搜索并提取附件。

entries.english: Microsoft Teams messaging: read, post and mention, and list members and threads.
entries.zh: Microsoft Teams 消息：读取、发布和提及，并列出成员及主题。

entries.english: Infobip cloud communications: send and receive SMS and RCS, use WhatsApp and Viber, automate communication workflows and manage customer data.
entries.zh: Infobip 云通信：收发 SMS 和 RCS、使用 WhatsApp 和 Viber、自动化通信工作流并管理客户数据。

entries.english: Give AI agents an address on fmsg, an open federated messaging protocol: inbox, threads, replies, reactions, attachments and waiting for new messages.
entries.zh: 为 AI 代理提供 fmsg 地址；fmsg 是开放的联合消息协议，支持收件箱、主题、回复、回应、附件和等待新消息。

entries.english: Run live audience Q&A and polls with AskOne, with free AI moderation: start rooms, launch polls, moderate and answer questions, and draft a FAQ from the Q&A. Also hosted at `https://askone.org/api/mcp`.
entries.zh: 使用 AskOne 开展实时观众问答和投票，提供免费 AI 审核：开启房间、发起投票、审核并回答问题，以及根据问答起草 FAQ。也托管于 `https://askone.org/api/mcp`。

entries.english: Self-hosted IMAP/SMTP email for Claude, ChatGPT and other AI apps on desktop and phone: up to 5 mailboxes, drafts by default, sends only when you ask, file attachments from chat.
entries.zh: 面向桌面及手机上的 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 应用的自托管 IMAP/SMTP 邮件：最多 5 个邮箱，默认起草，仅在你要求时发送，可附加聊天中的文件。

entries.english: Read-only search over Sendchamp documentation for SMS, OTP verification and Africa-specific routing.
entries.zh: 只读搜索 Sendchamp 文档，涵盖短信、OTP 验证和非洲特定路由。

entries.english: Manage Discord channels, messages, forums, webhooks, members, roles, threads and moderation. Also runs as a standalone bot with slash commands.
entries.zh: 管理 Discord 频道、消息、论坛、webhook、成员、角色、主题和审核；也可作为带斜杠命令的独立机器人运行。

entries.english: Shipmail business email: manage custom-domain mailboxes, read and send messages, draft replies, inspect threads and automate REST API and webhook workflows.
entries.zh: Shipmail 商业邮件：管理自定义域名邮箱、读取和发送消息、起草回复、检查主题，以及自动化 REST API 和 webhook 工作流。

entries.english: Apple Mail with indexed full-text search, verified multi-identity sending, scheduled sends, plan-then-apply triage and a local audit ledger.
entries.zh: Apple Mail：提供索引全文搜索、经验证的多身份发送、定时发送、先计划后执行的分拣以及本地审计账本。

entries.english: Unofficial Proton Mail integration via Proton Mail Bridge: send, read, search and organize email, with dry-run bulk operations and a read-only mode.
entries.zh: 通过 Proton Mail Bridge 的非官方 Proton Mail 集成：发送、读取、搜索和整理邮件，支持批量操作试运行和只读模式。

entries.english: Manage Inxmail Commerce transactional emails: events, sendings, bounces, blocklist and blacklist, reactions and delivery tracking.
entries.zh: 管理 Inxmail Commerce 事务邮件：事件、发送任务、退信、阻止列表和黑名单、回应及送达跟踪。

entries.english: Direct messaging for AI agents over the A2A protocol: inbox, friend list, group threads and per-friend memory for real-time chats with other people's agents.
entries.zh: 通过 A2A 协议为 AI 代理提供直接消息：收件箱、好友列表、群组主题和逐好友记忆，可与他人的代理实时聊天。

entries.english: Read and send email, and manage mailboxes, custom domains and webhooks via the QMailing API.
entries.zh: 通过 QMailing API 读取和发送邮件，并管理邮箱、自定义域名和 webhook。

entries.english: Email system for agents: message search, importance/urgency triage, commitment follow-through and reviewable drafts, keeping financial actions human-only.
entries.zh: 面向代理的邮件系统：消息搜索、按重要性/紧急程度分拣、承诺跟进和可审查草稿，财务操作仅限人类执行。

entries.english: Provision dedicated real-SIM US phone numbers, receive and poll inbound SMS, and extract OTP codes for phone verification.
entries.zh: 配置专用真实 SIM 美国电话号码、接收和轮询入站短信，并提取用于手机验证的 OTP 代码。

entries.english: Read-only Reddit API access: subreddit listings, post, comment, community and user search, comment trees and top posts.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Reddit API：子版块列表、帖子、评论、社区和用户搜索、评论树及热门帖子。

entries.english: Email (IMAP/SMTP), Sieve mail filters, CalDAV calendars, CardDAV contacts and free/busy scheduling for Open-Xchange and standards-based mail platforms.
entries.zh: 面向 Open-Xchange 和遵循标准的邮件平台，提供电子邮件（IMAP/SMTP）、Sieve 邮件过滤器、CalDAV 日历、CardDAV 联系人以及忙闲日程安排。

entries.english: Receive SMS verification codes on virtual phone numbers for services like WhatsApp, Telegram and Google: find and buy numbers and extract codes.
entries.zh: 在虚拟电话号码上接收 WhatsApp、Telegram 和 Google 等服务的短信验证码：查找和购买号码并提取代码。

entries.english: Access Mattermost teams, channels and messages, plus an MCP host running as a Mattermost bot that can use configured MCP servers.
entries.zh: 访问 Mattermost 团队、频道和消息，并提供作为 Mattermost 机器人运行、可使用已配置 MCP 服务器的 MCP 主机。

entries.english: Discord REST API: list channels, categories, roles and permission overwrites, with channel, role, guild and message management tools disabled by default.
entries.zh: Discord REST API：列出频道、分类、角色和权限覆盖；频道、角色、服务器和消息管理工具默认禁用。

entries.english: Email verification in real time, without sending anything: a valid, risky, invalid or unknown status with a score, disposable, role-based and catch-all detection, and typo suggestions. Remote server or local stdio package, hosted in France.
entries.zh: 实时验证邮箱地址而不发送任何内容：返回有效、有风险、无效或未知状态和评分，检测一次性、角色型及 catch-all 地址，并提供拼写建议。可使用远程服务器或本地 stdio 包，托管于法国。

entries.english: Send bots to browser-based meetings (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) to gather live transcripts, speak text and post in the meeting chat.
entries.zh: 将机器人送入基于浏览器的会议（Zoom、Teams、Google Meet），获取实时转录、朗读文本并在会议聊天中发言。

entries.english: Collaboration rooms for AI agents: create and join rooms and exchange real-time messages over MCP or A2A. Self-hostable.
entries.zh: AI 代理协作房间：创建并加入房间，通过 MCP 或 A2A 交换实时消息。可自托管。

entries.english: Slack DMs, channels, threads and search without an OAuth app or admin approval.
entries.zh: 无需 OAuth 应用或管理员批准即可访问 Slack 私信、频道、主题和搜索。

entries.english: iCloud Mail over IMAP and SMTP: search all folders, rebuild threads, save attachments, draft replies and file messages by rule, without marking mail as read.
entries.zh: 通过 IMAP 和 SMTP 访问 iCloud Mail：搜索所有文件夹、重建主题、保存附件、起草回复并按规则归档邮件，而不将邮件标记为已读。

entries.english: Telephony via Vonage APIs: automate voice calls with speech-to-text call summaries, send and receive SMS, and detect voicemail.
entries.zh: 通过 Vonage API 提供电话功能：自动拨打语音电话并生成语音转文字通话摘要，收发短信并检测语音信箱。

entries.english: Self-hosted email for multiple Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail or IMAP/SMTP accounts: search, read, threaded replies, drafts, allowlisted sending and attachments.
entries.zh: 面向多个 Gmail、iCloud、Fastmail 或 IMAP/SMTP 账号的自托管邮件：搜索、读取、主题式回复、草稿、白名单发送和附件。

entries.english: Slack workspace integration.
entries.zh: Slack 工作区集成。

entries.english: Bring an agent into live Google Meet or Zoom calls via a Chrome extension: read captions, answer in a side panel, post to chat and view shared screens.
entries.zh: 通过 Chrome 扩展将代理带入实时 Google Meet 或 Zoom 会议：读取字幕、在侧边栏回答、向聊天发消息并查看共享屏幕。

entries.english: Kudosity SMS, MMS and WhatsApp messaging: send messages, get delivery reports and replies, manage contacts and lists, configure webhooks and check balance.
entries.zh: Kudosity 的 SMS、MMS 和 WhatsApp 消息：发送消息、获取送达报告及回复、管理联系人和列表、配置 webhook 并检查余额。

entries.english: Local access to macOS apps: Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes, iMessage, Finder, Safari, OmniFocus, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive and Office documents.
entries.zh: 本地访问 macOS 应用：Mail、Calendar、Contacts、Reminders、Notes、iMessage、Finder、Safari、OmniFocus、Teams、Outlook、OneDrive 和 Office 文档。

entries.english: Telegram access with direct API calls, multi-user auth, an HTTP-MTProto bridge, file attachments and voice transcription.
entries.zh: 通过直接 API 调用访问 Telegram，支持多用户认证、HTTP-MTProto 桥接、文件附件和语音转录。

entries.english: Private, EU-hosted email for AI agents over JMAP: read, search, reply in-thread, organize and send, with sending pinned to the signed-in mailbox.
entries.zh: 通过 JMAP 为 AI 代理提供托管在欧盟的私密邮件：读取、搜索、主题内回复、整理和发送，发送固定使用已登录邮箱。

entries.english: Search personal WhatsApp messages and contacts, and send messages to individuals or groups.
entries.zh: 搜索个人 WhatsApp 消息及联系人，并向个人或群组发送消息。

entries.english: Read-only stats for public Telegram groups tracked by the Limzo anti-spam bot: leaderboards, activity trends, member levels and moderation summaries.
entries.zh: 只读查看 Limzo 反垃圾机器人跟踪的公开 Telegram 群组统计，包括排行榜、活动趋势、成员等级和审核摘要。

entries.english: Multi-agent communication hub with real-time messaging, task scheduling, shared memory, trust-based evolution and role-based access control.
entries.zh: 多代理通信中心，提供实时消息、任务调度、共享记忆、基于信任的演进和基于角色的访问控制。

entries.english: Manage WhatsApp Business message templates via the Meta Cloud API: create, validate and send all template types, including carousel, catalog and flows.
entries.zh: 通过 Meta Cloud API 管理 WhatsApp Business 消息模板：创建、验证和发送所有模板类型，包括轮播、目录和流程。

entries.english: Search an Outlook inbox, send emails, schedule meetings, manage contacts and configure mailbox settings.
entries.zh: 搜索 Outlook 收件箱、发送邮件、安排会议、管理联系人并配置邮箱设置。

entries.english: Check an email before an AI agent sends it: returns send, ask-a-human or block, with machine reason codes and prompt-injection detection.
entries.zh: AI 代理发送邮件前进行检查：返回发送、询问人类或阻止，并提供机器原因代码和提示词注入检测。

entries.english: Have an AI make phone calls on your behalf: book reservations, schedule appointments and view call transcripts.
entries.zh: 让 AI 代你拨打电话：预订、安排预约并查看通话转录。

entries.english: Restructure large Outlook/Hotmail mailboxes: move folder subtrees, bulk move and mark-read with dry-run previews, and manage inbox rules. Cannot send mail.
entries.zh: 重组大型 Outlook/Hotmail 邮箱：移动文件夹子树、批量移动和标记已读并提供试运行预览，以及管理收件箱规则。不能发送邮件。

entries.english: CalDAV calendars on any server (Yandex, Google, Nextcloud, iCloud and more): create events with recurrence, attendees and reminders, and search events.
entries.zh: 任意服务器上的 CalDAV 日历（Yandex、Google、Nextcloud、iCloud 等）：创建带重复规则、参与者和提醒的事件，并搜索事件。

entries.english: Email inboxes for agents that return one-time codes as a field. Addresses are permanent; messages expire after a configurable retention window.
entries.zh: 供代理使用的邮件收件箱，将一次性验证码作为字段返回。地址永久有效，消息在可配置的保留窗口后过期。

entries.english: Operate your own LINE bot: webhook queue health, failed jobs and retries, plus push, Rich Menu swap, follower insight and quota. LINE tools work with any Messaging API channel.
entries.zh: 操作自己的 LINE 机器人：查看 webhook 队列健康、失败作业与重试，并管理推送、Rich Menu 切换、关注者洞察和配额。LINE 工具适用于任何 Messaging API 频道。

entries.english: Unified email across Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and generic IMAP/SMTP: search, send, organize and batch-manage messages, with encrypted credential storage.
entries.zh: 统一 Gmail、Outlook、iCloud 和通用 IMAP/SMTP 邮件：搜索、发送、整理和批量管理消息，并加密保存凭据。

entries.english: Send, receive, monitor and reply to email with thread context via EngageLab Email.
entries.zh: 通过 EngageLab Email 发送、接收、监控和回复带主题上下文的邮件。

entries.english: Utility API tools for agents: schema generation, text extraction, token counting, regex and cron building, prompt optimization, web summarization and more.
entries.zh: 面向代理的实用 API 工具：模式生成、文本提取、token 计数、正则和 cron 构建、提示词优化、网页摘要等。

entries.english: Lets the LLM reach you by phone: live, interruptible voice calls and tiered alerts over self-hosted SIP, with whisper.cpp speech-to-text and macOS TTS.
entries.zh: 让大语言模型通过电话联系你：使用自托管 SIP 提供可实时打断的语音电话和分级提醒，使用 whisper.cpp 进行语音转文字和 macOS TTS。

entries.english: Email for AI agents: send and receive as Markdown with configurable human oversight (monitor, gate or fully autonomous).
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的邮件：以 Markdown 格式发送和接收，并可配置人工监督级别（监控、关卡或完全自主）。

entries.english: Contacts, groups and photos on any CardDAV server (Radicale, Baikal, Nextcloud, Fastmail, iCloud), with ETag-guarded writes and an address book allowlist.
entries.zh: 管理任意 CardDAV 服务器（Radicale、Baikal、Nextcloud、Fastmail、iCloud）上的联系人、群组和照片，提供 ETag 保护写入及通讯录白名单。

entries.english: Events, tasks and journal entries on any CalDAV server (Radicale, Nextcloud, Fastmail, iCloud), with a calendar allowlist and approval for series changes.
entries.zh: 管理任意 CalDAV 服务器（Radicale、Nextcloud、Fastmail、iCloud）上的事件、任务和日志条目，提供日历白名单，修改系列事件需要批准。

entries.english: Sequenzy email marketing automation: manage subscribers, lists, segments, templates, campaigns, sequences, transactional emails and analytics.
entries.zh: Sequenzy 邮件营销自动化：管理订阅者、列表、分组、模板、活动、序列、事务邮件和分析。

entries.english: Agent-to-agent networking: your agent publishes what you need and matches with other people's agents, and both humans approve before connecting.
entries.zh: 代理间联网：你的代理发布需求并匹配他人的代理，连接前双方人类均需批准。

entries.english: Control QQ via NapCatQQ (OneBot v11): send and receive messages, manage groups and wake the agent on incoming messages.
entries.zh: 通过 NapCatQQ（OneBot v11）控制 QQ：收发消息、管理群组，并在收到消息时唤醒代理。

entries.english: Apple Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes, Messages and Safari via AppleScript on macOS, or iCloud over IMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV elsewhere.
entries.zh: 在 macOS 上通过 AppleScript 访问 Apple Mail、Calendar、Contacts、Reminders、Notes、Messages 和 Safari；在其他环境通过 IMAP、CalDAV 和 CardDAV 访问 iCloud。

entries.english: Send, reply to and forward mail over SMTP, restricted to a recipient allowlist, with each message approved by a person before sending.
entries.zh: 通过 SMTP 发送、回复和转发邮件，限制为收件人白名单，每封邮件发送前均由人工批准。

entries.english: Self-hosted email for AI agents: mailboxes on your own domain, OTP and verification-link extraction, waiting for new mail, and a web dashboard.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的自托管邮件：使用自己域名的邮箱、提取 OTP 和验证链接、等待新邮件，并提供网页仪表盘。

entries.english: Send push notifications through ntfy, read back sent messages, update a notification in place while a job runs, and administer users and topic access.
entries.zh: 通过 ntfy 发送推送通知、读回已发消息、在作业运行时原位更新通知，以及管理用户和主题访问。

entries.english: Discord chat, moderation, automod, events and administration, including building a server from a description, with confirmation for destructive actions.
entries.zh: Discord 聊天、审核、自动审核、活动和管理，包括根据描述构建服务器；破坏性操作需要确认。

entries.english: Telegram via MTProto: read chats, search messages, download media and manage contacts, with QR code login.
entries.zh: 通过 MTProto 访问 Telegram：读取聊天、搜索消息、下载媒体和管理联系人，支持二维码登录。

entries.english: Send ChatterBox bots to Zoom and Google Meet meetings and get transcripts and recordings.
entries.zh: 将 ChatterBox 机器人送入 Zoom 和 Google Meet 会议，获取转录和录音。

entries.english: Call, text or push-notify the user's phone when an agent needs input mid-task, and let them reply by voice.
entries.zh: 代理任务中途需要输入时，向用户手机拨号、发送短信或推送通知，并允许语音回复。

entries.english: Calendars, contacts and tasks on any CalDAV/CardDAV server (Nextcloud, Baikal, Radicale, iCloud): 27 tools for events, vCards and VTODOs with field-level updates, server-side queries and free/busy, over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
entries.zh: 访问任意 CalDAV/CardDAV 服务器（Nextcloud、Baikal、Radicale、iCloud）上的日历、联系人和任务：提供 27 个事件、vCard 和 VTODO 工具，支持字段级更新、服务端查询和忙闲信息，可通过 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP 使用。

entries.english: Create and manage Carbon Voice voice messages, conversations, direct messages, folders, voice memos and AI actions.
entries.zh: 创建和管理 Carbon Voice 语音消息、会话、私信、文件夹、语音备忘录和 AI 操作。

entries.english: Schedule reminders, notifications and webhooks with the Pingfyr scheduled delivery API.
entries.zh: 使用 Pingfyr 定时投递 API 安排提醒、通知和 webhook。

entries.english: Rent virtual phone numbers worldwide, receive SMS and manage the full activation lifecycle via Platfone.
entries.zh: 通过 Platfone 在全球租用虚拟电话号码、接收短信并管理完整激活生命周期。

entries.english: Send physical postcards worldwide, individually or in bulk.
entries.zh: 向全球单独或批量发送实体明信片。

entries.english: Multi-guild Discord management: messages, channels, roles, forums, webhooks and moderation.
entries.zh: 多 Discord 服务器管理：消息、频道、角色、论坛、webhook 和审核。

entries.english: Group chat where people and AI agents talk in the same room: join by invite link, read and reply, wait for new messages, and send end-to-end encrypted whispers to one member.
entries.zh: 人类与 AI 代理在同一房间对话的群聊：通过邀请链接加入、阅读和回复、等待新消息，并向某个成员发送端到端加密私语。

entries.english: Middleware exposing aiogram Telegram bots via MCP: messaging, rich media, moderation, keyboards, real-time events, rate limiting, permissions and audit logs.
entries.zh: 通过 MCP 暴露 aiogram Telegram 机器人的中间件：消息、富媒体、审核、键盘、实时事件、速率限制、权限和审计日志。

entries.english: Send push notifications to iPhone, iPad and Mac via BotBell, with two-way replies, action buttons, Markdown and multi-bot management.
entries.zh: 通过 BotBell 向 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 发送推送通知，支持双向回复、操作按钮、Markdown 和多机器人管理。

entries.english: Interact with Discord and automate tasks.
entries.zh: 与 Discord 交互并自动执行任务。

entries.english: Feature-complete Discord MCP server with 117 native tools, dual user/bot account support, anti-abuse human pacing, and dynamic aesthetic symbol discovery.
entries.zh: 功能完整的 Discord MCP 服务器，提供 117 个原生工具、用户/机器人双账号支持、防滥用的人类节奏控制和动态美学符号发现。

entries.english: Let two agents on machines with no public address talk directly: pair with a short code over an end-to-end encrypted relay (hosted or self-hosted), send files, and invite saved contacts by name.
entries.zh: 让没有公网地址的两台机器上的代理直接通信：通过端到端加密中继（托管或自托管）使用短码配对、发送文件，并按名称邀请已保存联系人。

entries.english: Local access to Hey.com email via a cached session: read, search, send, reply and manage the Screener.
entries.zh: 通过缓存会话在本地访问 Hey.com 邮件：读取、搜索、发送、回复和管理 Screener。

entries.english: Email inboxes for AI agents via Sendmux: receive, search and send mail.
entries.zh: 通过 Sendmux 为 AI 代理提供邮件收件箱：接收、搜索和发送邮件。

entries.english: Viber Bot REST API: send text, media, files, locations and contacts, broadcast messages, manage webhooks and inspect account and user details.
entries.zh: Viber Bot REST API：发送文本、媒体、文件、位置和联系人，广播消息、管理 webhook 并查看账号及用户详情。

entries.english: Read, search and send email with Zoho Mail.
entries.zh: 使用 Zoho Mail 读取、搜索和发送邮件。

entries.english: Connect to Microsoft Office and the Microsoft 365 suite via the Graph API, including Outlook mail, files, Excel and calendar.
entries.zh: 通过 Graph API 连接 Microsoft Office 和 Microsoft 365 套件，包括 Outlook 邮件、文件、Excel 和日历。

entries.english: Serverless form backend, lead triage and contact form generator for static sites, React and JAMstack apps.
entries.zh: 面向静态网站、React 和 JAMstack 应用的无服务器表单后端、销售线索分拣和联系表单生成器。

entries.english: Phone numbers and voice for AI agents: make and receive calls, send email and manage contacts.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的电话号码和语音服务：拨打和接听电话、发送邮件并管理联系人。

entries.english: Multi-account email over IMAP, SMTP, Exchange Web Services and Microsoft Graph: read, search, send, reply, forward, bulk operations and attachment downloads.
entries.zh: 通过 IMAP、SMTP、Exchange Web Services 和 Microsoft Graph 管理多账号邮件：读取、搜索、发送、回复、转发、批量操作和下载附件。

entries.english: Terminal Telegram client over MTProto: CLI for messages, media and contacts, plus an MCP server that sends notifications when new messages arrive.
entries.zh: 通过 MTProto 使用终端 Telegram 客户端：消息、媒体和联系人的 CLI，以及在新消息到达时发送通知的 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Send and read SMS through your own Android phone via textbee, the open-source SMS gateway, including replies, codes and delivery status.
entries.zh: 通过自己的 Android 手机使用开源短信网关 textbee 收发短信，包括回复、验证码和送达状态。

entries.english: Tools for neurodivergent professionals: corporate-ambiguity translator, planner, and a guardrail against amplifying rumination, hyperfocus or sycophancy.
entries.zh: 面向神经多样性专业人士的工具：企业模糊表述翻译器、规划器，以及防止放大反刍、过度专注或逢迎的防护机制。

entries.english: Manage DIDLogic SIP endpoints, numbers and destinations.
entries.zh: 管理 DIDLogic SIP 端点、号码和目标。

entries.english: Send transactional email, authenticate sending domains, track delivery and diagnose deliverability, with scoped API keys and dry-run mode.
entries.zh: 发送事务邮件、验证发件域名、跟踪送达并诊断送达问题，支持限定范围的 API 密钥和试运行模式。

entries.english: WhatsApp through the WSAPI REST API: send messages and media, and manage chats, groups, communities and contacts on a connected number. Open source, self-hosted or managed.
entries.zh: 通过 WSAPI REST API 使用 WhatsApp：在关联号码上发送消息和媒体，并管理聊天、群组、社区及联系人。开源，可自托管或使用托管服务。

entries.english: Read iMessage data on macOS.
entries.zh: 在 macOS 上读取 iMessage 数据。

entries.english: Interact with JMAP (JSON Meta Application Protocol) email servers.
entries.zh: 与 JMAP（JSON Meta Application Protocol）邮件服务器交互。

entries.english: WhatsApp Business tools: send messages, automate workflows, run campaigns and manage CRM.
entries.zh: WhatsApp Business 工具：发送消息、自动化工作流、开展营销活动并管理 CRM。

entries.english: Manage Website Toolbox forums via the Forum REST API: categories, topics, posts, users, user groups, conversations, moderators, tags and page views.
entries.zh: 通过 Forum REST API 管理 Website Toolbox 论坛：分类、主题、帖子、用户、用户组、会话、版主、标签和页面浏览量。

entries.english: Read-only, self-hosted search over multiple IMAP accounts, mirrored by mbsync into a local notmuch index. Cannot send, delete or move mail.
entries.zh: 自托管、只读搜索多个 IMAP 账号，由 mbsync 镜像到本地 notmuch 索引。不能发送、删除或移动邮件。

entries.english: Run AI agents in Zulip as @mentionable bots or connect Zulip to any MCP client, with real-time listening, session management and file handling.
entries.zh: 在 Zulip 中将 AI 代理作为可 @提及的机器人运行，或将 Zulip 连接到任意 MCP 客户端，支持实时监听、会话管理和文件处理。

entries.english: Send email through your own Amazon SES account, and check domain verification, the suppression list and sandbox status. Works with any SES account; a Wraps deploy adds send history and delivery events. `npx -y @wraps.dev/mcp`
entries.zh: 通过自己的 Amazon SES 账号发送邮件，并检查域名验证、抑制列表和沙箱状态。适用于任意 SES 账号；Wraps 部署可增加发送历史和送达事件。`npx -y @wraps.dev/mcp`

entries.english: Manage NAVER WORKS messages, calendar, drive, mail, tasks and boards, also available as a CLI.
entries.zh: 管理 NAVER WORKS 消息、日历、云盘、邮件、任务和看板，也提供 CLI。

entries.english: Coldrig cold-email infrastructure run by your agent: buy domains, provision mailboxes, warm up, run sequences and handle replies.
entries.zh: 由代理运行的 Coldrig 冷邮件基础设施：购买域名、配置邮箱、预热、执行序列并处理回复。

entries.english: WhatsApp integration with a web admin UI (QR login, status, settings), two-way media upload and download, and SQLite persistence.
entries.zh: WhatsApp 集成，提供网页管理界面（二维码登录、状态、设置）、双向媒体上传下载和 SQLite 持久化。

entries.english: Read Outlook email attachments via Microsoft Graph, parsing PDF, Word (including embedded images), Excel and text files into structured content.
entries.zh: 通过 Microsoft Graph 读取 Outlook 邮件附件，将 PDF、Word（含嵌入图片）、Excel 和文本文件解析为结构化内容。

entries.english: Disposable email inboxes for AI agents with automatic OTP and magic-link extraction, for testing signups and auth flows.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的一次性邮件收件箱，自动提取 OTP 和魔法链接，用于测试注册及认证流程。

entries.english: Public Telegram channels without a user session: channel profiles, posts with view and forward counts, discussion threads and recommended channels.
entries.zh: 无需用户会话即可访问公开 Telegram 频道：频道资料、带浏览和转发次数的帖子、讨论主题和推荐频道。

entries.english: Manage and automate the Cognigy.AI conversational AI platform: flows, agents, snapshots, NLU, functions and deployment.
entries.zh: 管理并自动化 Cognigy.AI 对话式 AI 平台：流程、代理、快照、NLU、函数和部署。

entries.english: Tools from Lobby, an AI receptionist for small businesses: write phone scripts and IVR menus, generate ElevenLabs agent prompts and role-play calls.
entries.zh: Lobby 小企业 AI 接待员工具：编写电话脚本和 IVR 菜单、生成 ElevenLabs 代理提示词并进行电话角色扮演。

entries.english: Cloudflare Workers AI inference: LLM chat completions (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek), BGE text embeddings and Flux image generation.
entries.zh: Cloudflare Workers AI 推理：大语言模型聊天补全（Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek）、BGE 文本嵌入和 Flux 图像生成。

entries.english: Design Perspective AI conversation agents that replace static forms, analyze conversations, deploy embeds and automate follow-ups.
entries.zh: 设计 Perspective AI 对话代理，以取代静态表单、分析会话、部署嵌入组件并自动跟进。

entries.english: Build and test Vapi phone agents: vertical templates, self-testing agents, audio forensics, prompt versioning and CI regression gates.
entries.zh: 构建和测试 Vapi 电话代理：行业模板、自测代理、音频取证、提示词版本管理和 CI 回归关卡。

entries.english: Build and operate AI agents on the Zihin.ai platform: manage agents, schemas, triggers, budgets and approvals, run diagnostics and chat with your agents.
entries.zh: 在 Zihin.ai 平台构建和运行 AI 代理：管理代理、模式、触发器、预算和批准，运行诊断并与代理聊天。

entries.english: On-chain Ed25519 identity for AI agents: verify seals by fingerprint, validate document signatures and gate irreversible actions behind human-signed approvals.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的链上 Ed25519 身份：按指纹验证印章、验证文档签名，并在不可逆操作前要求人工签名批准。

entries.english: Encrypt and decrypt messages with historically accurate Enigma machine emulators from the enigmapython library.
entries.zh: 使用 enigmapython 库中忠实于历史的 Enigma 机器模拟器加密和解密消息。

entries.english: Verify AI-agent evidence records on the Bitcoin-anchored JIDEC ledger: fetch record bytes, recompute the SHA-256 and check the OpenTimestamps timestamp.
entries.zh: 在锚定 Bitcoin 的 JIDEC 账本上验证 AI 代理证据记录：获取记录字节、重新计算 SHA-256，并检查 OpenTimestamps 时间戳。

entries.english: Offline byte toolbox: hex/Base64/Base58 encoding, cryptographic and CRC hashing, base conversion, secure tokens, plus optional Ethereum/EVM tools.
entries.zh: 离线字节工具箱：十六进制/Base64/Base58 编码、密码学和 CRC 哈希、进制转换、安全 token，以及可选的 Ethereum/EVM 工具。

entries.english: Verify blockchain-anchored timestamp proofs locally: recompute a file's SHA-256, walk the Merkle path and check the anchor on Polygon or Bitcoin.
entries.zh: 在本地验证区块链锚定的时间戳证明：重新计算文件 SHA-256、遍历 Merkle 路径，并检查 Polygon 或 Bitcoin 上的锚点。

entries.english: B2B lead enrichment via Hunter.io and Apollo: email discovery, domain search, company data and contact verification.
entries.zh: 通过 Hunter.io 和 Apollo 丰富 B2B 销售线索：发现电子邮件、搜索域名、公司数据和联系人验证。

entries.english: Gender from names, emails and usernames via NameGender, with probability, sample size and source on every answer, bulk lookups of up to 100 values and the countries a name is recorded in.
entries.zh: 通过 NameGender 根据姓名、电子邮件和用户名推断性别，每个结果提供概率、样本量和来源，支持最多 100 个值的批量查询及姓名记录所在国家。

entries.english: Data center, power and gas intelligence from DC Hub: facilities, US power market scores, M&A deals, ISO grid telemetry, fiber routes and energy prices.
entries.zh: DC Hub 数据中心、电力和天然气情报：设施、美国电力市场评分、并购交易、ISO 电网遥测、光纤线路和能源价格。

entries.english: Track company events such as funding, senior hires, partnerships and expansion, with dated, weighted signals, natural-language queries and watch alerts.
entries.zh: 跟踪公司事件，如融资、高管招聘、合作和扩张，提供带日期和权重的信号、自然语言查询和关注提醒。

entries.english: Manage Pipedrive CRM deals, persons, organizations, activities, products, projects, tasks, leads, notes and mail, with opt-in delete tools.
entries.zh: 管理 Pipedrive CRM 商机、个人、组织、活动、产品、项目、任务、线索、笔记和邮件；删除工具需主动启用。

entries.english: amoCRM / Kommo CRM: leads, contacts, tasks and notes, plus sales analytics - pipeline report with win rate and manager leaderboard, stale deals, overdue tasks.
entries.zh: amoCRM / Kommo CRM：线索、联系人、任务和笔记，以及销售分析，包括带胜率和经理排行榜的销售漏斗报告、停滞交易和逾期任务。

entries.english: Company technographics from hiring data: find companies adopting, replacing or evaluating technologies and enrich domains with firmographics and hiring signals.
entries.zh: 从招聘数据获取企业技术画像：查找采用、替换或评估技术的公司，并为域名补充企业画像和招聘信号。

entries.english: ICTCRM, an open-source CRM with built-in telephony: read contact groups, with opt-in tools to create and delete contacts and add them to calling campaigns.
entries.zh: ICTCRM，内置电话功能的开源 CRM：读取联系人组，可主动启用创建和删除联系人及将其加入呼叫活动的工具。

entries.english: Statistical analysis, forecasting and ML on CSV files or live data from Shopify, Stripe, GA4 and more, with interactive HTML reports.
entries.zh: 对 CSV 文件或 Shopify、Stripe、GA4 等实时数据进行统计分析、预测和机器学习，并生成交互式 HTML 报告。

entries.english: Builds a finished influencer lead list end to end: keyword or niche discovery, the profile read, and the link in bio check, with newsletter status and contact emails per row.
entries.zh: 端到端构建完整网红销售线索列表：通过关键词或细分领域发现、读取资料、检查个人简介链接，并为每行提供通讯订阅状态和联系邮箱。

entries.english: Combines hiring and tech stack signals into a composite GTM intelligence brief with overall signal scoring per company.
entries.zh: 将招聘和技术栈信号组合为市场拓展情报简报，提供逐公司的综合信号评分。

entries.english: Score a company against a weighted ideal customer profile, returning a 0-100 score, an A/B/C tier and a per-signal breakdown.
entries.zh: 依据加权理想客户画像对公司评分，返回 0–100 分、A/B/C 等级和逐信号明细。

entries.english: Finds people at a company by role, seniority, and department, and returns structured contact records with an optional verified business email.
entries.zh: 按角色、资历和部门查找公司人员，返回结构化联系人记录，可选择提供经验证的商务邮箱。

entries.english: Bitrix24 CRM via inbound webhook: search and edit deals, leads, contacts, tasks and timeline comments, plus sales analytics — pipeline report with manager leaderboard, stale deals and overdue tasks.
entries.zh: 通过入站 webhook 访问 Bitrix24 CRM：搜索和编辑商机、线索、联系人、任务和时间线评论，并提供销售分析，包括经理排行榜、停滞商机和逾期任务的销售漏斗报告。

entries.english: Open-source customer feedback platform: search and triage posts, update statuses, comment, vote, manage roadmaps, merge duplicates and publish changelogs.
entries.zh: 开源客户反馈平台：搜索和分拣帖子、更新状态、评论、投票、管理路线图、合并重复项并发布更新日志。

entries.english: Manage questions and options of YaniFend, a WordPress feedback widget, and read collected answers.
entries.zh: 管理 WordPress 反馈组件 YaniFend 的问题和选项，并读取收集的回答。

entries.english: Scrupp: export LinkedIn, Sales Navigator and Apollo searches, find decision makers, and find and verify work emails.
entries.zh: Scrupp：导出 LinkedIn、Sales Navigator 和 Apollo 搜索结果，查找决策者，并查找和验证工作邮箱。

entries.english: Google Search Console SEO tools: search analytics, URL inspection, sitemap management, keyword opportunities, brand analysis and performance comparison.
entries.zh: Google Search Console SEO 工具：搜索分析、URL 检查、站点地图管理、关键词机会、品牌分析和性能比较。

entries.english: Interact with Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
entries.zh: 与 Google Search Console 和 Bing Webmaster Tools 交互。

entries.english: Governed MySQL + MariaDB DBA operations — slow-query, lock-wait/deadlock, replication, and fragmentation RCA, plus guardrailed writes (35 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理的 MySQL 和 MariaDB DBA 操作：慢查询、锁等待/死锁、复制及碎片化根因分析，以及带防护的写入（35 个工具）、不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护、试运行和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Manage Percona Operator for PostgreSQL clusters: PgBouncer pooling, tuning, backups and PITR, DR and major upgrades, with gated destructive actions.
entries.zh: 管理 Percona Operator for PostgreSQL 集群：PgBouncer 连接池、调优、备份和时间点恢复、灾备及大版本升级，破坏性操作受关卡控制。

entries.english: ClickHouse schema exploration, analytical queries and management, with statements gated by access mode, row caps and auditing.
entries.zh: ClickHouse 模式探索、分析查询和管理，语句受访问模式、行数上限和审计约束。

entries.english: Governed Redis + RabbitMQ operations — memory-pressure, latency, backlog, and churn RCA, plus guardrailed queue and key operations (28 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理地操作 Redis 和 RabbitMQ：分析内存压力、延迟、积压和波动根因，并提供带防护的队列及键操作（28 个工具）、不可绕过的 MCP + CLI 审计日志、预算及失控保护和撤销/回滚。

entries.english: Natural-language questions over Postgres, Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, DuckDB and SQLite; generated SQL is validated deterministically before running.
entries.zh: 对 Postgres、Oracle、Snowflake、Databricks、DuckDB 和 SQLite 使用自然语言提问；生成的 SQL 在运行前经过确定性验证。

entries.english: Governed PostgreSQL DBA operations: slow-query, bloat and lock analysis, index management, vacuum and replication lag, with audit logs and rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理的 PostgreSQL DBA 操作：慢查询、膨胀和锁分析、索引管理、vacuum 和复制延迟，支持审计日志和回滚。

entries.english: Safe, read-only SQLite MCP server with auto schema discovery, row limits, and structured AI error handling.
entries.zh: 安全的只读 SQLite MCP 服务器，支持自动发现模式、行数限制和结构化 AI 错误处理。

entries.english: Navigate Aiven projects and interact with PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, ClickHouse and OpenSearch services.
entries.zh: 浏览 Aiven 项目，并与 PostgreSQL、Apache Kafka、ClickHouse 和 OpenSearch 服务交互。

entries.english: Execute SQL queries and explore Supabase databases.
entries.zh: 执行 SQL 查询并探索 Supabase 数据库。

entries.english: Manage, monitor and query data in CockroachDB.
entries.zh: 管理、监控并查询 CockroachDB 中的数据。

entries.english: Work with PostgreSQL and MySQL within clear boundaries: schema discovery, sampling, read-only queries and query-plan inspection.
entries.zh: 在明确边界内使用 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL：模式发现、采样、只读查询和查询计划检查。

entries.english: Access PostgreSQL databases, including those behind an SSH bastion.
entries.zh: 访问 PostgreSQL 数据库，包括位于 SSH 堡垒机之后的数据库。

entries.english: Manage Appwrite databases, auth, users, functions, storage, messaging and more.
entries.zh: 管理 Appwrite 数据库、认证、用户、函数、存储、消息等。

entries.english: Built into ArcadeDB, a multi-model database (graph, document, key-value, time-series, vector) with SQL, Cypher, Gremlin and MongoDB QL support.
entries.zh: 内置于多模型数据库 ArcadeDB，支持图、文档、键值、时间序列和向量，以及 SQL、Cypher、Gremlin 和 MongoDB QL。

entries.english: Read-only Postgres access with SQL compiled from your own definitions, PII refusal and a tamper-evident audit chain.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Postgres：由你自己的定义编译 SQL，拒绝个人身份信息，并提供防篡改审计链。

entries.english: Selects the schema objects a SQL agent sees and returns only the tables the calling principal may read, on Postgres, Oracle, MySQL and SQL Server.
entries.zh: 为 SQL 代理筛选可见模式对象，在 Postgres、Oracle、MySQL 和 SQL Server 上仅返回调用主体有权读取的表。

entries.english: Operate Docker-based local-ydb deployments locally or over SSH: bootstrap, diagnostics, auth hardening, storage workflows, dump/restore and upgrades.
entries.zh: 在本地或通过 SSH 操作基于 Docker 的 local-ydb 部署：初始化、诊断、认证加固、存储工作流、转储/恢复和升级。

entries.english: MySQL database integration with configurable access controls and schema inspection.
entries.zh: MySQL 数据库集成，提供可配置的访问控制和模式检查。

entries.english: Baserow database integration: search and list tables, and create, read, update and delete rows.
entries.zh: Baserow 数据库集成：搜索和列出表，并创建、读取、更新和删除行。

entries.english: Automatically generate APIs from database schema and data for PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and Supabase.
entries.zh: 根据 PostgreSQL、ClickHouse、MySQL、Snowflake、BigQuery 和 Supabase 的数据库模式和数据自动生成 API。

entries.english: DICOM integration to query, read and move medical images and reports from PACS and other DICOM-compliant systems.
entries.zh: DICOM 集成，从 PACS 和其他符合 DICOM 标准的系统查询、读取和移动医学图像与报告。

entries.english: Access local and cloud Chroma instances for retrieval.
entries.zh: 访问本地和云端 Chroma 实例进行检索。

entries.english: Microsoft Dataverse: entity CRUD, FetchXML and OData queries, metadata inspection, workflow execution, audit logs and Power Platform integration.
entries.zh: Microsoft Dataverse：实体增删改查、FetchXML 和 OData 查询、元数据检查、执行工作流、审计日志和 Power Platform 集成。

entries.english: Confluent integration to interact with Confluent Kafka and Confluent Cloud REST APIs.
entries.zh: Confluent 集成，用于与 Confluent Kafka 和 Confluent Cloud REST API 交互。

entries.english: Tunnel-based bridge connecting local and on-premise databases (such as MSSQL) to LLMs, with AST-based query safety and PII masking.
entries.zh: 基于隧道的桥接，将本地和内部部署数据库（如 MSSQL）连接到大语言模型，支持基于 AST 的查询安全和个人身份信息脱敏。

entries.english: Unified access to Couchbase Capella and self-managed clusters for document operations, SQL++ queries and natural-language data analysis.
entries.zh: 统一访问 Couchbase Capella 和自管理集群，进行文档操作、SQL++ 查询及自然语言数据分析。

entries.english: Manage many SQL Server instances from one config, grouped by client or environment, with execution plans, index audits and stored-procedure analysis.
entries.zh: 通过一份配置管理多个 SQL Server 实例，可按客户或环境分组，提供执行计划、索引审计和存储过程分析。

entries.english: Local, contract-governed federation across files and databases (Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, DuckDB, Excel) with read-only guards and PII masking.
entries.zh: 跨文件和数据库（Postgres、Snowflake、BigQuery、DuckDB、Excel）的本地契约治理联邦查询，提供只读保护和个人身份信息脱敏。

entries.english: Read-only MySQL database access.
entries.zh: 只读访问 MySQL 数据库。

entries.english: Debug Apache Kafka: find messages by key or field, measure consumer lag and when it clears, unblock stuck consumers and compare clusters. Read-only endpoints and a preview before every write.
entries.zh: 调试 Apache Kafka：按键或字段查找消息、测量消费者延迟及其消除时间、解除卡住的消费者并比较集群。提供只读端点，每次写入前均预览。

entries.english: PostgreSQL catalog introspection, AST-validated query execution, index tuning, natural-language SQL, and pgvector, TimescaleDB and AGE integrations.
entries.zh: PostgreSQL 目录自省、经过 AST 验证的查询执行、索引调优、自然语言 SQL，以及 pgvector、TimescaleDB 和 AGE 集成。

entries.english: NocoDB database integration with read and write capabilities.
entries.zh: 具备读写能力的 NocoDB 数据库集成。

entries.english: Read-only SQL Server introspection for .NET projects: schema, DDL, dependency graphs, index health and data profiling, reading connection strings from appsettings.json or web.config, and reporting which GRANTs the login lacks.
entries.zh: 面向 .NET 项目的只读 SQL Server 自省：模式、DDL、依赖图、索引健康和数据剖析；从 appsettings.json 或 web.config 读取连接字符串，并报告登录账号缺少哪些 GRANT 权限。

entries.english: Read-only PostgreSQL access: AST-validated queries in read-only transactions, schema inspection, column redaction, EXPLAIN cost guard and audit log.
entries.zh: 只读访问 PostgreSQL：在只读事务中执行经 AST 验证的查询，支持模式检查、列脱敏、EXPLAIN 成本保护和审计日志。

entries.english: Local server for memvid storage and semantic search.
entries.zh: 用于 memvid 存储和语义搜索的本地服务器。

entries.english: Access Firebird databases registered in FlameRobin: schema introspection, DDL/DML execution, execution plans and missing index analysis.
entries.zh: 访问 FlameRobin 中注册的 Firebird 数据库：模式自省、执行 DDL/DML、执行计划和缺失索引分析。

entries.english: Static analysis of Django ORM schemas without a database: models, relationships, migration dependencies, missing indexes, ER diagrams and signal graphs.
entries.zh: 无需数据库即可静态分析 Django ORM 模式：模型、关系、迁移依赖、缺失索引、ER 图和信号图。

entries.english: Execute SQL via ConnectorX and stream results to CSV or Parquet files, supporting PostgreSQL, MariaDB, BigQuery, Redshift, SQL Server and more.
entries.zh: 通过 ConnectorX 执行 SQL，并将结果流式写入 CSV 或 Parquet 文件，支持 PostgreSQL、MariaDB、BigQuery、Redshift、SQL Server 等。

entries.english: Open-source server providing easy, fast and secure database tools.
entries.zh: 提供简单、快速和安全数据库工具的开源服务器。

entries.english: Read-only MCP server for Huawei GaussDB (centralized & distributed) built for coding agents: three-layer write protection (hardened static SQL validation, server-enforced read-only transactions, least-privilege account guidance), multi-instance config, schema/table exploration and single-SELECT execution. Designed for production and intranet non-SSL environments.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理的华为 GaussDB（集中式及分布式）只读 MCP 服务器：三层写入保护（强化静态 SQL 验证、服务器强制只读事务、最小权限账号指导）、多实例配置、模式/表浏览和单条 SELECT 执行。为生产及内网非 SSL 环境设计。

entries.english: Google Sheets automation tools.
entries.zh: Google Sheets 自动化工具。

entries.english: Hydrolix time-series datalake integration with schema exploration and query capabilities.
entries.zh: Hydrolix 时间序列数据湖集成，支持模式探索和查询。

entries.english: Retrieval over your own data with Infino (BM25 full-text, vector, hybrid and SQL), an embedded engine on Apache Parquet over object storage.
entries.zh: 通过 Infino 对自己的数据进行检索（BM25 全文、向量、混合和 SQL）；它是面向对象存储上 Apache Parquet 的嵌入式引擎。

entries.english: Interact with InfluxDB 3 Core, Enterprise and Cloud Dedicated.
entries.zh: 与 InfluxDB 3 Core、Enterprise 和 Cloud Dedicated 交互。

entries.english: Read-only access to PostgreSQL, Oracle and SQL Server via JDBC: schema discovery, query validation, execution plans, benchmarking and index analysis.
entries.zh: 通过 JDBC 只读访问 PostgreSQL、Oracle 和 SQL Server：模式发现、查询验证、执行计划、基准测试和索引分析。

entries.english: Compile, syntax-check and generate deployment deeplinks for TON smart contracts with the Tolk compiler.
entries.zh: 使用 Tolk 编译器编译、检查语法，并为 TON 智能合约生成部署深度链接。

entries.english: One server for Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB and OpenAPI REST APIs. Every query is checked against a per-table policy, connections are read-only at the database level, results are redacted, and every call is audited per agent.
entries.zh: 一个服务器支持 Postgres、MySQL、SQLite、MongoDB 和 OpenAPI REST API。每条查询均按逐表策略检查，连接在数据库层只读，结果被脱敏，并按代理审计每次调用。

entries.english: Manage and analyze Apache Druid clusters with tools, resources and prompts.
entries.zh: 使用工具、资源和提示词管理并分析 Apache Druid 集群。

entries.english: Committed, offline snapshots of database structure and column statistics: value lists, null rates, joins. No live connection.
entries.zh: 数据库结构和列统计的已提交离线快照：值列表、空值率和连接关系。无需实时连接。

entries.english: PostgreSQL-backed persistent memory, task tracker and multi-agent coordination hub for AI assistants.
entries.zh: 基于 PostgreSQL 的持久记忆、任务跟踪器和 AI 助手多代理协调中心。

entries.english: PostgreSQL querying, schema exploration and table analysis, read-only by default with SQL injection prevention.
entries.zh: PostgreSQL 查询、模式探索和表分析；默认只读，并防范 SQL 注入。

entries.english: Interact with SQLite databases.
entries.zh: 与 SQLite 数据库交互。

entries.english: Query SQLite, PostgreSQL, BigQuery and Databricks in natural language through a business semantic layer: glossary, metrics and a data dictionary.
entries.zh: 通过业务语义层以自然语言查询 SQLite、PostgreSQL、BigQuery 和 Databricks，提供术语表、指标和数据字典。

entries.english: Read-only Trino and Apache Pinot access for agents: every query is priced from the engine's own plan before it runs and refused if it's over budget.
entries.zh: 供代理只读访问 Trino 和 Apache Pinot：每条查询运行前依据引擎自己的计划估算价格，超过预算则拒绝。

entries.english: Firestore schema context for coding agents: scans live collections and returns real field names, types and presence rates to prevent hallucinated queries.
entries.zh: 供编码代理使用的 Firestore 模式上下文：扫描实时集合，返回真实字段名、类型和出现率，防止生成虚构查询。

entries.english: Read-only SQL Server access with AST-based query validation, schema exploration, ER diagrams and DBA toolkits like First Responder Kit and sp_WhoIsActive.
entries.zh: 只读访问 SQL Server，提供基于 AST 的查询验证、模式探索、ER 图以及 First Responder Kit 和 sp_WhoIsActive 等 DBA 工具包。

entries.english: Check PostgreSQL migrations against lock-safety rules before an agent applies them, offline and without a database.
entries.zh: 在代理应用 PostgreSQL 迁移前离线检查锁安全规则，无需数据库。

entries.english: Unified read-only tools for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite: list databases and tables, describe tables and run queries, enforced at SQL and database level.
entries.zh: 为 PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 SQLite 提供统一只读工具：列出数据库和表、描述表并运行查询，在 SQL 和数据库层强制只读。

entries.english: Access the MongoDB Atlas API.
entries.zh: 访问 MongoDB Atlas API。

entries.english: Official Nhost MCP server, bundled with the Nhost CLI. Lets AI coding assistants read your GraphQL schema, run the queries and mutations you allow, manage permissions and migrations, update Nhost Cloud project config, and search the docs.
entries.zh: 官方 Nhost MCP 服务器，随 Nhost CLI 提供。让 AI 编码助手读取 GraphQL 模式、运行你允许的查询与变更、管理权限和迁移、更新 Nhost Cloud 项目配置并搜索文档。

entries.english: Self-hosted natural-language-to-SQL engine with validation for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and DuckDB, plus document QA and semantic caching.
entries.zh: 可自托管的自然语言转 SQL 引擎，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、Snowflake、BigQuery 和 DuckDB 的验证，并提供文档问答和语义缓存。

entries.english: Generic database (DBMS) connectivity via JDBC.
entries.zh: 通过 JDBC 连接通用数据库（DBMS）。

entries.english: Generic database (DBMS) connectivity via ODBC.
entries.zh: 通过 ODBC 连接通用数据库（DBMS）。

entries.english: Generic database (DBMS) connectivity via SQLAlchemy using pyodbc.
entries.zh: 使用 pyodbc 通过 SQLAlchemy 连接通用数据库（DBMS）。

entries.english: SQLite operations: query databases, inspect schemas, explain queries and export data.
entries.zh: SQLite 操作：查询数据库、检查模式、解释查询并导出数据。

entries.english: Secure access to PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite databases with parameterized queries and schema inspection.
entries.zh: 通过参数化查询和模式检查安全访问 PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 SQLite 数据库。

entries.english: Built into the PlanetScale CLI: direct access to your PlanetScale databases.
entries.zh: 内置于 PlanetScale CLI，直接访问你的 PlanetScale 数据库。

entries.english: Drive the QuestDB Web Console: notebook cells, SQL queries and charts on live time-series data.
entries.zh: 驱动 QuestDB Web Console：在实时序列数据上使用笔记本单元、SQL 查询和图表。

entries.english: Serve any JSON file (catalogue, FAQ, price list) as read-only list, keyword search and get-by-id tools over stdio, configured with CLI flags.
entries.zh: 将任意 JSON 文件（目录、FAQ、价格表）以 stdio 只读列表、关键词搜索和按 ID 获取工具的形式提供，通过 CLI 标志配置。

entries.english: Inspect and operate Redis-backed Asynq and BullMQ job queues: per-state counts, decoded job payloads and errors, retry and delete, with a read-only mode.
entries.zh: 检查和操作基于 Redis 的 Asynq 和 BullMQ 作业队列：按状态计数、解码作业负载及错误、重试和删除，并提供只读模式。

entries.english: Manage and search data in Redis.
entries.zh: 管理和搜索 Redis 中的数据。

entries.english: Query PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redshift and SQL Server over SSH or AWS SSM tunnels, with read-only enforcement, confined exports and pluggable secret providers.
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 或 AWS SSM 隧道查询 PostgreSQL、MySQL、Redshift 和 SQL Server，支持强制只读、受限导出和可插拔密钥服务商。

entries.english: Access legacy MySQL 5.0 to 5.6 databases: schema inspection and SELECT by default, with opt-in INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and DDL.
entries.zh: 访问旧版 MySQL 5.0 至 5.6 数据库：默认进行模式检查和 SELECT，可主动启用 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE 和 DDL。

entries.english: Safe, read-only database access with SQL guardrails, table allowlists, PII masking and audit logs.
entries.zh: 安全只读数据库访问，提供 SQL 防护规则、表白名单、个人身份信息脱敏和审计日志。

entries.english: Interact with the S2 serverless stream platform.
entries.zh: 与 S2 无服务器流平台交互。

entries.english: Connect to any relational database to get valid SQL and ask questions about the schema, such as what a column prefix means.
entries.zh: 连接任意关系数据库以获取有效 SQL 并询问模式问题，例如某列前缀的含义。

entries.english: Fill a PostgreSQL database with synthetic test data generated from its live schema: plan, run and track seeds without production data.
entries.zh: 根据 PostgreSQL 实时模式生成合成测试数据并填充数据库：规划、运行和跟踪种子数据，不使用生产数据。

entries.english: Redash integration: natural-language SQL with safety guards and PII detection, table selection, saved queries, dashboards, widgets and alerts.
entries.zh: Redash 集成：带安全防护和个人身份信息检测的自然语言 SQL、表选择、已保存查询、仪表盘、小组件和告警。

entries.english: Brazilian IBGE data: demographics, geography and economics, including localities, SIDRA tables, census data, population projections and geographic meshes.
entries.zh: 巴西 IBGE 数据：人口、地理和经济，包括地方、SIDRA 表、人口普查数据、人口预测和地理网格。

entries.english: Read-only SQL across PostgreSQL, MySQL, S3-compatible storage and Parquet/CSV/JSON files, with cross-source joins federated by DuckDB.
entries.zh: 跨 PostgreSQL、MySQL、兼容 S3 的存储和 Parquet/CSV/JSON 文件执行只读 SQL，通过 DuckDB 联邦实现跨源连接。

entries.english: Launch and delete serverless MariaDB Cloud databases, execute SQL and use database-level AI agents for text-to-SQL and conversations.
entries.zh: 启动和删除无服务器 MariaDB Cloud 数据库、执行 SQL，并使用数据库级 AI 代理进行文本转 SQL 和对话。

entries.english: Snowflake: prompt Cortex Agents, query structured and unstructured data, manage objects, run SQL and query semantic views, with RBAC and CRUD controls.
entries.zh: Snowflake：向 Cortex Agent 提示、查询结构化和非结构化数据、管理对象、运行 SQL 并查询语义视图，提供 RBAC 和增删改查控制。

entries.english: Design ERDs following naming standards: edit entities and relationships, import/export SQL and DBML, and diff the model against a live database.
entries.zh: 按照命名标准设计 ER 图：编辑实体和关系、导入/导出 SQL 与 DBML，并将模型与实时数据库比较。

entries.english: Generate a Java MCP server exposing only selected Oracle PL/SQL packages, tables, sequences and SQL statements as typed tools, with no generic SQL tool.
entries.zh: 生成 Java MCP 服务器，仅将选定 Oracle PL/SQL 包、表、序列和 SQL 语句作为类型化工具公开，不提供通用 SQL 工具。

entries.english: Connect to your Supabase project to manage tables, fetch config and query data.
entries.zh: 连接 Supabase 项目以管理表、获取配置和查询数据。

entries.english: Persistent schema memory for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL and SQLite: table and column annotations, a foreign-key graph and searchable notes. Read-only.
entries.zh: 供 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MSSQL 和 SQLite 使用的持久模式记忆：表和列注释、外键图和可搜索笔记。只读。

entries.english: Multi-database access for PostgreSQL, Redshift, CockroachDB, MySQL, RDS MySQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, Oracle and SQLite.
entries.zh: 为 PostgreSQL、Redshift、CockroachDB、MySQL、RDS MySQL、SQL Server、BigQuery、Oracle 和 SQLite 提供多数据库访问。

entries.english: Dialect-aware tools for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server: queries, schema introspection, optimization, migrations and PII scanning.
entries.zh: 感知数据库方言的 PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 SQL Server 工具：查询、模式自省、优化、迁移和个人身份信息扫描。

entries.english: Query SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL in plain language, read-only, with column hiding and masking, row caps, timeouts, cost-based rejection and rate limiting.
entries.zh: 以自然语言只读查询 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL，支持隐藏和遮盖列、行数上限、超时、基于成本拒绝及速率限制。

entries.english: Search URDB's product integrity database for integrity scores, enshittification events and change tracking across consumer products.
entries.zh: 搜索 URDB 产品诚信数据库，查看消费产品的诚信评分、产品恶化事件和变化跟踪。

entries.english: Integration with VictoriaLogs APIs and documentation for working with logs and debugging VictoriaLogs instances.
entries.zh: 集成 VictoriaLogs API 和文档，用于处理日志和调试 VictoriaLogs 实例。

entries.english: Use Weaviate collections as a knowledge base and as a chat memory store.
entries.zh: 将 Weaviate 集合作为知识库和聊天记忆存储。

entries.english: MSSQL database integration with schema inspection and query capabilities.
entries.zh: MSSQL 数据库集成，提供模式检查和查询能力。

entries.english: Security and management tools for libSQL databases.
entries.zh: libSQL 数据库的安全和管理工具。

entries.english: Snowflake access that works behind a corporate proxy, with read and optional write operations.
entries.zh: 可通过企业代理访问 Snowflake，支持读取和可选写入操作。

entries.english: Semantic gateway that turns common databases into MCP services, enriched with business metadata and parameterized SQL tools.
entries.zh: 语义网关，将常见数据库转换为 MCP 服务，并补充业务元数据和参数化 SQL 工具。

entries.english: Compile SQL and Prisma schemas to Zod, TypeScript and Pydantic, and generate realistic synthetic mock API data.
entries.zh: 将 SQL 和 Prisma 模式编译为 Zod、TypeScript 和 Pydantic，并生成逼真的合成模拟 API 数据。

entries.english: Interact with Milvus and Zilliz databases.
entries.zh: 与 Milvus 和 Zilliz 数据库交互。

entries.english: Inspect Apache Kafka topics and consumer groups and safely manage offsets (reset, rewind).
entries.zh: 检查 Apache Kafka 主题和消费者组，并安全管理偏移量（重置、回退）。

entries.english: Operations toolchain for SQLite, Cloudflare D1 and Turso: inspect, diff, migrate, monitor, back up and repair databases. Read-only by default.
entries.zh: 适用于 SQLite、Cloudflare D1 和 Turso 的运维工具链：检查、比较、迁移、监控、备份和修复数据库。默认只读。

entries.english: Read-only access to ERP SQL databases (Logo Tiger, Netsis, Mikro) through canonical entities like orders, with a guard that blocks side-effecting statements.
entries.zh: 通过订单等规范实体只读访问 ERP SQL 数据库（Logo Tiger、Netsis、Mikro），并使用防护机制阻止有副作用的语句。

entries.english: Monitor and manage Debezium and Kafka Connect CDC connectors, with access modes, connector allowlists, delete gating and credential redaction.
entries.zh: 监控和管理 Debezium 与 Kafka Connect CDC 连接器，支持访问模式、连接器白名单、删除关卡和凭据脱敏。

entries.english: Monitor and manage Apache Kafka clusters, topics and consumer groups (including lag), with access modes, topic allowlists and delete gating.
entries.zh: 监控和管理 Apache Kafka 集群、主题和消费者组（包括延迟），支持访问模式、主题白名单和删除关卡。

entries.english: Brazilian public data via BrasilAPI: companies (CNPJ), addresses (CEP), banks (BACEN) and national holidays.
entries.zh: 通过 BrasilAPI 获取巴西公共数据：企业（CNPJ）、地址（CEP）、银行（BACEN）和全国假日。

entries.english: Search and enrich company data: lookup by name, VAT or ID, NACE sector search, and financial data from official EU business registries.
entries.zh: 搜索和补充企业数据：按名称、增值税号或 ID 查询，按 NACE 行业搜索，并获取欧盟官方商业登记处的财务数据。

entries.english: Manage Apache Airflow via its REST API: list DAGs, inspect runs and task instances, trigger runs, and check failed DAGs and scheduler health.
entries.zh: 通过 REST API 管理 Apache Airflow：列出 DAG、检查运行和任务实例、触发运行，并检查失败 DAG 和调度器健康状态。

entries.english: Business intelligence: company and contact discovery, verification, enrichment, business signals, lists and governed delivery.
entries.zh: 商业情报：发现、验证和丰富公司及联系人信息，获取业务信号和列表，并受治理地交付。

entries.english: Pay-per-query x402 datasets: NPI healthcare, SEC filings, OFAC sanctions, crypto whales, Polymarket signals, patents and economic indicators.
entries.zh: 按次查询付费的 x402 数据集：NPI 医疗、SEC 文件、OFAC 制裁、加密巨鲸、Polymarket 信号、专利和经济指标。

entries.english: US government records (short-term rental permits, lodging licenses, property violations, healthcare exclusions, EPA ECHO) and Norwegian company data.
entries.zh: 美国政府记录（短租许可、住宿许可证、房产违规、医疗排除名单、EPA ECHO）及挪威企业数据。

entries.english: Data quality checks on DuckDB, BigQuery, Athena, Databricks and Postgres, with LLM root-cause analysis of failures and proposed SQL remediations.
entries.zh: 对 DuckDB、BigQuery、Athena、Databricks 和 Postgres 执行数据质量检查，并通过大语言模型分析失败根因和提出 SQL 修复方案。

entries.english: Local-first data quality workbench for Excel/CSV: validate against schemas and 10 zero-code constraint types (uniqueness, ranges, foreign keys, allowed values and more), with row-level error reports. Also ships a visual desktop app, CLI and REST API.
entries.zh: 面向 Excel/CSV 的本地优先数据质量工作台：依据模式和 10 类零代码约束（唯一性、范围、外键、允许值等）验证，并提供行级错误报告；还提供可视化桌面应用、CLI 和 REST API。

entries.english: Query Snowflake, Google BigQuery and Databricks data products in natural language through Alkemi.
entries.zh: 通过 Alkemi 以自然语言查询 Snowflake、Google BigQuery 和 Databricks 数据产品。

entries.english: Search and query public datasets from the World Bank, IMF, Eurostat, OECD and WHO, and publish charts.
entries.zh: 搜索和查询世界银行、IMF、Eurostat、OECD 和 WHO 的公共数据集，并发布图表。

entries.english: Query Swedish public data through Apiverket, including company data, SCB statistics, weather, transport and more.
entries.zh: 通过 Apiverket 查询瑞典公共数据，包括企业数据、SCB 统计、天气、交通等。

entries.english: Method CRM API integration: manage tables, files, users, events and API keys, with rate limiting and retries.
entries.zh: Method CRM API 集成：管理表、文件、用户、事件和 API 密钥，支持速率限制和重试。

entries.english: Kafka Schema Registry management across multiple registries, including schema migration.
entries.zh: 跨多个 Kafka Schema Registry 管理模式，包括模式迁移。

entries.english: Apache Superset: dashboards, charts, datasets, SQL Lab, security (users, roles, RLS, groups) and permissions audit, with built-in safety validations.
entries.zh: Apache Superset：仪表盘、图表、数据集、SQL Lab、安全（用户、角色、RLS、组）和权限审计，内置安全验证。

entries.english: Brazilian agricultural data: prices, crop estimates, climate and deforestation from public sources including CEPEA, CONAB, IBGE, INPE and B3.
entries.zh: 巴西农业数据：来自 CEPEA、CONAB、IBGE、INPE 和 B3 等公共来源的价格、作物估计、气候和森林砍伐信息。

entries.english: Query, create and update opportunities and contacts in VTENext, an open-source vtiger-based CRM, via its WebService API.
entries.zh: 通过 WebService API 查询、创建和更新 VTENext（基于 vtiger 的开源 CRM）中的商机与联系人。

entries.english: Search MercadoLibre products, get item details, browse categories, track trends and convert currencies across Latin America.
entries.zh: 搜索 MercadoLibre 产品、获取商品详情、浏览类别、跟踪趋势，并在拉丁美洲各地转换货币。

entries.english: Datanika, the open-source ELT and dbt platform: browse connections, preview data, run dbt transforms, monitor runs and manage pipelines. Read-only by default.
entries.zh: Datanika 开源 ELT 和 dbt 平台：浏览连接、预览数据、运行 dbt 转换、监控运行并管理流水线。默认只读。

entries.english: dbt integration: dbt Core and Cloud CLI, project metadata discovery, model information and semantic layer queries.
entries.zh: dbt 集成：dbt Core 和 Cloud CLI、项目元数据发现、模型信息及语义层查询。

entries.english: Search French building permits (Sitadel open data), cross-referenced with DVF transactions, PLU zoning and BRGM natural and technological risks.
entries.zh: 搜索法国建筑许可（Sitadel 开放数据），并与 DVF 交易、PLU 分区以及 BRGM 自然与技术风险数据交叉引用。

entries.english: Turn business documents (PDFs, invoices, contracts, payroll) into structured datasets with classification, field extraction, PII masking and quality scoring.
entries.zh: 将商业文档（PDF、发票、合同、工资单）转换为结构化数据集，支持分类、字段提取、个人身份信息脱敏和质量评分。

entries.english: Power BI refresh with table-level polling and retry, refresh diagnostics, DAX queries with RLS simulation, PBIP source locating and refresh reports.
entries.zh: Power BI 刷新：表级轮询与重试、刷新诊断、模拟 RLS 的 DAX 查询、PBIP 源定位和刷新报告。

entries.english: Operational ontology reference implementation: tools generated from a typed business domain model, with rule-checked, audited writes to systems of record.
entries.zh: 运营本体参考实现：从类型化业务领域模型生成工具，对记录系统的写入进行规则检查和审计。

entries.english: Open data for La Réunion (French overseas region) from data.gouv.fr and the regional portal: economy, demographics, transport, health, education and more.
entries.zh: 来自 data.gouv.fr 和地区门户的留尼汪（法国海外大区）开放数据，涵盖经济、人口、交通、健康、教育等。

entries.english: Greenhouse-gas emission factors and carbon calculations (activity, embodied EN 15978, PCAF financed emissions) with source references and data versions.
entries.zh: 温室气体排放因子与碳计算（活动、EN 15978 隐含碳、PCAF 融资排放），提供来源引用和数据版本。

entries.english: Run SQL queries, list jobs and get job status via the Databricks API.
entries.zh: 通过 Databricks API 运行 SQL 查询、列出作业并获取作业状态。

entries.english: Query Qlik Cloud apps and sheets and extract data from visualizations, with authentication and rate-limiting support.
entries.zh: 查询 Qlik Cloud 应用和工作表，并从可视化中提取数据，支持认证和速率限制。

entries.english: Interact with the Keboola Connection data platform: list and access data from the Keboola Storage API.
entries.zh: 与 Keboola Connection 数据平台交互：列出并通过 Keboola Storage API 访问数据。

entries.english: Move data between Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, MQTT, IBM MQ, SQL databases, MongoDB, files and HTTP: publish messages and run copy routes with endpoints given inline as JSON, while the rows never pass through the model's context.
entries.zh: 在 Kafka、NATS、RabbitMQ、MQTT、IBM MQ、SQL 数据库、MongoDB、文件和 HTTP 之间移动数据：以内联 JSON 指定端点，发布消息并运行复制路由，数据行不经过模型上下文。

entries.english: dbt-core (OSS) project metadata, model and column-level lineage, and dbt documentation.
entries.zh: dbt-core（开源）项目元数据、模型与列级血缘关系以及 dbt 文档。

entries.english: China apparel supply chain data: verified suppliers, lab-tested fabrics and industrial clusters, with AATCC, ISO and GB lab-test verification.
entries.zh: 中国服装供应链数据：经验证的供应商、实验室检测面料和产业集群，支持 AATCC、ISO 和 GB 实验室检测验证。

entries.english: Query Power BI semantic models: browse workspaces, tables and measures, run DAX queries and page large results via local CSV.
entries.zh: 查询 Power BI 语义模型：浏览工作区、表和度量，运行 DAX 查询，并通过本地 CSV 分页处理大型结果。

entries.english: Fine-grained sentiment analysis, keyword extraction and batch processing.
entries.zh: 细粒度情绪分析、关键词提取和批处理。

entries.english: Deterministic, lexicon-based semantic word encoding and valence analysis: word-to-code mapping, semantic similarity and synonym/antonym lookup.
entries.zh: 基于词典的确定性语义词语编码与情感效价分析：词到代码映射、语义相似度及同义词/反义词查询。

entries.english: Automate or monitor business operations: sales recording, POS software and CRM.
entries.zh: 自动化或监控业务运营：销售记录、POS 软件和 CRM。

entries.english: Trust checks for Malaysian public datasets: freshness, licence, provenance and drift, with signed evidence and an offline-verifiable attestation chain.
entries.zh: 马来西亚公共数据集的可信性检查：新鲜度、许可、来源和漂移，提供签名证据及可离线验证的证明链。

entries.english: POS and sales analytics for AirREGI, Smaregi and BASE e-commerce: store management, sales data queries, AI chat analysis and weather correlation.
entries.zh: 面向 AirREGI、Smaregi 和 BASE 电商的 POS 与销售分析：店铺管理、销售数据查询、AI 聊天分析和天气相关性。

entries.english: Read-only BI pipeline governance: each table's stage from source to Power BI, what blocks the next stage, static SQL/TMDL/PBIR checks and evidence packs.
entries.zh: 只读 BI 流水线治理：记录每张表从源头到 Power BI 所处阶段、下一阶段的阻碍、静态 SQL/TMDL/PBIR 检查和证据包。

entries.english: Airflow REST API: list DAGs, runs and task instances, tail logs and roll up DAG health. Read-only by default; trigger and clear are write-gated.
entries.zh: Airflow REST API：列出 DAG、运行和任务实例，跟踪日志并汇总 DAG 健康状态。默认只读；触发和清除操作受写入关卡控制。

entries.english: Capsule CRM: contacts, opportunities, projects, tasks, timeline activity, filters, workflow tracks and file attachments, with an optional read-only mode.
entries.zh: Capsule CRM：联系人、商机、项目、任务、时间线活动、过滤器、工作流跟踪和文件附件，提供可选只读模式。

entries.english: World data from primary sources via the Sugra API: markets, macroeconomics, company fundamentals, government, news, climate, maritime and entity screening.
entries.zh: 通过 Sugra API 获取来自一手来源的全球数据：市场、宏观经济、公司基本面、政府、新闻、气候、海事和实体筛查。

entries.english: Swiss open data: transport, weather, geodata, companies, parliament and more.
entries.zh: 瑞士开放数据：交通、天气、地理数据、企业、议会等。

entries.english: Databricks Genie API: ask natural language questions, run SQL queries and interact with Databricks conversational agents.
entries.zh: Databricks Genie API：使用自然语言提问、运行 SQL 查询并与 Databricks 对话代理交互。

entries.english: USDA FoodData Central nutrition data, paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base): food search, details, comparisons and recipes.
entries.zh: USDA FoodData Central 营养数据，通过 x402（Base 上的 USDC）按次付费：食物搜索、详情、比较和食谱。

entries.english: Social network analysis of YouTube comments: influencer centrality ranking, Louvain community detection and sentiment analysis.
entries.zh: YouTube 评论社交网络分析：影响者中心性排名、Louvain 社区检测和情绪分析。

entries.english: FastMCP server for business intelligence and data agents, exposing dynamic KPI analytics, anomaly detection, and schema resources across 10 business domains via stdio and SSE transports.
entries.zh: 面向商业智能和数据代理的 FastMCP 服务器，通过 stdio 和 SSE 传输公开 10 个业务领域的动态 KPI 分析、异常检测和模式资源。

entries.english: Writes illustrated end-user help articles from a codebase: reads the interface code, renders screenshots of each screen in a local headless Chromium, and saves Markdown with images. No account needed.
entries.zh: 根据代码库编写带插图的终端用户帮助文章：读取界面代码，在本地无头 Chromium 中渲染各屏幕截图，并保存带图片的 Markdown。无需账号。

entries.english: Zero-config runtime and browser error sensor for AI coding agents: intercepts dev server crashes and in-browser exceptions with source-mapped stack traces for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的零配置运行时与浏览器错误传感器：拦截开发服务器崩溃和浏览器异常，为 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 提供带源码映射的堆栈跟踪。

entries.english: Scans a repository for dead code, duplication, churn and structure and erases what the scan found, with a log of every erasure; the judgments come from a local core binary, not an LLM.
entries.zh: 扫描仓库中的死代码、重复、代码变动和结构，并删除扫描发现的内容，记录每次删除；判断来自本地核心二进制而非大语言模型。

entries.english: Deterministic symbol oracle over a locally built index of the repo: whether a symbol exists, what a file declares, and what changed structurally since the last snapshot. Ships with a PreToolUse guard that stops an Edit/Write referencing a function, constant or type the repo does not declare, before the write lands. No LLM, no API keys, no network — the same code produces the same answer. Parsers for Go, Python, JS/TS, Rust, Ruby and shell. `bash install.sh`
entries.zh: 基于本地构建的仓库索引提供确定性符号查询：符号是否存在、文件声明了什么，以及自上次快照以来发生了哪些结构变化。附带 PreToolUse 保护器，在 Edit/Write 引用仓库未声明的函数、常量或类型时，在写入前阻止。无需大语言模型、API 密钥或网络，相同代码产生相同答案。支持 Go、Python、JS/TS、Rust、Ruby 和 shell 解析器。`bash install.sh`

entries.english: SLOC counts for any public GitHub repository from any MCP client: files, code, comment and blank lines per language, plus side-by-side repo comparisons.
entries.zh: 从任意 MCP 客户端统计公开 GitHub 仓库的源代码行数：按语言列出文件、代码、注释和空行，并支持仓库并排比较。

entries.english: Profiles how you use any MCP server into a reusable, read-only skill: workflows, call chains and each tool's safety class.
entries.zh: 分析你如何使用任意 MCP 服务器，生成可复用只读技能：包括工作流程、调用链和每个工具的安全等级。

entries.english: Maps a .NET Reqnroll/SpecFlow test-automation solution into a queryable SQLite file to search step definitions, check change impact and avoid duplicate code.
entries.zh: 将 .NET Reqnroll/SpecFlow 测试自动化方案映射为可查询 SQLite 文件，以搜索步骤定义、检查变更影响并避免重复代码。

entries.english: On-premise private AI systems from ARADIA on NVIDIA DGX hardware: hardware sizing, ROI modeling, partner onboarding, procurement and order tracking.
entries.zh: ARADIA 基于 NVIDIA DGX 硬件的本地私有 AI 系统：硬件规格、投资回报建模、合作伙伴入驻、采购和订单跟踪。

entries.english: Reads local Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode usage logs: token totals, daily and hourly activity, per-agent and per-model breakdowns and a year-in-review recap.
entries.zh: 读取本地 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 使用日志：token 总量、每日和每小时活动、按代理和模型细分以及年度回顾。

entries.english: Checks source-context freshness against a Git working tree and retrieves source-linked code relationships to surface stale knowledge and cross-file impact.
entries.zh: 根据 Git 工作树检查源上下文的新鲜度，并获取关联源代码的关系，以发现过时知识和跨文件影响。

entries.english: Explains known developer errors offline and deterministically (CORS, ESM/CommonJS, npm ERESOLVE, Next.js build, Postgres connection and DATABASE_URL errors): cause, ranked fixes and the documentation link. One tool, no LLM, no network.
entries.zh: 离线、确定性解释常见开发错误（CORS、ESM/CommonJS、npm ERESOLVE、Next.js 构建、Postgres 连接和 DATABASE_URL 错误）：原因、排序后的修复方法和文档链接。单一工具，无需大语言模型或网络。

entries.english: Health and token cost of every server in the official MCP registry, probed daily: look up or search a server, probe any URL live, and measure what the servers in your own config cost before the first prompt.
entries.zh: 每日探测官方 MCP 注册表中每个服务器的健康状态和 token 成本：查询或搜索服务器、实时探测任意 URL，并在首次提示前测量自己配置中的服务器成本。

entries.english: AST-based code outliner, log compressor and context budget analyzer to reduce LLM token usage.
entries.zh: 基于 AST 的代码大纲、日志压缩器和上下文预算分析器，减少大语言模型 token 使用。

entries.english: Health checks, binary validation and JSON auto-repair for MCP client configuration files.
entries.zh: 对 MCP 客户端配置文件进行健康检查、二进制验证和 JSON 自动修复。

entries.english: AST-based dependency analyzer: flags unused packages, calculates actual install sizes and detects unmaintained dependencies.
entries.zh: 基于 AST 的依赖分析器：标记未使用的软件包、计算实际安装大小并检测未维护依赖。

entries.english: Is this dependency still maintained? Scores npm packages, PyPI packages and GitHub repositories 0-100 with an A-F grade and plain-language risks (deprecated, archived, single maintainer, unanswered issues). Scans package.json, requirements.txt and lock files. No API key needed.
entries.zh: 这个依赖还在维护吗？对 npm 包、PyPI 包和 GitHub 仓库按 0–100 分及 A–F 等级评分，并以通俗语言说明风险（已弃用、已归档、单一维护者、无人答复的问题）。扫描 package.json、requirements.txt 和锁文件，无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Search and fetch animated, shadcn-compatible React components, design systems and templates, with install commands, from the aicanvas registry.
entries.zh: 从 aicanvas 注册表搜索并获取兼容 shadcn 的动态 React 组件、设计系统和模板，以及安装命令。

entries.english: Browse and search Hyperiux Vault React/Next.js animation and interaction effects, with dependencies, changelogs, install commands and source code.
entries.zh: 浏览和搜索 Hyperiux Vault 的 React/Next.js 动画与交互效果，查看依赖、更新日志、安装命令和源代码。

entries.english: Versioned projects from assistant-built work: shareable HTML previews, version comparison, delegated approvals, artifacts, work assignments and source export.
entries.zh: 从助手构建的工作中管理版本化项目：可分享 HTML 预览、版本比较、委派批准、产物、工作分配和源代码导出。

entries.english: Free ASO Score (Agent Signal Optimization) scanner scoring discovery, identity, trust, commerce, reputation, and memory signals, with maturity levels, evidence, and prioritized fix plans. Local stdio, no API key required. `npx -y @forgemeshlabs/aso-score-mcp`
entries.zh: 免费 ASO Score（Agent Signal Optimization）扫描器，对发现、身份、信任、商务、声誉和记忆信号评分，提供成熟度等级、证据和优先修复计划。本地 stdio，无需 API 密钥。`npx -y @forgemeshlabs/aso-score-mcp`

entries.english: Prevents double charges and duplicate side effects from agent tool calls: concurrent races elect one winner, late duplicates replay a sealed receipt.
entries.zh: 防止代理工具调用重复收费和重复副作用：并发竞争选出一个胜者，后到的重复调用重放封存收据。

entries.english: Demand-signal scanner for validating product and dev-tool ideas using GitHub repo signals, Hacker News attention and npm/PyPI download counts.
entries.zh: 需求信号扫描器，利用 GitHub 仓库信号、Hacker News 关注度及 npm/PyPI 下载量验证产品和开发工具想法。

entries.english: Tailwind CSS palettes (50–950) from any color for Tailwind v4, v3, v2 and v1, computed in OKLCH, plus the closest Tailwind color to any color. Run it with `npx tailwindshades-mcp` or use the hosted endpoint.
entries.zh: 为 Tailwind v4、v3、v2 和 v1 根据任意颜色计算 Tailwind CSS 调色板（50–950），使用 OKLCH，并查找任意颜色最接近的 Tailwind 颜色。通过 `npx tailwindshades-mcp` 运行或使用托管端点。

entries.english: Local-first runtime for coding agents: bounded workspace access, guarded writes, AST search, LSP navigation and diagnostics, and Git tooling.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理的本地优先运行时：限定工作区访问、受保护的写入、AST 搜索、LSP 导航和诊断，以及 Git 工具。

entries.english: Deterministic execution guardrails, isolated AST-based math evaluation, SSRF-safe DNS routing and malformed JSON repair.
entries.zh: 确定性执行防护、隔离的基于 AST 数学求值、安全防范 SSRF 的 DNS 路由和畸形 JSON 修复。

entries.english: Records Python, Rust and TypeScript program runs to local SQLite so coding agents can query call trees, exceptions and value flow.
entries.zh: 将 Python、Rust 和 TypeScript 程序运行记录到本地 SQLite，让编码代理查询调用树、异常和数值流。

entries.english: Deterministic local developer utilities for coding agents: inspect listening ports and processes, compute IPv4 CIDR subnet ranges, decode creation timestamps from UUIDv7, ULID, Snowflake and MongoDB ObjectId, and convert Unix epochs with zero telemetry.
entries.zh: 面向编码代理的确定性本地开发工具：检查监听端口和进程、计算 IPv4 CIDR 子网范围、解码 UUIDv7、ULID、Snowflake 和 MongoDB ObjectId 的创建时间戳，并转换 Unix 时间戳；无遥测。

entries.english: Page inspection and runtime debugging in Chrome for AI coding agents: breakpoints, stepping, scope variables, source-mapped stacks, plus HTML/CSS, console, network and screenshots. Plain CDP with no DevTools SDK dependency, keeping the install lightweight.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的 Chrome 页面检查与运行时调试：断点、单步、作用域变量、源码映射堆栈，以及 HTML/CSS、控制台、网络和截图。使用纯 CDP，无 DevTools SDK 依赖，保持安装轻量。

entries.english: Check whether an LLM model ID is deprecated, retiring or retired, and what to migrate to, across OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock, Google and Cohere.
entries.zh: 检查 OpenAI、Anthropic、Azure、Bedrock、Google 和 Cohere 的大语言模型 ID 是否已弃用、即将退役或已退役，以及应迁移到哪个模型。

entries.english: Read-only debugging for Hono apps: recent exceptions with their requests, logs and queries, requests filtered by status or duration, and the slowest queries.
entries.zh: Hono 应用的只读调试：最近异常及其请求、日志和查询，按状态或时长过滤请求，以及最慢查询。

entries.english: Read-only access to the agentic-os governance, SDLC and QE methodology, with install planning and verification.
entries.zh: 只读访问 agentic-os 治理、软件开发生命周期和质量工程方法，并提供安装规划和验证。

entries.english: Self-hosted live library docs, code audits with file:line findings, BM25-ranked snippets and lockfile-aware version pinning.
entries.zh: 自托管实时库文档、带文件和行号发现的代码审计、BM25 排序代码片段，以及感知锁文件的版本固定。

entries.english: Semantic file and code search by description, with local indexes, AST-aware chunking, optional reranking and API-based or fully offline embedding models.
entries.zh: 按描述进行语义文件和代码搜索，支持本地索引、感知 AST 的分块、可选重排以及基于 API 或完全离线的嵌入模型。

entries.english: Health check for React Native and Expo projects: upgrade blockers, New Architecture support, App Store and Google Play rejections, crash risks, OWASP MASVS security and accessibility findings, an ordered upgrade plan, library compatibility checks and release bundle measurement. Read-only; never runs project code.
entries.zh: React Native 和 Expo 项目健康检查：升级阻碍、新架构支持、App Store 和 Google Play 拒审、崩溃风险、OWASP MASVS 安全及无障碍问题，并提供有序升级计划、库兼容性检查和发行包测量。只读，从不运行项目代码。

entries.english: Design review of rendered UI for coding agents: submit a preview URL, get findings with element references and recheck after fixing. Read-only.
entries.zh: 为编程代理审查渲染后的界面设计：提交预览 URL，获取带元素引用的问题，修复后重新检查。只读。

entries.english: Checks if a project idea already exists on GitHub, npm or Python repositories and suggests maintained alternatives to extend instead of scaffolding anew.
entries.zh: 检查项目创意是否已存在于 GitHub、npm 或 Python 仓库，并建议扩展仍在维护的替代项目，而非从头搭建。

entries.english: Hallucination guard: verify a claim against evidence (supported, refuted or not enough evidence) with a confidence score and abstain flag.
entries.zh: 幻觉防护：根据证据核验声明是否得到支持、被反驳或证据不足，并给出置信分数和弃答标志。

entries.english: Dependency-upgrade impact analysis for Python and .NET: which API usages break, with line numbers and fix hints, plus detection of hallucinated API calls.
entries.zh: 分析 Python 和 .NET 依赖升级的影响：指出会失效的 API 用法、行号和修复提示，并检测虚构的 API 调用。

entries.english: Reduced-motion and WCAG 2.2.2/2.3.3 verification for web animation: validate animation specs and compile them into reduced-motion-safe CSS.
entries.zh: 检查网页动画的减少动态效果设置及 WCAG 2.2.2/2.3.3：验证动画规范并将其编译为兼容减少动态效果的 CSS。

entries.english: DAP-to-MCP bridge for native debugging via CodeLLDB: stack frames, registers, locals, disassembly, memory, crash dumps and crash fix/verify workflows.
entries.zh: 通过 CodeLLDB 进行原生调试的 DAP 到 MCP 桥接：提供堆栈帧、寄存器、局部变量、反汇编、内存、崩溃转储及崩溃修复与验证流程。

entries.english: Checks coding-agent context files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md) against the git index: broken links, missing paths, undefined commands and drift.
entries.zh: 对照 git 索引检查编程代理的上下文文件（CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、SKILL.md），发现失效链接、缺失路径、未定义命令和内容漂移。
