entries.english: Tells coding agents which npm dependencies changed after their training cutoff, and what changed: ranked notes in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, a post-edit guard that explains type errors caused by changed APIs, and a `search_changes` tool over type diffs, release notes and upgrade guides. `npx stalemap setup --agent <claude|cursor|codex|opencode>`
entries.zh: 告知编程代理哪些 npm 依赖在其训练截止日期后发生变化及具体变化：在 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 中提供排序说明，用编辑后检查解释 API 变化造成的类型错误，并通过 `search_changes` 工具搜索类型差异、发行说明和升级指南。`npx stalemap setup --agent <claude|cursor|codex|opencode>`

entries.english: Search, inspect and install Ballmac UI React + Tailwind components, blocks and templates, with props, keyboard notes and the exact shadcn install command, and plan whole pages from blocks.
entries.zh: 搜索、查看和安装 Ballmac UI 的 React + Tailwind 组件、区块和模板，提供属性、键盘操作说明及准确的 shadcn 安装命令，并通过区块规划整个页面。

entries.english: Merge gate for AI-written code: catches placeholder code, unfailable tests, unsupported completion claims and nonexistent API calls, then returns a fix plan.
entries.zh: AI 编写代码的合并关卡：发现占位代码、不会失败的测试、缺乏依据的完成声明和不存在的 API 调用，然后返回修复计划。

entries.english: Host-level telemetry gateway letting sandboxed agents fetch container logs and track kernel resource metrics.
entries.zh: 主机级遥测网关，让沙箱代理获取容器日志并跟踪内核资源指标。

entries.english: Local stdio bridge to the hosted Delx Protocol MCP endpoint, with client install, doctor checks and live tool discovery.
entries.zh: 连接托管 Delx Protocol MCP 端点的本地 stdio 桥接，支持客户端安装、诊断检查和实时工具发现。

entries.english: Deterministic linter for AI writing tells. Offline by default, with an optional model pass if you want one.
entries.zh: 用于检查 AI 写作痕迹的确定性检查器。默认离线运行，可选择增加模型检查。

entries.english: Contract-first programming language: check types, effects, capabilities and contracts in agent-written modules and review changes for new authority.
entries.zh: 契约优先的编程语言：检查代理编写模块的类型、副作用、能力和契约，并审查变更是否引入新的权限。

entries.english: Indexes a repo into a persistent local knowledge graph of functions, classes, call chains, HTTP routes and cross-service links, using tree-sitter and LSP.
entries.zh: 使用 tree-sitter 和 LSP 将仓库索引为持久化本地知识图谱，涵盖函数、类、调用链、HTTP 路由和跨服务关联。

entries.english: Generate PDFs from HTML, a URL or a template with JSON data, and extract text or Markdown from PDFs.
entries.zh: 从 HTML、URL 或带 JSON 数据的模板生成 PDF，并从 PDF 提取文本或 Markdown。

entries.english: Query problems, logs, events, SLOs, security insights and performance metrics from self-hosted Dynatrace Managed environments.
entries.zh: 查询自托管 Dynatrace Managed 环境中的问题、日志、事件、SLO、安全洞察和性能指标。

entries.english: Lint HTML email with Emailens: rendering issues in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and more, per-client CSS compatibility scores, dark mode simulation and fixes.
entries.zh: 使用 Emailens 检查 HTML 邮件：发现 Gmail、Outlook、Apple Mail 等客户端的渲染问题，提供各客户端 CSS 兼容性评分、深色模式模拟及修复建议。

entries.english: Build and maintain Altium Designer component libraries: read and write .PcbLib footprints and .SchLib symbols, with IPC-7351B footprints and STEP models.
entries.zh: 构建和维护 Altium Designer 元件库：读写 .PcbLib 封装和 .SchLib 符号，并提供 IPC-7351B 封装和 STEP 模型。

entries.english: Generate fictional test identities, addresses, phones, Luhn cards and IBANs for QA fixtures (66 countries). Companion web tools at https://fauxgen.com.
entries.zh: 为质量保证测试数据生成虚构的身份、地址、电话、符合 Luhn 校验的卡号和 IBAN（覆盖 66 个国家）。配套网页工具：https://fauxgen.com。

entries.english: Audits website and API agent readiness: robots.txt AI rules, llms.txt, agent cards, MCP server cards and OAuth metadata, with maturity scores and fix plans.
entries.zh: 审查网站和 API 对代理的支持情况：检查 robots.txt AI 规则、llms.txt、代理卡、MCP 服务器卡和 OAuth 元数据，并提供成熟度评分及修复计划。

entries.english: Local CI/CD for agents: runs jobs on LGH git events in isolated checkouts, with failure diagnosis, approval gates, auto-rollback and a web console.
entries.zh: 面向代理的本地 CI/CD：在隔离检出目录中根据 LGH git 事件运行任务，支持故障诊断、审批关卡、自动回滚和网页控制台。

entries.english: Duplicate code detection with jscpd: check snippets and files for copy/paste duplication against a scanned project before committing.
entries.zh: 使用 jscpd 检测重复代码：提交前将代码片段和文件与扫描过的项目比较，发现复制粘贴重复。

entries.english: Local launch-readiness audit for AI-built apps: read-only checks, an evidence-based 0-100 score and guided fixes.
entries.zh: 本地审查 AI 构建应用是否具备上线条件：进行只读检查，给出基于证据的 0–100 分评分和引导式修复。

entries.english: Test management: author manual test cases, run executions, cut releases and link automated tests, with prompts for flaky-test triage and release readiness.
entries.zh: 测试管理：编写手工测试用例、执行测试、创建发布并关联自动化测试，提供不稳定测试分诊和发布就绪提示。

entries.english: Frontend review on deployed previews. Your agent reads reviewers' comments over MCP and resolves them, and a CI check holds the merge until they are.
entries.zh: 在已部署的预览上进行前端审查。代理通过 MCP 读取并解决审查意见，CI 检查在问题解决前阻止合并。

entries.english: Breaking-change diffs for npm packages, so coding agents avoid writing code against outdated APIs.
entries.zh: 提供 npm 包的破坏性变更差异，帮助编程代理避免使用过时 API 编写代码。

entries.english: Reusable prompt templates with multi-step chains, quality gates and reasoning frameworks, exportable as native skills for coding agents.
entries.zh: 可复用的提示词模板，支持多步骤链、质量关卡和推理框架，可导出为编程代理的原生技能。

entries.english: Control Claude Managed Agents: launch agents, watch their events, reply, approve tool calls and stop them.
entries.zh: 控制 Claude Managed Agents：启动代理、观察其事件、回复、批准工具调用并停止代理。

entries.english: Local, deterministic review of Git changes for coding agents: weakened tests and CI gates, security boundaries, blast radius.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理在本地确定性审查 Git 变更，涵盖测试及 CI 关卡弱化、安全边界和影响范围。

entries.english: Nahook webhook platform: trigger webhooks, inspect deliveries, retry failures and manage endpoints.
entries.zh: Nahook Webhook 平台：触发 Webhook、查看投递记录、重试失败任务并管理端点。

entries.english: Developer toolkit: semantic code search, natural-language database queries, docs indexing and OpenAPI introspection.
entries.zh: 开发者工具集：语义代码搜索、自然语言数据库查询、文档索引和 OpenAPI 自省。

entries.english: Index TypeScript/React repos into a code graph: who-renders and who-calls queries, blast radius, dependency cycles, dead code and symbol signatures.
entries.zh: 将 TypeScript/React 仓库索引为代码图谱：查询谁渲染谁、谁调用谁，分析影响范围、依赖循环、死代码和符号签名。

entries.english: Voice interface for Claude Code: live speech-to-text with turn-taking, spoken replies with xAI Grok voices, per-subagent voice personas and a real-time HUD.
entries.zh: Claude Code 语音界面：实时语音转文字及轮流发言，使用 xAI Grok 声音进行语音回复，为各子代理设置语音角色，并提供实时平视显示界面。

entries.english: Monitors coding-agent token cache using inventory theory (EOQ) and signals optimal session restart timing via a live dashboard and terminal status line.
entries.zh: 使用库存理论（EOQ）监测编程代理的令牌缓存，并通过实时仪表盘和终端状态行提示最佳会话重启时机。

entries.english: Register PNTR dev subdomains, manage DNS records, receive email in a disposable inbox and capture inbound HTTP requests for webhook debugging.
entries.zh: 注册 PNTR 开发子域名、管理 DNS 记录、在一次性收件箱接收邮件，并捕获入站 HTTP 请求以调试 Webhook。

entries.english: Deterministic documentation-drift detection: validates a project's docs against its code, with stable finding codes and suggested fixes. Read-only.
entries.zh: 确定性检测文档漂移：对照代码验证项目文档，提供稳定的问题代码和修复建议。只读。

entries.english: NowSecure Platform mobile security testing: list applications, pull remediation findings and generate PDF reports locally.
entries.zh: NowSecure Platform 移动安全测试：列出应用、获取修复问题并在本地生成 PDF 报告。

entries.english: Generates CLAUDE.md from git history and file sampling, and keeps a concept map linking features and flows to files so agents skip repeated searches.
entries.zh: 根据 git 历史和文件抽样生成 CLAUDE.md，并维护将功能和流程关联至文件的概念图，帮助代理避免重复搜索。

entries.english: Build token-efficient codebase context locally, with live preview, Git scopes, secret redaction and syntax-aware compression.
entries.zh: 在本地构建节省令牌的代码库上下文，支持实时预览、Git 范围、敏感信息遮盖和语法感知压缩。

entries.english: Change tracking for codebases: agents log structured change events with diff and reasoning, then query them via diff, blame, history and search.
entries.zh: 代码库变更跟踪：代理记录包含差异和理由的结构化变更事件，然后通过 diff、blame、历史记录和搜索进行查询。

entries.english: Design-fidelity checks: compare a Figma frame or design screenshot with the rendered UI and get structured discrepancies with CSS properties and severity.
entries.zh: 设计还原度检查：比较 Figma 画框或设计截图与渲染后的界面，获取带 CSS 属性及严重程度的结构化差异。

entries.english: Validate AI-built front-ends against Figma by tokens and geometry, not pixels: extract a spec from a Figma frame link, then get a deterministic fidelity score and fix-list for the rendered page.
entries.zh: 根据设计令牌和几何信息而非像素，对照 Figma 验证 AI 构建的前端：从 Figma 画框链接提取规范，并获得渲染页面的确定性还原度评分及修复清单。

entries.english: Billing for MCP server operators: Stripe subscriptions, per-call credits, tiered pricing and x402 micropayments without writing billing code.
entries.zh: 面向 MCP 服务器运营者的计费：无需编写计费代码即可使用 Stripe 订阅、按调用计次额度、分级定价和 x402 小额支付。

entries.english: Build Laravel apps through conversation on the Stellify platform: code stored as structured JSON for surgical statement-level edits, with a shared reuse library, CRUD scaffolding, migrations and studio test runs.
entries.zh: 在 Stellify 平台通过对话构建 Laravel 应用：代码以结构化 JSON 存储，支持语句级精确编辑、共享复用库、CRUD 脚手架、迁移和工作室测试运行。

entries.english: Compiles TypeScript to validated Swift for Apple platforms: App Intents, SwiftUI views, WidgetKit widgets and full apps.
entries.zh: 将 TypeScript 编译为经验证的 Swift，面向 Apple 平台生成 App Intents、SwiftUI 视图、WidgetKit 小组件和完整应用。

entries.english: Deterministic local audit for AI writing tells (uniform paragraphs, stock transitions) plus a trainable voice layer so drafts sound closer to a real voice.
entries.zh: 在本地确定性审查 AI 写作痕迹（如段落千篇一律和套话式过渡），并提供可训练的语气层，使草稿更接近真实声音。

entries.english: Discovery router for the agent-device CLI: status, install guidance, version-matched help and prompts for iOS, Android, tvOS, macOS and Linux automation.
entries.zh: agent-device CLI 的发现路由器：提供状态、安装指导、与版本匹配的帮助及 iOS、Android、tvOS、macOS 和 Linux 自动化提示。

entries.english: Local repo intelligence: hybrid BM25/vector search, a tree-sitter code graph, queryable git and GitHub history, and persistent source-anchored memories.
entries.zh: 本地仓库智能工具：混合 BM25/向量搜索、tree-sitter 代码图谱、可查询的 git 和 GitHub 历史，以及锚定源码的持久记忆。

entries.english: Local codebase intelligence backed by SQLite: context packets, indexed code and schema facts, diagnostics and optional Postgres/Supabase awareness.
entries.zh: 基于 SQLite 的本地代码库智能工具：上下文包、已索引的代码和模式事实、诊断，以及可选的 Postgres/Supabase 感知能力。

entries.english: Developer utilities: web search, exchange rates, crypto prices, QR codes, JSON formatting, UUIDs, URL tools, domain checks and RSS feeds, some paid via x402.
entries.zh: 开发者实用工具：网页搜索、汇率、加密货币价格、二维码、JSON 格式化、UUID、URL 工具、域名检查和 RSS 订阅，其中部分通过 x402 付费。

entries.english: Roku development: ECP device control, automated channel sideloading, BrightScript debugging and real-time log monitoring.
entries.zh: Roku 开发：ECP 设备控制、频道自动侧载、BrightScript 调试及实时日志监控。

entries.english: AST-based codebase map, token compression and context packaging for AI coding agents and IDEs.
entries.zh: 为 AI 编程代理和 IDE 提供基于 AST 的代码库地图、令牌压缩和上下文打包。

entries.english: Deterministic validation of AI-generated artifacts: JSON Schema and OpenAPI response conformance and per-dialect SQL syntax, with typed verdicts and fix hints.
entries.zh: 确定性验证 AI 生成的产物：检查 JSON Schema 与 OpenAPI 响应一致性及各方言 SQL 语法，给出带类型的判定和修复提示。

entries.english: Validate HTML and CSS, audit technical SEO and accessibility, check JSON-LD and public links, and capture responsive screenshots.
entries.zh: 验证 HTML 和 CSS，审查技术 SEO 与无障碍性，检查 JSON-LD 和公开链接，并截取响应式截图。

entries.english: Indexes a repo into a local, deterministic code graph (symbols, references, dependencies) with semantic diffs and impact analysis.
entries.zh: 将仓库索引为本地确定性代码图谱（符号、引用、依赖），提供语义差异和影响分析。

entries.english: Static-analysis context compiler for Python repos: selects callers, callees and related functions for a change and packs them into a token budget.
entries.zh: 面向 Python 仓库的静态分析上下文编译器：为变更选择调用方、被调用方及相关函数，并在令牌预算内打包。

entries.english: GitHub repository health monitoring: A-F health grades, OpenSSF security checks, DORA metrics, code scanning alerts and CI/CD status.
entries.zh: GitHub 仓库健康监控：A–F 健康等级、OpenSSF 安全检查、DORA 指标、代码扫描警报和 CI/CD 状态。

entries.english: Fault injection for MCP servers (timeouts, malformed JSON-RPC, corrupted outputs) with a reliability scorecard for output schemas and error conformance.
entries.zh: 为 MCP 服务器注入故障（超时、格式错误的 JSON-RPC、损坏的输出），并提供输出模式和错误一致性的可靠性评分卡。

entries.english: Local code search for coding agents: hybrid keyword and semantic search with SQL relevance ranking over a plain-file index.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地代码搜索：在普通文件索引上结合关键词和语义搜索，并使用 SQL 相关性排序。

entries.english: Read-only Nacos config and service discovery for Spring Cloud repos: finds environments from application/bootstrap files and diffs config keys across them.
entries.zh: 面向 Spring Cloud 仓库的只读 Nacos 配置和服务发现：从 application/bootstrap 文件识别环境，并比较各环境配置键的差异。

entries.english: Generate SaaS specifications for AI build tools: design systems, database schemas and RLS policies.
entries.zh: 为 AI 构建工具生成 SaaS 规范：设计系统、数据库模式和 RLS 策略。

entries.english: Interactive .NET/ASP.NET Core debugging via netcoredbg: breakpoints, stepping, thread inspection, exception and deadlock analysis, and request tracing.
entries.zh: 通过 netcoredbg 交互式调试 .NET/ASP.NET Core：断点、单步执行、线程检查、异常与死锁分析及请求跟踪。

entries.english: Scoped access to local dev environments (filesystem, databases, processes, OpenAPI) with a command allowlist and read-only database mode.
entries.zh: 对本地开发环境（文件系统、数据库、进程、OpenAPI）提供范围限定访问，并支持命令允许列表和只读数据库模式。

entries.english: Semantic code index that extracts domain concepts, naming conventions and behavioral similarity from codebases.
entries.zh: 语义代码索引，从代码库中提取领域概念、命名约定和行为相似性。

entries.english: AST-aware repository graph for Go codebases: struct embeds, public API surfaces, SQL queries and error mapping, giving agents context without grepping.
entries.zh: 面向 Go 代码库、可感知 AST 的仓库图谱：涵盖结构体嵌入、公开 API 表面、SQL 查询和错误映射，让代理无需 grep 即可获取上下文。

entries.english: Observability for AI coding: tracks token usage and time, and turns AI deviations into persistent project rules.
entries.zh: AI 编程可观测性：跟踪令牌用量和时间，并将 AI 偏差转化为持久的项目规则。

entries.english: Codebeamer ALM: read and write work items, trackers, projects, associations, references, comments and risk management data via the REST API.
entries.zh: Codebeamer ALM：通过 REST API 读写工作项、跟踪器、项目、关联、引用、评论和风险管理数据。

entries.english: Upgrade intelligence for coding agents: what an upgrade changes and which of your files it touches, pre-install dependency checks, and lockfile CVE scans.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的升级情报：说明升级会改变什么、影响哪些文件，并提供安装前依赖检查和锁文件 CVE 扫描。

entries.english: WordPress management via WP-CLI, locally or over SSH: themes, plugins, posts, menus, users, database, scaffolding and cache.
entries.zh: 通过 WP-CLI 在本地或经 SSH 管理 WordPress：主题、插件、文章、菜单、用户、数据库、脚手架及缓存。

entries.english: Multi-site WordPress Elementor management: safe edits with backup and auto-rollback, template export/import, bulk find/replace, CSS flush and screenshots.
entries.zh: 多站点 WordPress Elementor 管理：安全编辑并支持备份和自动回滚、模板导入导出、批量查找替换、刷新 CSS 和截图。

entries.english: WordPress plugin exposing Rank Math SEO fields, JSON-LD schema and restorable content snapshots as MCP tools, plus an additive-only write gate and audit log.
entries.zh: WordPress 插件，将 Rank Math SEO 字段、JSON-LD 模式和可恢复的内容快照作为 MCP 工具公开，并提供仅允许新增的写入关卡及审计日志。

entries.english: Build WordPress sites on the Sweipe or FlatMobile themes: import demos, build a site from a brief, review it, rewrite page copy and change settings.
entries.zh: 基于 Sweipe 或 FlatMobile 主题构建 WordPress 网站：导入演示、根据简报建站、审查网站、重写页面文案和更改设置。

entries.english: Code quality gate for AI-generated code, detecting hallucinated packages, phantom dependencies, stale APIs and AI-specific defects.
entries.zh: AI 生成代码的质量关卡，检测虚构包、幽灵依赖、过时 API 和 AI 特有缺陷。

entries.english: Codebase intelligence: indexes a repo into a dependency graph, git history, defect-risk code health, generated docs and architectural decisions. Runs locally.
entries.zh: 代码库智能工具：将仓库索引为依赖图谱、git 历史、缺陷风险代码健康信息、生成的文档和架构决策。本地运行。

entries.english: Huawei AppGallery Connect publishing: upload APK/AAB, update metadata and localizations, submit for review, and manage phased rollouts.
entries.zh: 华为 AppGallery Connect 发布：上传 APK/AAB、更新元数据及本地化内容、提交审核并管理分阶段发布。

entries.english: Lets agents gate their own work: a fail-closed ship checklist, independent refute-first review and a tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts ledger.
entries.zh: 让代理为自身工作设置关卡：默认拒绝的交付清单、独立的优先反驳式审查，以及防篡改的哈希链凭据账本。

entries.english: Static blast-radius extraction and an AOS manifest.json divergence check (Oracle, Permitted, Prohibited), also usable as a blocking CI gate.
entries.zh: 静态提取影响范围并检查 AOS manifest.json 差异（Oracle、Permitted、Prohibited），也可用作阻断式 CI 关卡。

entries.english: Agent health reporter: advisory health scans under AOS discipline covering manifest, services, immune loop and evidence.
entries.zh: 代理健康报告工具：遵循 AOS 规则进行建议性的健康扫描，涵盖清单、服务、免疫循环和证据。

entries.english: Utility tools with x402 micropayments: JSON validation, base64, hashing, UUIDs, regex testing, Markdown and datetime conversion, cron parsing and JWT decoding.
entries.zh: 支持 x402 小额支付的实用工具：JSON 验证、base64、哈希、UUID、正则测试、Markdown 和日期时间转换、cron 解析及 JWT 解码。

entries.english: Local-first design contract layer: scans Figma, code, Storybook and token files, reconciles conflicts and serves a single source of truth for design rules.
entries.zh: 本地优先的设计契约层：扫描 Figma、代码、Storybook 和设计令牌文件，协调冲突并提供统一的设计规则事实来源。

entries.english: Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud: work with repositories, pull requests, workspaces and code.
entries.zh: Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud：操作仓库、拉取请求、工作区和代码。

entries.english: Atlassian Confluence Cloud: work with spaces, pages and content, with automatic ADF-to-Markdown conversion.
entries.zh: Atlassian Confluence Cloud：操作空间、页面和内容，自动将 ADF 转为 Markdown。

entries.english: Atlassian Jira Cloud: work with projects, issues, comments and related development information.
entries.zh: Atlassian Jira Cloud：操作项目、问题、评论及相关开发信息。

entries.english: Wraps mcp-atlassian with Playwright SSO login to reach Atlassian Server/Data Center behind corporate SSO (Okta, SAML, ADFS) where API tokens are unavailable.
entries.zh: 为 mcp-atlassian 封装 Playwright SSO 登录，以访问企业 SSO（Okta、SAML、ADFS）后无法使用 API 令牌的 Atlassian Server/Data Center。

entries.english: Project Telos local tools for inspectable AI work: source intake, workspace context, routing ledgers, action receipts and verification packets.
entries.zh: Project Telos 的本地工具，支持可检查的 AI 工作：来源接收、工作区上下文、路由账本、操作凭据和验证包。

entries.english: Atlassian Jira and Confluence with schema-validated Markdown/ADF conversion that flags content-model violations instead of silently dropping nodes.
entries.zh: Atlassian Jira 和 Confluence，支持经模式验证的 Markdown/ADF 转换，在内容模型违规时标记问题而不是静默丢弃节点。

entries.english: Visualize code, architecture and other concepts as Mermaid diagrams in a locally hosted web app.
entries.zh: 在本地托管的网页应用中将代码、架构和其他概念可视化为 Mermaid 图表。

entries.english: Identifies important files in a codebase from dependency relationships, with diagrams and importance scores.
entries.zh: 根据依赖关系识别代码库中的重要文件，并提供图表和重要性评分。

entries.english: App Store Connect and Google Play Console: iOS and Android app management, TestFlight, builds, submissions, prices and sales reports.
entries.zh: App Store Connect 和 Google Play Console：管理 iOS 和 Android 应用、TestFlight、构建、提交、价格和销售报告。

entries.english: Chrome Web Store extension management: upload, publish, check status, staged rollouts and metadata updates.
entries.zh: Chrome 网上应用店扩展管理：上传、发布、检查状态、分阶段发布和更新元数据。

entries.english: npm package management: publish, version, search, audit, install and more.
entries.zh: npm 包管理：发布、管理版本、搜索、审计、安装等。

entries.english: Read-first code IDE whose bundled server exposes a project's tasks, comments, reading progress and bookmarks as MCP resources — plus browser-preview inspection tools — so a coding agent can consult your review and mark each task done or failed. `reado mcp`
entries.zh: 阅读优先的代码 IDE，其内置服务器将项目任务、评论、阅读进度和书签作为 MCP 资源公开，并提供浏览器预览检查工具，让编程代理参考你的审查并将每项任务标记为完成或失败。`reado mcp`

entries.english: Autonomous web app testing: run test cases in real browsers with pass/fail results and screenshots, and generate user stories, test cases and Playwright code.
entries.zh: 自主网页应用测试：在真实浏览器中运行测试用例，提供通过/失败结果及截图，并生成用户故事、测试用例和 Playwright 代码。

entries.english: Generates Architecture Decision Records from Claude Code conversations, with quality review, duplicate detection, a dependency graph and stale ADR alerts.
entries.zh: 从 Claude Code 对话生成架构决策记录（ADR），提供质量审查、重复检测、依赖图和过期 ADR 警报。

entries.english: Android and iOS runtime inspection and control via Frida: method hooks, state inspection, temporary overrides, UI actions and screenshots.
entries.zh: 通过 Frida 检查和控制 Android 与 iOS 运行时：方法钩子、状态检查、临时覆盖、界面操作和截图。

entries.english: Persistent Tree-sitter code index for precise, compact code search in languages including C#, TypeScript, Python, Rust and Go.
entries.zh: 持久化 Tree-sitter 代码索引，支持 C#、TypeScript、Python、Rust、Go 等语言的精确紧凑代码搜索。

entries.english: Deterministic, offline detector for filler phrases and clichés in AI-generated prose, using a curated phrase list and returning exact spans and a 0-1 score.
entries.zh: 确定性离线检测 AI 生成文章中的填充短语和陈词滥调，使用精选短语列表，返回精确位置和 0–1 分数。

entries.english: Hierarchical code intelligence: scans local source, clusters files by behavioral role, maps coupling seams and finds similar in-repo code for complex tasks.
entries.zh: 分层代码智能：扫描本地源码，按行为角色聚类文件、绘制耦合连接点，并为复杂任务查找仓库内相似代码。

entries.english: Structured .aide spec files that give agents progressive disclosure of codebase architecture.
entries.zh: 结构化 .aide 规范文件，向代理逐步披露代码库架构。

entries.english: Read-only local code graph for Rust, Cangjie, ArkTS, TS/JS, C/C++, Python and Shell: call graphs, quality gates, change review and impact analysis.
entries.zh: 面向 Rust、Cangjie、ArkTS、TS/JS、C/C++、Python 和 Shell 的只读本地代码图谱：调用图、质量关卡、变更审查和影响分析。

entries.english: Code analysis, JSON repair, encoding fixes and import organization for local projects.
entries.zh: 为本地项目提供代码分析、JSON 修复、编码修复和导入整理。

entries.english: Apple Icon Composer: create .icon bundles with Liquid Glass effects (iOS 26+), tune glass effects, set dark mode appearances and export for the App Store.
entries.zh: Apple Icon Composer：创建带 Liquid Glass 效果的 .icon 包（iOS 26+）、调整玻璃效果、设置深色模式外观并导出至 App Store。

entries.english: Generate PWA, iOS and Android app icon sets from a text description with Google Imagen 4: all required sizes, maskable icons, splash screens and manifest.json.
entries.zh: 使用 Google Imagen 4 根据文字描述生成 PWA、iOS 和 Android 应用图标集，包含所有必需尺寸、可遮罩图标、启动画面和 manifest.json。

entries.english: Dynamic SOC security threat analysis for a Text2SQL AI agent.
entries.zh: 面向 Text2SQL AI 代理的动态 SOC 安全威胁分析。

entries.english: Search, install and manage agent skills (SKILL.md files) from GitHub repositories, with workspace analysis for personalized recommendations.
entries.zh: 从 GitHub 仓库搜索、安装和管理代理技能（SKILL.md 文件），并分析工作区以提供个性化推荐。

entries.english: Create, retrieve and delete webhooks on webhook-test.com.
entries.zh: 在 webhook-test.com 创建、获取和删除 Webhook。

entries.english: Gives agents props, examples and CSS variables for the Bestax React component library (Bulma v1). Runs offline.
entries.zh: 为代理提供 Bestax React 组件库（Bulma v1）的属性、示例和 CSS 变量。离线运行。

entries.english: Control the iOS Simulator.
entries.zh: 控制 iOS 模拟器。

entries.english: Look up SDKs, frameworks and dependencies used by macOS and Windows desktop apps, search by technology adoption and compare stacks via Desktop Insights.
entries.zh: 通过 Desktop Insights 查询 macOS 和 Windows 桌面应用使用的 SDK、框架和依赖，按技术采用情况搜索并比较技术栈。

entries.english: ReSharper solution-wide inspections and code cleanup for C# solutions via JetBrains' command-line tools, without an IDE. Unofficial.
entries.zh: 通过 JetBrains 命令行工具对 C# 解决方案进行 ReSharper 全解决方案检查和代码清理，无需 IDE。非官方。

entries.english: Retrieve SonarQube project information: current and historical metrics, issues and health status.
entries.zh: 获取 SonarQube 项目信息：当前和历史指标、问题及健康状态。

entries.english: PHP static analysis: code quality metrics, problem detection, refactoring priorities, dependency graphs, git hotspots, test coverage and impact analysis.
entries.zh: PHP 静态分析：代码质量指标、问题检测、重构优先级、依赖图、git 热点、测试覆盖率和影响分析。

entries.english: Search and get up-to-date information about npm, Cargo, PyPI and NuGet packages.
entries.zh: 搜索并获取 npm、Cargo、PyPI 和 NuGet 包的最新信息。

entries.english: Read-only registry of animated companion packs (pets) for Codex: search, preview and install community pets and generate badges and embed cards.
entries.zh: 面向 Codex 动画伙伴包（宠物）的只读注册表：搜索、预览和安装社区宠物，并生成徽章与嵌入卡片。

entries.english: Maven Central dependency intelligence: bulk version comparison, stability filtering, dependency age analysis, release patterns and Context7 upgrade guidance.
entries.zh: Maven Central 依赖情报：批量版本比较、稳定性筛选、依赖年龄分析、发布模式和 Context7 升级指导。

entries.english: Up-to-date framework documentation for React, Next.js, Laravel, FastAPI, Tailwind CSS and more.
entries.zh: 提供 React、Next.js、Laravel、FastAPI、Tailwind CSS 等框架的最新文档。

entries.english: Lossless context guard for coding agents: outlines large files with line ranges and digests noisy command output (tests, builds, installs), with full output always retrievable. `pipx install skimread`
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的无损上下文保护工具：以行范围概述大型文件，摘要冗长的命令输出（测试、构建、安装），完整输出始终可取回。`pipx install skimread`

entries.english: Jenkins CI/CD: job management, build status tracking, pipeline monitoring, artifact and queue management, and batch operations.
entries.zh: Jenkins CI/CD：任务管理、构建状态跟踪、流水线监控、产物与队列管理及批量操作。

entries.english: Local, read-only search of the Python standard library docs with exact symbol lookup, section-level results and version-aware context.
entries.zh: 本地只读搜索 Python 标准库文档，支持精确符号查找、章节级结果和版本感知上下文。

entries.english: Analyze React code locally and generate docs or llm.txt for a whole project at once.
entries.zh: 在本地分析 React 代码，并一次性为整个项目生成文档或 llm.txt。

entries.english: Load Claude Code skills into agents without copying files: discover, read and install skills on demand.
entries.zh: 无需复制文件即可将 Claude Code 技能载入代理：按需发现、读取和安装技能。

entries.english: Converts any OpenAPI/Swagger specification into MCP tools automatically.
entries.zh: 自动将任意 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范转换为 MCP 工具。

entries.english: Compact structured-JSON replacements for built-in file, search, exec and git tools, with git, cargo, gh and docker plugins, output filtering and batching.
entries.zh: 以紧凑的结构化 JSON 替代内置文件、搜索、执行和 git 工具，提供 git、cargo、gh 和 docker 插件以及输出筛选和批处理。

entries.english: Valkey and Redis observability: query real-time metrics, analyze slow commands, detect hot keys and investigate performance issues.
entries.zh: Valkey 和 Redis 可观测性：查询实时指标、分析慢命令、检测热点键并调查性能问题。

entries.english: Semantic code indexer with a GraphRAG knowledge graph: index a codebase and search it in natural language to understand its architecture.
entries.zh: 带 GraphRAG 知识图谱的语义代码索引器：索引代码库并用自然语言搜索，以理解其架构。

entries.english: Research, analysis and discovery across GitHub and npm in real time.
entries.zh: 实时研究、分析和探索 GitHub 与 npm。

entries.english: Bitrise API: app management, build operations, artifact management and more.
entries.zh: Bitrise API：应用管理、构建操作、产物管理等。

entries.english: Zero-configuration Go library that exposes existing Echo web framework APIs as MCP tools.
entries.zh: 零配置 Go 库，将现有 Echo Web 框架 API 作为 MCP 工具公开。

entries.english: Buildkite: create pipelines, diagnose and fix failures, trigger builds, monitor job queues and more.
entries.zh: Buildkite：创建流水线、诊断和修复故障、触发构建、监控任务队列等。

entries.english: Verified, version-pinned records of new dependency bugs: your coding agent looks an error up before searching the web (91% vs 68% correct on whether a bug is known or fixed, 56 fresh bugs). Read-only by default.
entries.zh: 经过验证并固定版本的新依赖缺陷记录：编程代理在搜索网页前先查询错误（针对缺陷是否已知或已修复的判断，正确率为 91% 对 68%，涉及 56 个新缺陷）。默认只读。

entries.english: Manage Featureflip feature flags: create and toggle flags, edit targeting rules and find stale flags.
entries.zh: 管理 Featureflip 功能开关：创建和切换开关、编辑定向规则并查找过期开关。

entries.english: Run any number of LSP servers from one YAML config for diagnostics, go-to-definition and rename, plus server-specific features like Rust macro expansion.
entries.zh: 通过一个 YAML 配置运行任意数量的 LSP 服务器，用于诊断、跳转定义和重命名，并支持 Rust 宏展开等服务器专有功能。

entries.english: iOS memory leak and performance investigation: reads .memgraph and .trace files, classifies retain cycles against known patterns and suggests Swift fixes.
entries.zh: iOS 内存泄漏和性能调查：读取 .memgraph 和 .trace 文件，根据已知模式分类保留循环并建议 Swift 修复方案。

entries.english: Fine-tune open-source LLMs (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, Gemma) on your data with LoRA, QLoRA or full fine-tuning, plus cost estimation and S3 export.
entries.zh: 使用 LoRA、QLoRA 或全量微调，基于自己的数据微调开源大语言模型（Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek、Mistral、Gemma），并支持成本估算及导出至 S3。

entries.english: Buildable development platform: manage tasks, track progress, get project context and collaborate with humans on software projects.
entries.zh: Buildable 开发平台：管理任务、跟踪进度、获取项目上下文并与人协作开发软件项目。

entries.english: Fix CircleCI build failures.
entries.zh: 修复 CircleCI 构建失败。

entries.english: Zero-configuration Go library that exposes existing Gin web framework APIs as MCP tools.
entries.zh: 零配置 Go 库，将现有 Gin Web 框架 API 作为 MCP 工具公开。

entries.english: Manage Docker containers, images, volumes and networks.
entries.zh: 管理 Docker 容器、镜像、卷和网络。

entries.english: Search and share Claude Code snippets, prompts, Q&A solutions, error fixes and MCP server configurations from the ClaudeCodeNavi community.
entries.zh: 搜索和分享 ClaudeCodeNavi 社区的 Claude Code 代码片段、提示词、问答解决方案、错误修复和 MCP 服务器配置。

entries.english: API testing: per-project environments with variable interpolation, saved collections, multi-step flows, assertions, load testing and OpenAPI mock generation.
entries.zh: API 测试：按项目配置支持变量插值的环境、保存的集合、多步骤流程、断言、负载测试和 OpenAPI 模拟服务生成。

entries.english: Structured file edits for agents: JSON, YAML and TOML by selector, Markdown and AST edits, dry runs and multi-file transactional batches.
entries.zh: 面向代理的结构化文件编辑：通过选择器编辑 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，支持 Markdown 和 AST 编辑、试运行及多文件事务批处理。

entries.english: Shows agents which patterns a codebase actually uses, which files a change will affect and when there is too little context to trust an edit. Runs locally.
entries.zh: 向代理展示代码库实际使用的模式、变更将影响哪些文件，以及何时上下文过少而无法信任编辑结果。本地运行。

entries.english: CodeLogic code dependency analytics, architectural risk analysis and impact assessment.
entries.zh: CodeLogic 代码依赖分析、架构风险分析和影响评估。

entries.english: Compiler-resolved call graph for TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python and Java that traces a function's callers up to HTTP routes and handlers in one call.
entries.zh: 由编译器解析的 TypeScript/JavaScript、Go、Python 和 Java 调用图，一次调用即可将函数调用方追踪至 HTTP 路由和处理程序。

entries.english: Conan C/C++ package manager: create projects, manage dependencies, check licenses and scan for security vulnerabilities.
entries.zh: Conan C/C++ 包管理器：创建项目、管理依赖、检查许可证并扫描安全漏洞。

entries.english: ConfigCat feature flag platform: manage feature flags, configs, environments, products and organizations.
entries.zh: ConfigCat 功能开关平台：管理功能开关、配置、环境、产品和组织。

entries.english: Monitors agent context health: token utilization, context quality degradation and session fatigue, with 0-100 health scores and recovery recommendations.
entries.zh: 监控代理上下文健康状况：令牌利用率、上下文质量下降和会话疲劳，提供 0–100 健康评分及恢复建议。

entries.english: Local-first content governance: model and content CRUD, validation, normalization and i18n across any framework.
entries.zh: 本地优先的内容治理：跨任意框架进行模型和内容的增删改查、验证、规范化及国际化。

entries.english: Identifies refactoring hotspots to help agents improve code.
entries.zh: 识别重构热点，帮助代理改进代码。

entries.english: Lowers Manus AI usage costs through model routing, smart testing and context hygiene.
entries.zh: 通过模型路由、智能测试和上下文整理降低 Manus AI 的使用成本。

entries.english: Fix Playwright test failures reported to Currents.
entries.zh: 修复向 Currents 报告的 Playwright 测试失败。

entries.english: AI coding usage analytics: track spend, model usage and costs across Cursor and Claude Code sessions.
entries.zh: AI 编程使用分析：跟踪 Cursor 和 Claude Code 会话的支出、模型用量和成本。

entries.english: JetBrains TeamCity: builds, tests, build agents and CI/CD pipeline management, with dev and full modes switchable at runtime.
entries.zh: JetBrains TeamCity：管理构建、测试、构建代理和 CI/CD 流水线，可在运行时切换开发和完整模式。

entries.english: Publish HTML as live, shareable web pages with public, password-protected or email-restricted access.
entries.zh: 将 HTML 发布为可分享的在线网页，支持公开、密码保护或限定邮箱访问。

entries.english: Figma control: create shapes, text and components, and set styles, auto-layout, variables and exports.
entries.zh: 控制 Figma：创建形状、文本和组件，设置样式、自动布局、变量及导出。

entries.english: Build and edit Figma designs: JSX-like tree creation, variables and tokens, components, cross-page navigation and screenshot-based visual verification.
entries.zh: 构建和编辑 Figma 设计：通过类似 JSX 的树创建内容，使用变量和设计令牌、组件、跨页面导航及基于截图的视觉验证。

entries.english: Network control and management via the POX SDN controller.
entries.zh: 通过 POX SDN 控制器进行网络控制和管理。

entries.english: API governance: detects breaking changes between OpenAPI/Swagger spec versions using configurable policy rules, with structured pass/fail verdicts.
entries.zh: API 治理：使用可配置策略规则检测 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范版本间的破坏性变更，并给出结构化通过/失败判定。

entries.english: Deployment tracking and monitoring with live status badges.
entries.zh: 使用实时状态徽章跟踪和监控部署。

entries.english: Interact with Docker Hub: repositories, search and Docker Hardened Images.
entries.zh: 操作 Docker Hub：仓库、搜索和 Docker Hardened Images。

entries.english: Offline access to TwitterAPI.io documentation: endpoint references, guides and authentication docs.
entries.zh: 离线访问 TwitterAPI.io 文档：端点参考、指南和认证文档。

entries.english: Markdown reader and editor that tells coding agents what you are reading: the open document, section and selection, unread changes, your comments to resolve, and section search across the project. Read-only, local and off until enabled per project.
entries.zh: Markdown 阅读器和编辑器，向编程代理说明你正在阅读的内容：打开的文档、章节和选区、未读变更、待处理评论以及跨项目章节搜索。只读、本地运行，需逐项目启用。

entries.english: Curated Swift and SwiftUI patterns and real-world code examples from sources like Swift by Sundell and SwiftLee.
entries.zh: 精选 Swift 和 SwiftUI 模式及来自 Swift by Sundell、SwiftLee 等来源的真实代码示例。

entries.english: Deterministic structural analysis of systems described in EN syntax: topology, bottlenecks, blast radius, tracing, diffs and centrality.
entries.zh: 对以 EN 语法描述的系统进行确定性结构分析：拓扑、瓶颈、影响范围、跟踪、差异和中心性。

entries.english: Share Android and iOS builds with testers: detects Expo, React Native or Flutter, runs the build, uploads the .apk or .ipa to buildtree, and returns install links, a QR code image and tester feedback.
entries.zh: 与测试人员分享 Android 和 iOS 构建：检测 Expo、React Native 或 Flutter，执行构建，将 .apk 或 .ipa 上传至 buildtree，并返回安装链接、二维码图片和测试反馈。

entries.english: Exposes .context/ folder files as MCP resources so Claude Code can reference project documentation via @ mentions.
entries.zh: 将 .context/ 文件夹中的文件公开为 MCP 资源，让 Claude Code 可通过 @ 提及引用项目文档。

entries.english: Visual DOM element selector for coding agents: a Chrome extension and server bridge to capture page elements with Option+Click.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的可视化 DOM 元素选择器：通过 Chrome 扩展和服务器桥接，使用 Option+Click 捕获页面元素。

entries.english: Build smart-glasses apps: scaffold, validate and simulate Meta smart glasses integrations (camera capture, voice, audio) in Android and iOS apps.
entries.zh: 构建智能眼镜应用：在 Android 和 iOS 应用中搭建、验证和模拟 Meta 智能眼镜集成（相机拍摄、语音、音频）。

entries.english: Task management for AI-driven development: PRD parsing, task expansion, multi-provider support and selective tool loading to save context.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 驱动开发的任务管理：PRD 解析、任务展开、多服务商支持和选择性加载工具以节省上下文。

entries.english: Generate API test cases from Swagger/OpenAPI specs (auth, validation, boundary, security and more) and export them to Gherkin, Postman, k6, pytest or TestRail.
entries.zh: 根据 Swagger/OpenAPI 规范生成 API 测试用例（认证、验证、边界、安全等），并导出为 Gherkin、Postman、k6、pytest 或 TestRail。

entries.english: Multi-perspective architecture review from viewpoints like CTO, security, product and DevOps, plus AI collaboration coaching and idea scoring.
entries.zh: 从 CTO、安全、产品和 DevOps 等视角进行多维架构审查，并提供 AI 协作指导和创意评分。

entries.english: Ship iOS and Android apps end to end: App Store Connect, Google Play Console and Expo EAS builds, listings, screenshots, privacy labels, review submission and App Review replies.
entries.zh: 端到端交付 iOS 和 Android 应用：管理 App Store Connect、Google Play Console 和 Expo EAS 构建、商店信息、截图、隐私标签、审核提交及 App Review 回复。

entries.english: Interact with feature flags in Flipt.
entries.zh: 操作 Flipt 中的功能开关。

entries.english: Deterministic agent execution engine (browser, file, Docker, data, crypto, scheduling modules) with execution traces, evidence snapshots and step replay.
entries.zh: 确定性代理执行引擎（浏览器、文件、Docker、数据、加密、调度模块），提供执行跟踪、证据快照和步骤重放。

entries.english: Utility APIs: email validation, DNS lookup, WHOIS, SSL certificate inspection, IBAN validation, business day calculation, hashing and GPU prices.
entries.zh: 实用 API：邮箱验证、DNS 查询、WHOIS、SSL 证书检查、IBAN 验证、工作日计算、哈希和 GPU 价格。

entries.english: Render PDFs and images from HTML templates (Jinja2, Liquid, Handlebars) or Word and PowerPoint files, check data against a template's schema before rendering, and convert Office documents to PDF through the Formfeed API. `npx -y @formfeed/mcp`, or the hosted endpoint `https://mcp.formfeed.dev/mcp`.
entries.zh: 从 HTML 模板（Jinja2、Liquid、Handlebars）或 Word 和 PowerPoint 文件渲染 PDF 与图片，在渲染前按模板模式检查数据，并通过 Formfeed API 将 Office 文档转换为 PDF。`npx -y @formfeed/mcp`，或使用托管端点 `https://mcp.formfeed.dev/mcp`。

entries.english: Code-quality gate for Bazel monorepos: runs lint, coverage and architecture checks from the build graph and returns a pass/fail verdict.
entries.zh: Bazel 单体仓库的代码质量关卡：根据构建图运行 lint、覆盖率和架构检查，并返回通过/失败判定。

entries.english: LynxPrompt prompt management: create, search and organize AI prompts and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md configuration files.
entries.zh: LynxPrompt 提示词管理：创建、搜索和整理 AI 提示词以及 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 配置文件。

entries.english: Deterministic code map for AI coding agents: a tree-sitter symbol and call graph with exact file:line callers and callees, the evidence behind each edge, diff impact and test discovery across 20 languages.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编程代理的确定性代码地图：基于 tree-sitter 的符号和调用图，提供精确到 file:line 的调用方和被调用方、每条边的证据、差异影响和跨 20 种语言的测试发现。

entries.english: Search, inspect and compare AI agent infrastructure tools (cloud browsers, code sandboxes, memory, search APIs and more) from the Agent Stack Directory open dataset. Read-only, no API key.
entries.zh: 从 Agent Stack Directory 开放数据集搜索、查看和比较 AI 代理基础设施工具（云浏览器、代码沙箱、记忆、搜索 API 等）。只读，无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Generate and visualize unified diffs as HTML or PNG, with side-by-side and line-by-line views for filesystem dry runs.
entries.zh: 将统一差异生成为 HTML 或 PNG 并可视化，提供并排和逐行视图，用于文件系统试运行。

entries.english: SQL validation, formatting, parsing, linting, security scanning and metadata extraction across multiple SQL dialects.
entries.zh: 跨多种 SQL 方言进行 SQL 验证、格式化、解析、检查、安全扫描和元数据提取。

entries.english: Renders a frontend with Playwright and audits spacing, gaps and element sizes against a design scale, returning fix hints. Tailwind-first.
entries.zh: 使用 Playwright 渲染前端，对照设计尺度审查间距、间隔和元素大小，并返回修复提示。优先支持 Tailwind。

entries.english: Up-to-date documentation for a specific Rust crate via semantic search and LLM summarization.
entries.zh: 通过语义搜索和大语言模型摘要提供特定 Rust crate 的最新文档。

entries.english: Renders HTML in a headless browser and detects layout defects (text overlap, element overflow, leftover placeholders) without baseline images.
entries.zh: 在无头浏览器中渲染 HTML 并检测布局缺陷（文本重叠、元素溢出、遗留占位符），无需基准图片。

entries.english: Version-aware docs for coding agents: finds llms.txt, OpenAPI and skill specs, resolves dependency versions, detects pitfalls and verifies code.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的版本感知文档：查找 llms.txt、OpenAPI 和技能规范，解析依赖版本、检测陷阱并验证代码。

entries.english: JetBrains IDE plugin giving coding agents programmatic control of the debugger.
entries.zh: JetBrains IDE 插件，让编程代理以编程方式控制调试器。

entries.english: JetBrains IDE plugin exposing indexing and refactoring features: rename, safe delete, find references, call and type hierarchy, diagnostics and more.
entries.zh: JetBrains IDE 插件，公开索引和重构功能：重命名、安全删除、查找引用、调用与类型层次结构、诊断等。

entries.english: Regression testing for AI agents: save golden baselines, detect behavioral drift and block regressions in CI.
entries.zh: AI 代理回归测试：保存黄金基线、检测行为漂移并在 CI 中阻止回归。

entries.english: Maintain and use API collections, replacing REST clients like Postman or Insomnia.
entries.zh: 维护和使用 API 集合，替代 Postman 或 Insomnia 等 REST 客户端。

entries.english: Authenticated calls to any REST API: auto-login, token caching, 2FA/OTP support, Swagger spec fetching and fuzzy endpoint search.
entries.zh: 对任意 REST API 发起经过认证的调用：自动登录、令牌缓存、2FA/OTP 支持、获取 Swagger 规范和端点模糊搜索。

entries.english: Go code analysis via gopls, the Go language server.
entries.zh: 通过 Go 语言服务器 gopls 分析 Go 代码。

entries.english: Deterministic tech stack recommendations scored on six dimensions: analyze and compare technologies and get stack suggestions for any project type.
entries.zh: 按六个维度评分的确定性技术栈建议：分析和比较技术，并为任意项目类型提供技术栈建议。

entries.english: Deploy and operate multi-user web apps: magic-link sign-in, a shared realtime database, per-role permissions, email notifications and file uploads.
entries.zh: 部署和运行多用户网页应用：魔法链接登录、共享实时数据库、按角色设置权限、邮件通知和文件上传。

entries.english: Interact with the Bruno API client.
entries.zh: 操作 Bruno API 客户端。

entries.english: Detect dead code, circular dependencies, coupling and architectural drift.
entries.zh: 检测死代码、循环依赖、耦合和架构漂移。

entries.english: Generic remote server that provides documentation for any GitHub repository or project.
entries.zh: 通用远程服务器，为任何 GitHub 仓库或项目提供文档。

entries.english: Read-only access to self-hosted SonarQube Community Build: issues, security hotspots, rules and code snippets so an agent can fix findings locally.
entries.zh: 只读访问自托管的 SonarQube Community Build：问题、安全热点、规则和代码片段，让代理可在本地修复发现的问题。

entries.english: Turns thumbs-up/down feedback into enforced pre-action gates via PreToolUse hooks, stopping coding agents from repeating mistakes.
entries.zh: 通过 PreToolUse 钩子将点赞/点踩反馈转为操作前强制关卡，防止编程代理重复错误。

entries.english: Drive Android emulators and devices over adb: screenshots, UI inspection, tap/swipe/type, app lifecycle, logcat, screen recording and Gradle builds and tests.
entries.zh: 通过 adb 操作 Android 模拟器和设备：截图、界面检查、点击/滑动/输入、应用生命周期、logcat、屏幕录制及 Gradle 构建和测试。

entries.english: Zuul CI: build failure analysis, log search, pipeline status and job configuration.
entries.zh: Zuul CI：构建故障分析、日志搜索、流水线状态和任务配置。

entries.english: Interact with iOS simulators (iPhone, iPad and more) through natural language commands.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言命令操作 iOS 模拟器（iPhone、iPad 等）。

entries.english: Persistent pixel-art characters that reflect an agent's state in real time: report work state, mark tasks complete, signal errors and check status.
entries.zh: 实时反映代理状态的持久像素风角色：报告工作状态、标记任务完成、发出错误信号并检查状态。

entries.english: Local image and video processing: resize, convert, compress, crop, thumbnails, metadata extraction, rotate, flip, filters and ffmpeg-based video operations.
entries.zh: 本地图片和视频处理：调整大小、转换、压缩、裁剪、缩略图、元数据提取、旋转、翻转、滤镜和基于 ffmpeg 的视频操作。

entries.english: Backend-as-a-service for agents building full-stack apps: auth, PostgreSQL database, storage and functions.
entries.zh: 面向构建全栈应用的代理的后端即服务：认证、PostgreSQL 数据库、存储和函数。

entries.english: Mobile E2E testing on macOS: iOS Simulator control, native UI automation, Maestro flows, React Native debugging and WebView DOM inspection.
entries.zh: macOS 上的移动端端到端测试：iOS 模拟器控制、原生界面自动化、Maestro 流程、React Native 调试和 WebView DOM 检查。

entries.english: Navigate codebases with language server tools: go to definition, find references, rename and diagnostics.
entries.zh: 使用语言服务器工具浏览代码库：跳转定义、查找引用、重命名和诊断。

entries.english: Stateful layer over real language servers: persistent sessions keep indexes warm, and speculative execution simulates edits in memory before writing to disk.
entries.zh: 真实语言服务器之上的有状态层：持久会话保持索引热态，推测执行在写入磁盘前于内存中模拟编辑。

entries.english: AI-powered search and querying of the Vercel AI SDK documentation.
entries.zh: 利用 AI 搜索和查询 Vercel AI SDK 文档。

entries.english: Search repos, fetch AI-generated wiki docs and ask questions about any open-source repository via codewiki.google.
entries.zh: 通过 codewiki.google 搜索仓库、获取 AI 生成的 Wiki 文档并就任意开源仓库提问。

entries.english: Local hybrid code search (vector, BM25 and code graph) with structural code graph analysis and persistent semantic memory.
entries.zh: 本地混合代码搜索（向量、BM25 和代码图谱），提供结构化代码图谱分析及持久语义记忆。

entries.english: Manifest-driven MCP server scaffolder: generate MCP servers from YAML manifests, with batch registration and a live routing hub.
entries.zh: 由清单驱动的 MCP 服务器脚手架：根据 YAML 清单生成 MCP 服务器，支持批量注册和实时路由中心。

entries.english: Extracts a visual contract from a live page or Figma frame and measures a UI implementation against it, one line per property that drifted.
entries.zh: 从实时页面或 Figma 画框提取视觉契约，并据此衡量界面实现，每个发生偏差的属性列一行。

entries.english: Developer and security utilities via the onlinecybertools.com API: encoding, hashing, JWT decoding, regex testing, formatters, network diagnostics and OSINT.
entries.zh: 通过 onlinecybertools.com API 提供开发与安全工具：编码、哈希、JWT 解码、正则测试、格式化、网络诊断和开源情报（OSINT）。

entries.english: Structural codebase graph: scans entities, relationships and feature flows across languages so LLMs navigate by structure instead of grepping.
entries.zh: 结构化代码库图谱：跨语言扫描实体、关系和功能流程，让大语言模型按结构导航而无需 grep。

entries.english: TNL (Typed Natural Language): per-feature English contracts that coding agents can look up, propose edits to and verify implementations against.
entries.zh: TNL（Typed Natural Language）：按功能编写的英文契约，编程代理可查询、提出修改并据此验证实现。

entries.english: Extracts essential code structure from large codebases into an AI-digestible format so agents write code that correctly uses existing APIs.
entries.zh: 从大型代码库提取关键代码结构并转换为 AI 易于理解的格式，帮助代理编写正确使用现有 API 的代码。

entries.english: Search and contribute to a community-verified knowledge base of engineering issues and fixes, with trust scores and fix verification.
entries.zh: 搜索并贡献经社区验证的工程问题和修复知识库，提供信任评分和修复验证。

entries.english: Local-first safety and verification layer for coding agents: workspace confinement, command allowlists, scope-violation detection and auditable task evidence.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地优先安全与验证层：工作区限制、命令允许列表、越界检测和可审计的任务证据。

entries.english: Regulation and deadline linters for EU CRA, DORA, NIS2, the EU AI Act, PCI DSS, WCAG, e-invoicing and more, reporting file, line and fix for each finding.
entries.zh: 针对欧盟 CRA、DORA、NIS2、欧盟 AI 法案、PCI DSS、WCAG、电子发票等的法规与截止期限检查器，为每项发现报告文件、行号和修复方案。

entries.english: CMS managed via natural language: publish content and manage templates, assets, themes, redirects and multi-site forks, with versioning and semantic search.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言管理的 CMS：发布内容并管理模板、素材、主题、重定向和多站点分支，支持版本管理及语义搜索。

entries.english: Access CSV files via RestCSV.
entries.zh: 通过 RestCSV 访问 CSV 文件。

entries.english: Dependency picker for coding agents: recommends and compares GitHub repos for a need, scored 0-100 on momentum, maintenance, npm/PyPI downloads and license, with a one-line verdict.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的依赖选择器：根据需求推荐并比较 GitHub 仓库，按发展势头、维护、npm/PyPI 下载量和许可证打 0–100 分，并给出一句话结论。

entries.english: Access shadcn/ui v4 components, blocks, demos and metadata.
entries.zh: 访问 shadcn/ui v4 组件、区块、演示和元数据。

entries.english: Run ping, traceroute, mtr, HTTP and DNS measurements from locations around the world via Globalping.
entries.zh: 通过 Globalping 从全球各地运行 ping、traceroute、mtr、HTTP 和 DNS 测量。

entries.english: IDE for agents: read code by symbol, edit with compiler diagnostics, validate with the project's own build and tests, and revert to checkpoints.
entries.zh: 面向代理的 IDE：按符号读取代码、结合编译器诊断编辑、用项目自身构建和测试进行验证，并可回滚到检查点。

entries.english: Estimate, submit, monitor and fetch logs for GPU inference, training, fine-tuning and batch workloads on Jungle Grid.
entries.zh: 在 Jungle Grid 上估算、提交和监控 GPU 推理、训练、微调和批处理工作负载，并获取日志。

entries.english: Scan codebases for LLM API calls and estimate monthly costs. Compare costs between git refs to catch cost regressions during code review.
entries.zh: 扫描代码库中的大语言模型 API 调用并估算月成本，比较不同 git 引用的成本，以便在代码审查中发现成本回归。

entries.english: Token-efficient access to OpenAPI/Swagger specs via MCP Resources.
entries.zh: 通过 MCP Resources 节省令牌地访问 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范。

entries.english: Code search for AI coding agents with hybrid retrieval, structural search and shared indexing across Git worktrees. Requires PostgreSQL with pgvector and Apache AGE.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编程代理的代码搜索，支持混合检索、结构化搜索和跨 Git 工作树共享索引。需要带 pgvector 和 Apache AGE 的 PostgreSQL。

entries.english: End-to-end QA loop: analyzes web pages or mobile screens, generates and runs pytest or Maestro tests with auto-retry, and writes an optimization plan.
entries.zh: 端到端质量保证闭环：分析网页或移动屏幕，生成并运行带自动重试的 pytest 或 Maestro 测试，并编写优化计划。

entries.english: Translates design tokens from Tailwind, CSS, Figma or W3C DTCG into Material 3, SwiftUI, Tailwind config and CSS variables, with WCAG contrast validation.
entries.zh: 将 Tailwind、CSS、Figma 或 W3C DTCG 设计令牌转换为 Material 3、SwiftUI、Tailwind 配置和 CSS 变量，并验证 WCAG 对比度。

entries.english: Bug-report triage and fix dispatch: plain-English diagnoses of user-reported bugs with evidence, blast radius and a fix prompt, then automated GitHub fix PRs.
entries.zh: 缺陷报告分诊及修复派发：以通俗英文诊断用户报告的缺陷，附证据、影响范围和修复提示，然后自动创建 GitHub 修复 PR。

entries.english: Self-hosted server that captures design patterns, conventions and decisions from git history and developer feedback and serves them to coding agents.
entries.zh: 自托管服务器，从 git 历史和开发者反馈中捕获设计模式、约定及决策，并提供给编程代理。

entries.english: iOS development tools: build, run, screenshot and interact with the iOS Simulator.
entries.zh: iOS 开发工具：构建、运行、截图并操作 iOS 模拟器。

entries.english: Time-travel debugger with bidirectional execution replay, hash-chain audit logging and SIMD-accelerated stack unwinding.
entries.zh: 时间旅行调试器，支持双向执行重放、哈希链审计日志和 SIMD 加速的堆栈展开。

entries.english: MCP server / agent plugin for Maven and Gradle dependency intelligence: latest versions, outdated deps, CVEs, changelogs, licenses and project audits.
entries.zh: 面向 Maven 和 Gradle 依赖情报的 MCP 服务器 / 代理插件：最新版本、过时依赖、CVE、更新日志、许可证和项目审计。

entries.english: Encoding-aware file read/edit for coding agents with indentation conversion and .editorconfig support, plus SSH, SFTP, process management and system utilities.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理、可感知编码的文件读取与编辑，支持缩进转换和 .editorconfig，另提供 SSH、SFTP、进程管理和系统工具。

entries.english: Local service orchestrator with a stdio MCP server for inspecting and controlling development services, logs, ports, actions and run history across live project runtimes.
entries.zh: 带 stdio MCP 服务器的本地服务编排器，可跨正在运行的项目环境检查和控制开发服务、日志、端口、操作和运行历史。

entries.english: Regression testing for MCP servers: discovers configured servers, checks capabilities, invokes tools, detects schema drift and recommends new servers.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器回归测试：发现已配置服务器、检查能力、调用工具、检测模式漂移并推荐新服务器。

entries.english: Read-only lookups for facts newer than a model's training cutoff: AI model costs, dependency maintenance, SaaS stack costs, shadcn registry items and more.
entries.zh: 只读查询晚于模型训练截止日期的事实：AI 模型成本、依赖维护情况、SaaS 技术栈成本、shadcn 注册表项目等。

entries.english: Roslyn-based Visual Studio integration: semantic code navigation, symbol search, inheritance trees, call graphs, safe rename and build/test execution.
entries.zh: 基于 Roslyn 的 Visual Studio 集成：语义代码导航、符号搜索、继承树、调用图、安全重命名和构建/测试执行。

entries.english: Analyze GitHub repositories' tech stack, dependencies, architecture, health metrics and security indicators with deterministic JSON output.
entries.zh: 分析 GitHub 仓库的技术栈、依赖、架构、健康指标和安全指标，输出确定性 JSON。

entries.english: Roslyn-based .NET code intelligence: type hierarchies, call graphs, DI registrations, diagnostics, code fixes and complexity metrics from pre-built indexes.
entries.zh: 基于 Roslyn 的 .NET 代码智能：从预构建索引获取类型层次、调用图、依赖注入注册、诊断、代码修复及复杂度指标。

entries.english: Access and manage LLM application prompts created with Langfuse Prompt Management.
entries.zh: 访问和管理使用 Langfuse Prompt Management 创建的大语言模型应用提示词。

entries.english: Underground Cultural District: developer utilities (UUID, JSON, Base64, hashing, JWT, regex, cron), creative tools and a marketplace of digital goods.
entries.zh: Underground Cultural District：开发工具（UUID、JSON、Base64、哈希、JWT、正则、cron）、创意工具和数字商品市场。

entries.english: Manage API test suites and test cases with atest.
entries.zh: 使用 atest 管理 API 测试套件和测试用例。

entries.english: Interact with Neovim.
entries.zh: 操作 Neovim。

entries.english: Feedback loop for coding agents: CI monitoring, process watching, file change detection and HTTP polling.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的反馈闭环：CI 监控、进程监视、文件变更检测和 HTTP 轮询。

entries.english: Local semantic code search with AST-aware chunking, hybrid BM25 and dense retrieval, and a code knowledge graph over codebases, docs sites and PDFs.
entries.zh: 本地语义代码搜索，支持感知 AST 的分块、混合 BM25 与稠密检索，以及覆盖代码库、文档网站和 PDF 的代码知识图谱。

entries.english: Detect AI-generated text via the GPTZero API, with confidence scores, probability breakdowns and French and Spanish support.
entries.zh: 通过 GPTZero API 检测 AI 生成文本，提供置信评分、概率明细，并支持法语和西班牙语。

entries.english: Exposes the Figma desktop app's Plugin API on the open file: inline renders, design token reading and one undo step per call, without the cloud API.
entries.zh: 在打开的文件上公开 Figma 桌面应用的 Plugin API：行内渲染、读取设计令牌，每次调用对应一个撤销步骤，无需云 API。

entries.english: Turns vague prompts into platform-optimized prompts for AI tools across image, video, voice, music, code, chat and document categories.
entries.zh: 将模糊提示词转换为针对各平台优化的提示词，适用于图片、视频、语音、音乐、代码、聊天和文档类 AI 工具。

entries.english: Local code graph for coding agents: find code by intent, follow callers and references, inspect blast radius and trace dependencies across repositories.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地代码图谱：按意图查找代码、追踪调用方和引用、检查影响范围并跨仓库追踪依赖。

entries.english: Version-pinned, offline documentation sourced from DevDocs.io.
entries.zh: 来自 DevDocs.io、固定版本的离线文档。

entries.english: Runs long-running commands a coding agent starts in Neovim (dev servers, watchers) as overseer.nvim tasks you can watch and stop from your task list.
entries.zh: 将编程代理在 Neovim 中启动的长时间运行命令（开发服务器、监视器）作为 overseer.nvim 任务运行，可从任务列表查看和停止。

entries.english: Control Neovim instances via msgpack-RPC: read and edit buffers, run commands, send keys, query LSP diagnostics and annotate code with highlights.
entries.zh: 通过 msgpack-RPC 控制 Neovim 实例：读取和编辑缓冲区、运行命令、发送按键、查询 LSP 诊断及使用高亮标注代码。

entries.english: Open and render Markdown files in MarkView, a native macOS Markdown preview app.
entries.zh: 在原生 macOS Markdown 预览应用 MarkView 中打开和渲染 Markdown 文件。

entries.english: On-demand .NET memory profiling with JetBrains dotMemory: detects memory leaks, LOH fragmentation and anti-patterns, and suggests code fixes.
entries.zh: 使用 JetBrains dotMemory 按需分析 .NET 内存：检测内存泄漏、LOH 碎片和反模式，并建议代码修复。

entries.english: Android device control via ADB: screenshots, UI tree inspection, touch automation, logcat and compound actions like tap-and-wait.
entries.zh: 通过 ADB 控制 Android 设备：截图、界面树检查、触控自动化、logcat 和点击后等待等组合操作。

entries.english: Read-only access to Swarmia metrics for quick reporting.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Swarmia 指标以快速生成报告。

entries.english: Up-to-date documentation for npm packages, fetched from the latest README in the package's GitHub repository.
entries.zh: 从 npm 包的 GitHub 仓库最新 README 获取该包的最新文档。

entries.english: Annotates any web page with hover labels for AI assistants via reverse proxy injection, without browser extensions.
entries.zh: 通过反向代理注入为任意网页添加悬停标签，供 AI 助手使用，无需浏览器扩展。

entries.english: Inspect microservices.sh Cloudflare-native modules and templates, generate app plans and projects, run checks and trigger confirmation-gated preview deploys.
entries.zh: 查看 microservices.sh 的 Cloudflare 原生模块和模板，生成应用计划和项目、运行检查，并触发需确认的预览部署。

entries.english: Checks that every computed number in a Markdown document still matches the formula that produced it, and plans — then applies, behind an explicit write gate — the repair, so an agent's correct formula can't ship with a wrong total.
entries.zh: 检查 Markdown 文档中每个计算出的数字是否仍与其公式一致，并规划修复，然后在明确的写入关卡后应用修复，避免代理公式正确却交付错误总数。

entries.english: Offload summaries, drafts, extractions and first-pass code reviews from a cloud LLM agent to a local Ollama model via handoff tools with built-in prompts.
entries.zh: 通过带内置提示词的交接工具，将云端大语言模型代理的摘要、草稿、提取和首轮代码审查任务交给本地 Ollama 模型。

entries.english: Structural codebase indexer for querying functions, classes, imports, dependency graphs and change impact.
entries.zh: 结构化代码库索引器，可查询函数、类、导入、依赖图和变更影响。

entries.english: Generate step-by-step development plans (PROJECT_BRIEF.md, DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md, CLAUDE.md) using the ClaudeCode-DevPlanBuilder methodology.
entries.zh: 使用 ClaudeCode-DevPlanBuilder 方法生成分步开发计划（PROJECT_BRIEF.md、DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md、CLAUDE.md）。

entries.english: Architectural decision governance for coding agents: submit proposals and query canonical decisions and their lineage, while humans keep final authority.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的架构决策治理：提交提案并查询权威决策及其沿革，最终决定权仍由人掌握。

entries.english: Android and iOS app and device automation, development and app scraping on simulators, emulators and physical devices.
entries.zh: 在模拟器、仿真器和实体设备上进行 Android 和 iOS 应用及设备自动化、开发和应用数据抓取。

entries.english: Exposes the MDMA spec (interactive Markdown applications with mounted components), authoring prompts, package metadata and live docs.
entries.zh: 公开 MDMA 规范（带挂载组件的交互式 Markdown 应用）、编写提示词、包元数据和实时文档。

entries.english: Control Android devices and iOS simulators: AI visual analysis, Flutter widget tree inspection, element finding, video recording and test script generation.
entries.zh: 控制 Android 设备和 iOS 模拟器：AI 视觉分析、Flutter 小组件树检查、元素查找、录像和测试脚本生成。

entries.english: Mock HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, MQTT, SSE and SOAP APIs with chaos engineering, stateful CRUD, spec imports and deterministic seeded responses.
entries.zh: 模拟 HTTP、GraphQL、gRPC、WebSocket、MQTT、SSE 和 SOAP API，支持混沌工程、有状态 CRUD、规范导入和确定性种子响应。

entries.english: Synthetic test data generation: detect schemas from SQL or JSON and generate JSON, CSV or SQL data.
entries.zh: 生成合成测试数据：从 SQL 或 JSON 检测模式，并生成 JSON、CSV 或 SQL 数据。

entries.english: Enable a human-in-the-loop feedback workflow in AI coding tools.
entries.zh: 在 AI 编程工具中启用人参与的反馈工作流。

entries.english: Explains why code exists by tracing lines back to commits, GitHub PR descriptions and linked issues, plus file history, commit search and contributors.
entries.zh: 将代码行追溯到提交、GitHub PR 描述及关联问题，以解释代码存在的原因，并提供文件历史、提交搜索和贡献者信息。

entries.english: Pharo Smalltalk integration: code evaluation, class and method introspection, package management, test execution and project installation in Pharo images.
entries.zh: Pharo Smalltalk 集成：在 Pharo 镜像中进行代码求值、类和方法自省、包管理、测试执行及项目安装。

entries.english: Keeps agents grounded in project rules: query coding standards, validate snippets and get task-specific guidance from version-controlled rule files.
entries.zh: 让代理遵守项目规则：从版本控制的规则文件查询编码标准、验证代码片段并获取特定任务指导。

entries.english: Swift code reviews, local Apple references and app scaffolding, plus simulator tools on macOS with Xcode.
entries.zh: Swift 代码审查、本地 Apple 参考资料和应用脚手架，以及 macOS 上使用 Xcode 的模拟器工具。

entries.english: Explore elaborated SystemVerilog/Verilog designs (RTL or gate-level netlists) with najaeda: trace fan-in/fan-out, walk module hierarchy and jump to source.
entries.zh: 使用 najaeda 探索已展开的 SystemVerilog/Verilog 设计（RTL 或门级网表）：追踪扇入/扇出、遍历模块层级并跳转至源码。

entries.english: Test, score and inspect n8n workflows with config-driven test suites, two-tier scoring, execution traces and a built-in node catalog.
entries.zh: 使用配置驱动的测试套件、两级评分、执行跟踪和内置节点目录测试、评分和检查 n8n 工作流。

entries.english: Generate n8n workflow JSON from natural language, lint for deprecated nodes, missing typeVersion and broken connections, and debug per-node execution failures.
entries.zh: 根据自然语言生成 n8n 工作流 JSON，检查已弃用节点、缺失的 typeVersion 和损坏连接，并调试各节点执行故障。

entries.english: Convert any Git repository into a text digest of its codebase using gitingest.
entries.zh: 使用 gitingest 将任意 Git 仓库转换为其代码库的文本摘要。

entries.english: ADB-based Android access: read-only logcat, UI hierarchy, package listing and allowlisted shell commands.
entries.zh: 基于 ADB 的 Android 访问：只读 logcat、界面层次、包列表和允许列表中的 shell 命令。

entries.english: Formats files using .editorconfig rules so AI-generated code follows project formatting standards.
entries.zh: 按 .editorconfig 规则格式化文件，让 AI 生成的代码遵循项目格式标准。

entries.english: Turn a Spring Boot application into an MCP server by reusing its existing Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.
entries.zh: 复用 Spring Boot 应用现有的 Swagger/OpenAPI 文档，将其转变为 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Drive a self-hosted Woodpecker CI: read failing step logs, restart, cancel or approve pipelines, and manage secrets, registries, crons, agents and the queue.
entries.zh: 操作自托管 Woodpecker CI：读取失败步骤日志、重启、取消或批准流水线，并管理密钥、注册表、定时任务、代理和队列。

entries.english: Scaffolds a deployment-readiness harness (redaction, evals from real failures, CI regression gate) into document-QA and extraction projects, and exposes grounding, extraction and readiness checks to agents.
entries.zh: 为文档问答和信息提取项目搭建部署就绪检查框架（敏感信息遮盖、基于真实故障的评估、CI 回归关卡），并向代理公开依据、提取及就绪检查。

entries.english: Framework-aware code intelligence via a cross-language dependency graph: routes, ORM relations, DI trees, impact analysis, call graphs and refactoring.
entries.zh: 通过跨语言依赖图提供框架感知代码智能：路由、ORM 关系、依赖注入树、影响分析、调用图和重构。

entries.english: React/TypeScript development toolkit: component scaffolding, dependency audits, WCAG checks, test generation, type enforcement and monorepo management.
entries.zh: React/TypeScript 开发工具集：组件脚手架、依赖审计、WCAG 检查、测试生成、类型约束和单体仓库管理。

entries.english: Discover and call API endpoints from OpenAPI specs using semantic search and dependency graphs, planning multi-step workflows without loading entire specs.
entries.zh: 使用语义搜索和依赖图从 OpenAPI 规范发现并调用 API 端点，无需加载完整规范即可规划多步骤工作流。

entries.english: Query the Hirð compiler (typed actors on the BEAM): type inference, definition lookup, effect rows, IR fragments, actor protocols and supervision graphs.
entries.zh: 查询 Hirð 编译器（BEAM 上的类型化 actor）：类型推断、定义查找、效应行、IR 片段、actor 协议和监督图。

entries.english: Control Android devices and emulators via ADB: UI inspection, screen interaction, ADB commands and change detection.
entries.zh: 通过 ADB 控制 Android 设备和模拟器：界面检查、屏幕交互、ADB 命令和变更检测。

entries.english: See your codebase the way an agent sees it: turns a source repository into a queryable code graph (symbols, calls, references, structure) with JSON answers an AI coding agent can act on directly, via 12 MCP tools over local stdio.
entries.zh: 以代理的视角查看代码库：将源码仓库转为可查询代码图谱（符号、调用、引用、结构），通过本地 stdio 的 12 个 MCP 工具提供可供 AI 编程代理直接使用的 JSON 答案。

entries.english: Local-first task tracking and coordination for coding agents: durable issues, leases, checkpoints, decisions, dependency graphs and review workflows.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地优先任务跟踪和协调：持久问题、租约、检查点、决策、依赖图和审查工作流。

entries.english: Developer utilities: Base64, UUID, hashing, JWT decoding, cron parsing, timestamps, JSON and regex.
entries.zh: 开发工具：Base64、UUID、哈希、JWT 解码、cron 解析、时间戳、JSON 和正则。

entries.english: DNS lookups, reverse DNS, WHOIS and domain availability checks.
entries.zh: DNS 查询、反向 DNS、WHOIS 和域名可用性检查。

entries.english: Manage Docker containers, images, volumes, networks and Compose services.
entries.zh: 管理 Docker 容器、镜像、卷、网络和 Compose 服务。

entries.english: GitHub Actions: view workflow runs, read logs, re-run failed jobs and manage CI/CD.
entries.zh: GitHub Actions：查看工作流运行、读取日志、重新运行失败任务并管理 CI/CD。

entries.english: Create, read, update, list and search GitHub Gists.
entries.zh: 创建、读取、更新、列出和搜索 GitHub Gist。

entries.english: Search, extract sections, list headings and find code blocks across Markdown files.
entries.zh: 跨 Markdown 文件搜索、提取章节、列出标题和查找代码块。

entries.english: npm package search, bundle size checks, vulnerability scans and download comparisons.
entries.zh: npm 包搜索、包体积检查、漏洞扫描和下载量比较。

entries.english: Web scraping: extract clean Markdown, links and metadata from any URL.
entries.zh: 网页抓取：从任意 URL 提取干净的 Markdown、链接和元数据。

entries.english: Token optimization through caching and compression, with tools for API optimization, code analysis and real-time monitoring.
entries.zh: 通过缓存和压缩优化令牌，提供 API 优化、代码分析和实时监控工具。

entries.english: Generate secure smart contracts in multiple languages from OpenZeppelin Wizard templates.
entries.zh: 根据 OpenZeppelin Wizard 模板生成多种语言的安全智能合约。

entries.english: Ship over-the-air updates for Capacitor mobile apps: inspect the project, check native compatibility, upload web bundles, publish releases with human approval, read rollout health, and revert.
entries.zh: 为 Capacitor 移动应用发布空中更新：检查项目、核查原生兼容性、上传网页包、经人工批准发布版本、读取发布健康状态并回滚。

entries.english: WCAG accessibility and color-contrast audits plus QA issue tracking from your coding agent.
entries.zh: 从编程代理执行 WCAG 无障碍性和颜色对比度审计，以及质量问题跟踪。

entries.english: Enforces critical rules for Claude to prevent documented failure patterns, with a compliance verification checklist and rules summary.
entries.zh: 为 Claude 强制执行关键规则，防止已记录的故障模式，并提供合规性验证清单和规则摘要。
